## Source: internal/plugins/descriptors.go#*Manager.pluginTool

``````
// pluginTool adapts one contributed tool to the catalogue. Read-only tools
// execute through /ether/tool/{name}; writes return a Proposal whose
// Apply runs the call after owner approval (SPEC §5.10). Hosted read-only
// calls carry a host-enforced write restriction; remote tools always require
// approval because a sidecar can write independently of the current call.
func (m *Manager) pluginTool(r Record, tl ToolMeta) tools.Tool {
	pluginID, name := r.ID, tl.Name
	readOnly := tl.ReadOnly && r.Manifest.RuntimeKind() == "hosted"
	title := tl.Title
	if strings.HasPrefix(title, "$t:") {
		title = name
	}
	run := func(ctx context.Context, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
		body, err := json.Marshal(input)
		if err != nil {
			return tools.Result{}, err
		}
		resp, err := m.Call(ctx, pluginID, Request{Method: "POST", Path: "/ether/tool/" + name, Body: body})
		if err != nil {
			return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %s tool %s failed.", pluginID, name)
		}
		if resp.Status >= 300 {
			return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %s tool %s failed with status %d.", pluginID, name, resp.Status)
		}
		if len(resp.Body) > 64*1024 {
			return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin tool output is too large.")
		}
		var data map[string]any
		if len(resp.Body) > 0 {
			if err := json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &data); err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin tool returned invalid output.")
			}
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(data)
		if err != nil {
			return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin tool returned invalid output.")
		}
		clean := m.store.redactKnown(ctx, pluginID, string(encoded))
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(clean), &data); err != nil {
			return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin tool output could not be safely displayed.")
		}
		redactValue(data)
		return tools.Result{Data: data}, nil
	}
	return tools.Tool{
		Name: ToolName(pluginID, name), Title: title, Description: tl.Description,
		InputSchema: tl.InputSchema, ReadOnly: readOnly, Destructive: tl.Destructive,
		OpenWorld: tl.OpenWorld, Audience: tools.AudienceOwner, Owner: pluginID,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(input)
			if err != nil || len(encoded) > 64*1024 {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Tool input is invalid or too large.")
			}
			var snapshot map[string]any
			if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &snapshot); err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Tool input is invalid.")
			}
			if err := agent.ValidateToolInput(tl.InputSchema, snapshot); err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Invalid tool input: %s", err)
			}
			if readOnly {
				return run(context.WithValue(ctx, readOnlyToolContextKey{}, true), snapshot)
			}
			return tools.Result{Proposal: &tools.Proposal{
				Category:    fmt.Sprintf("Run %s from %s", title, r.Name),
				Description: tl.Description,
				Input:       snapshot,
				Apply: func(ctx context.Context) (tools.Result, error) {
					var approved map[string]any
					if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &approved); err != nil {
						return tools.Result{}, err
					}
					return run(ctx, approved)
				},
			}}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/descriptors.go#PermissionSheet

``````
// PermissionSheet returns the plain-language lines the owner sees at
// install (SPEC §5.4). needsViewers and needsFolders say the sheet needs
// viewer or folder picks.
func PermissionSheet(man Manifest) (lines []string, needsViewers, needsFolders bool) {
	if man.Ether != nil && man.Ether.Runtime.Kind == "data" {
		return []string{"Adds channel styles and licensed artwork. Runs no code."}, false, false
	}
	if man.Ether == nil {
		return []string{"Connects to the add-on address you gave"}, false, false
	}
	if man.Ether.Stremio {
		lines = append(lines, "Connects to the add-on it was made from")
	}
	p := man.Ether.Permissions
	for _, h := range p.Network {
		lines = append(lines, "Connects to "+h)
	}
	if normLevel(p.Catalog) == "read" {
		lines = append(lines, "Reads your catalogue")
	}
	if normLevel(p.Viewers.Identity) != "none" {
		lines = append(lines, "Sees who is watching (viewers you choose)")
		needsViewers = needsViewers || normLevel(p.Viewers.Identity) == "granted_viewers"
	}
	if normLevel(p.Viewers.WatchHistory) != "none" {
		lines = append(lines, "Reads watch history")
		needsViewers = needsViewers || normLevel(p.Viewers.WatchHistory) == "granted_viewers"
	}
	if normLevel(p.Viewers.WriteWatchState) != "none" {
		lines = append(lines, "Marks titles watched")
		needsViewers = true
	}
	if normLevel(p.Collections) == "write" {
		lines = append(lines, "Creates and updates collections")
	}
	if normLevel(p.Folders) == "read" {
		lines = append(lines, "Reads folders you choose")
		needsFolders = true
	}
	switch normLevel(p.Sources) {
	case "search":
		lines = append(lines, "Searches your indexers for sources")
	case "acquire":
		lines = append(lines, "Searches your indexers and opens sources through your debrid accounts")
	}
	for _, k := range man.Ether.Contributes.MediaKinds {
		if !k.HasLibrary() {
			continue
		}
		name := k.Library.Name
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, "$t:") {
			name = k.Key
		}
		lines = append(lines, "Adds a library: "+name)
	}
	for range p.Secrets {
		lines = append(lines, "Stores an access token")
	}
	if man.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
		lines = append(lines, "Gets play and new-release events")
	}
	if len(lines) == 0 {
		lines = []string{"Needs no access to your server or the network"}
	}
	return lines, needsViewers, needsFolders
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/descriptors.go#PermissionDiff

``````
// PermissionDiff lists the permissions `next` asks for that `cur` does
// not have. A non-empty result pauses auto-update and asks the owner.
func PermissionDiff(cur, next Manifest) []string {
	if cur.Ether == nil || next.Ether == nil {
		if next.Ether != nil {
			lines, _, _ := PermissionSheet(next)
			return lines
		}
		return nil
	}
	a, b := cur.Ether.Permissions, next.Ether.Permissions
	var added []string
	have := map[string]bool{}
	for _, h := range a.Network {
		have[h] = true
	}
	for _, h := range b.Network {
		if !have[h] {
			added = append(added, "Connects to "+h)
		}
	}
	level := map[string]int{"none": 0, "granted_viewers": 1, "read": 1, "write": 1, "all": 2}
	raised := func(x, y string) bool { return level[normLevel(y)] > level[normLevel(x)] }
	if raised(a.Catalog, b.Catalog) {
		added = append(added, "Reads your catalogue")
	}
	if raised(a.Viewers.Identity, b.Viewers.Identity) {
		added = append(added, "Sees who is watching (viewers you choose)")
	}
	if raised(a.Viewers.WatchHistory, b.Viewers.WatchHistory) {
		added = append(added, "Reads watch history")
	}
	if raised(a.Viewers.WriteWatchState, b.Viewers.WriteWatchState) {
		added = append(added, "Marks titles watched")
	}
	if raised(a.Collections, b.Collections) {
		added = append(added, "Creates and updates collections")
	}
	if raised(a.Folders, b.Folders) {
		added = append(added, "Reads folders you choose")
	}
	sourcesLevel := map[string]int{"none": 0, "search": 1, "acquire": 2}
	if sourcesLevel[normLevel(b.Sources)] > sourcesLevel[normLevel(a.Sources)] {
		if normLevel(b.Sources) == "acquire" {
			added = append(added, "Searches your indexers and opens sources through your debrid accounts")
		} else {
			added = append(added, "Searches your indexers for sources")
		}
	}
	haveKindLib := map[string]bool{}
	for _, k := range cur.Ether.Contributes.MediaKinds {
		if k.HasLibrary() {
			haveKindLib[k.Key] = true
		}
	}
	for _, k := range next.Ether.Contributes.MediaKinds {
		if k.HasLibrary() && !haveKindLib[k.Key] {
			name := k.Library.Name
			if strings.HasPrefix(name, "$t:") {
				name = k.Key
			}
			added = append(added, "Adds a library: "+name)
		}
	}
	haveSecret := map[string]bool{}
	for _, s := range a.Secrets {
		haveSecret[s] = true
	}
	for _, s := range b.Secrets {
		if !haveSecret[s] {
			added = append(added, "Stores an access token")
		}
	}
	if !cur.HasCapability(CapEvents) && next.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
		added = append(added, "Gets play and new-release events")
	}
	return added
}
``````

``````
func newEventID() string {
	var b [8]byte
	_, _ = rand.Read(b[:])
	return hex.EncodeToString(b[:])
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.Publish

``````
// Publish normalizes and fans out one Ether event: it is written to the
// 7-day event log and queued for every enabled plugin that subscribed to
// it (and was not revoked). Viewer identity is stripped per plugin unless
// the plugin's grants allow it.
func (m *Manager) Publish(ctx context.Context, ev Event) {
	if !KnownEvents[ev.Name] {
		return
	}
	m.mu.Lock()
	recs := make([]Record, 0, len(m.eventSubs[ev.Name]))
	for _, r := range m.eventSubs[ev.Name] {
		recs = append(recs, r)
	}
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if len(recs) == 0 {
		return
	}
	if ev.ID == "" {
		ev.ID = newEventID()
	}
	if ev.At.IsZero() {
		ev.At = m.now()
	}
	logged := false
	for _, r := range recs {
		if !r.Enabled || r.Manifest.Ether == nil || !r.Manifest.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
			continue
		}
		sub := false
		if evMeta := r.Manifest.Ether.Contributes.Events; evMeta != nil {
			for _, n := range evMeta.Subscribe {
				if n == ev.Name {
					sub = true
				}
			}
		}
		if !sub {
			continue
		}
		g, err := m.store.grants(ctx, r.ID)
		if err != nil || g.revoked("events") {
			continue
		}
		if !logged {
			m.store.logEvent(ctx, ev)
			logged = true
		}
		out := ev
		if !viewerOK(g, normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Viewers.Identity), ev.ViewerID) {
			out.ViewerID = 0
			out.Payload = stripViewer(out.Payload)
		}
		dropped, err := m.store.enqueue(ctx, r.ID, out)
		if err == nil && dropped > 0 {
			m.healthMu.Lock()
			if h, err := m.store.health(ctx, r.ID); err == nil {
				h.Drops += int64(dropped)
				_ = m.store.putHealth(ctx, r.ID, h)
			}
			m.healthMu.Unlock()
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.indexEventSubscriptions

``````
// indexEventSubscriptions is updated together with the plugin's descriptors.
func (m *Manager) indexEventSubscriptions(r Record) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	for _, subscribers := range m.eventSubs {
		delete(subscribers, r.ID)
	}
	if !r.Enabled || r.Manifest.Ether == nil || !r.Manifest.HasCapability(CapEvents) || r.Manifest.Ether.Contributes.Events == nil {
		return
	}
	for _, name := range r.Manifest.Ether.Contributes.Events.Subscribe {
		if !KnownEvents[name] {
			continue
		}
		if m.eventSubs[name] == nil {
			m.eventSubs[name] = make(map[string]Record)
		}
		m.eventSubs[name][r.ID] = r
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#stripViewer

``````
func stripViewer(payload json.RawMessage) json.RawMessage {
	var doc any
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &doc) != nil {
		return json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	}
	changed := false
	var strip func(any)
	strip = func(v any) {
		switch value := v.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			for k, child := range value {
				lk := strings.ToLower(k)
				if strings.Contains(lk, "viewer") || strings.Contains(lk, "user") {
					delete(value, k)
					changed = true
				} else {
					strip(child)
				}
			}
		case []any:
			for _, child := range value {
				strip(child)
			}
		}
	}
	strip(doc)
	if !changed {
		return payload
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(doc)
	if err != nil {
		return payload
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#NormalizePlayback

``````
// NormalizePlayback maps a playback.Manager event kind to §5.7 names.
// state is the raw timeline state for updates (playing, paused, stopped).
// It returns "" for kinds with no normalized event.
func NormalizePlayback(kind, state string) string {
	switch kind {
	case "start", "started":
		return EventPlaybackStarted
	case "stop", "stopped":
		return EventPlaybackStopped
	case "completed", "complete":
		return EventPlaybackCompleted
	case "error":
		return EventPlaybackError
	case "failover", "downfailover":
		return EventPlaybackFailover
	case "update", "progress":
		switch state {
		case "paused":
			return EventPlaybackPaused
		case "playing":
			return EventPlaybackResumed
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.DeliverOutbox

``````
// DeliverOutbox sends queued events to one plugin in batches of 50 and
// deletes the ones it acks. A missing ack keeps events for redelivery
// (at least once).
func (m *Manager) DeliverOutbox(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) error {
	for {
		evs, ids, err := m.store.outboxBatch(ctx, pluginID, 50)
		if err != nil || len(evs) == 0 {
			return err
		}
		body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"events": evs})
		resp, err := m.Call(ctx, pluginID, Request{Method: "POST", Path: "/ether/event", Body: body})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if resp.Status < 200 || resp.Status >= 300 {
			return fmt.Errorf("event delivery failed with status %d", resp.Status)
		}
		var out struct {
			Ack []string `json:"ack"`
		}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &out)
		acked := map[string]bool{}
		for _, id := range out.Ack {
			acked[id] = true
		}
		var done []int64
		for i, ev := range evs {
			if acked[ev.ID] {
				done = append(done, ids[i])
			}
		}
		if len(done) == 0 {
			return nil // nothing acked; try again later
		}
		if err := m.store.ackOutbox(ctx, done); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(done) < len(evs) {
			return nil
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.Run

``````
// Run drives health checks, scheduled jobs and outbox delivery until ctx
// ends. Leader plugins run jobs and event delivery only on the leader;
// every_node plugins run everywhere. Health checks run on every node.
func (m *Manager) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	defer m.cancelActionJobs("")
	defer func() {
		m.hashMu.Lock()
		defer m.hashMu.Unlock()
		for _, job := range m.hashJobs {
			job.cancel()
		}
	}()

	tick := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)
	defer tick.Stop()
	lastHealth := map[string]time.Time{}
	for {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-tick.C:
			m.runOnce(ctx, lastHealth)
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#stremioManifestRefresh

``````
// runOnce is one scheduler pass; tests drive it directly.
// stremioManifestRefresh is how often an installed Stremio add-on's
// manifest is re-read.
const stremioManifestRefresh = time.Hour
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.runOnce

``````
func (m *Manager) runOnce(ctx context.Context, lastHealth map[string]time.Time) {
	recs, err := m.store.list(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	now := m.now()
	m.refreshOnAir(ctx, recs, now)
	for _, r := range recs {
		if r.Enabled && r.Manifest.IsStremioOnly() && r.SourceKind == "url" && m.isLeader() {
			// Stremio add-ons change catalogs and resources without a
			// version bump; re-read the manifest hourly (cluster leader).
			key := "stremio-manifest|" + r.ID
			if last, seen := lastHealth[key]; !seen || now.Sub(last) >= stremioManifestRefresh {
				lastHealth[key] = now
				if seen {
					go func(id string) {
						rctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), time.Minute)
						defer cancel()
						_, _, _ = m.CheckUpdate(rctx, id)
					}(r.ID)
				}
			}
		}
		if !r.Enabled || r.Manifest.Ether == nil {
			continue
		}
		interval := time.Minute
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(r.Manifest.Ether.Health.Interval); err == nil && d >= 15*time.Second {
			interval = d
		}
		if _, hasRuntime := m.factoryFor(r); hasRuntime && now.Sub(lastHealth[r.ID]) >= interval {
			lastHealth[r.ID] = now
			h, _ := m.store.health(ctx, r.ID)
			if h.NextRetry.IsZero() || !now.Before(h.NextRetry) || h.Status != "error" {
				_, _ = m.CheckHealth(ctx, r.ID)
			}
		}
		if !m.mayRunJobs(r) {
			continue
		}
		for _, job := range r.Manifest.Ether.Schedule {
			if job.Call == "/ether/feeds" {
				continue
			}
			every, err := time.ParseDuration(job.Every)
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			key := r.ID + "|" + job.Call
			m.mu.Lock()
			next, seen := m.nextRun[key]
			if !seen {
				m.nextRun[key] = now.Add(every)
				m.mu.Unlock()
				continue
			}
			if now.Before(next) {
				m.mu.Unlock()
				continue
			}
			m.nextRun[key] = now.Add(every)
			m.mu.Unlock()
			_, _ = m.Call(ctx, r.ID, Request{Method: "POST", Path: job.Call})
		}
		_ = m.DeliverOutbox(ctx, r.ID)
		// Capability refreshes ride the schedule: list sources and
		// channels declare their own refresh in contributes.
		m.maybeRefresh(ctx, r, now)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/events.go#*Manager.maybeRefresh

``````
func (m *Manager) maybeRefresh(ctx context.Context, r Record, now time.Time) {
	type refresh struct {
		key   string
		every time.Duration
		path  string
	}
	var jobs []refresh
	c := r.Manifest.Ether.Contributes
	if c.Channels != nil && c.Channels.Refresh != "" {
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(c.Channels.Refresh); err == nil {
			jobs = append(jobs, refresh{"channels", d, "/ether/channels.json"})
		}
	}
	for _, ls := range c.ListSources {
		refreshStr := ls.Refresh
		if refreshStr == "" {
			refreshStr = "1h"
		}
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(refreshStr); err == nil {
			jobs = append(jobs, refresh{"list:" + ls.Key, d, "/catalog/movie/" + ls.Catalog + ".json"})
		}
	}
	for _, j := range jobs {
		key := r.ID + "|refresh:" + j.key
		m.mu.Lock()
		next, seen := m.nextRun[key]
		if !seen {
			m.nextRun[key] = now.Add(j.every)
			m.mu.Unlock()
			continue
		}
		if now.Before(next) {
			m.mu.Unlock()
			continue
		}
		m.nextRun[key] = now.Add(j.every)
		m.mu.Unlock()
		_, _ = m.Call(ctx, r.ID, Request{Method: "GET", Path: j.path})
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hash_jobs.go#*host.FoldersHashStart

``````
func (h *host) FoldersHashStart(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (FolderHashJob, error) {
	if _, err := h.FoldersStat(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
		return FolderHashJob{}, err
	}
	m := h.m
	m.hashMu.Lock()
	defer m.hashMu.Unlock()
	if m.hashJobs == nil {
		m.hashJobs = make(map[string]*folderHashWork)
	}
	for id, w := range m.hashJobs {
		if w.plugin != h.plugin {
			continue
		}
		w.mu.Lock()
		running := w.status.State == "running"
		status := w.status
		w.mu.Unlock()
		if running {
			if w.root == root && w.path == path {
				return status, nil
			}
			return FolderHashJob{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash: plugin already has a running job")
		}
		delete(m.hashJobs, id)
	}
	select {
	case folderHashSlots <- struct{}{}:
	default:
		return FolderHashJob{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash: global job limit reached; retry later")
	}
	// The job intentionally survives the initiating host call, but has a finite lifetime.
	jobCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 24*time.Hour)
	m.hashSequence++
	w := &folderHashWork{plugin: h.plugin, root: root, path: path, cancel: cancel, status: FolderHashJob{ID: fmt.Sprintf("hash-%d", m.hashSequence), State: "running"}}
	m.hashJobs[w.status.ID] = w
	go func() {
		defer func() { cancel(); <-folderHashSlots }()
		result, err := h.hashFile(jobCtx, root, path, true, func(n int64) { w.mu.Lock(); w.status.Bytes = n; w.mu.Unlock() })
		w.mu.Lock()
		defer w.mu.Unlock()
		if err != nil {
			w.status.State = "error"
			w.status.Error = err.Error()
			if jobCtx.Err() != nil {
				w.status.State = "canceled"
			}
		} else {
			w.status.State = "done"
			w.status.Bytes = result.Size
			w.status.Result = &result
		}
	}()
	return FolderHashJob{ID: w.status.ID, State: "running"}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hash_jobs.go#*host.hashJob

``````
func (h *host) hashJob(ctx context.Context, id string, cancel bool) (FolderHashJob, error) {
	h.m.hashMu.Lock()
	w := h.m.hashJobs[id]
	h.m.hashMu.Unlock()
	if w == nil || w.plugin != h.plugin {
		return FolderHashJob{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash: unknown job")
	}
	if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, w.root, w.path); err != nil {
		w.cancel()
		return FolderHashJob{}, err
	}
	if cancel {
		w.cancel()
	}
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	status := w.status
	if status.Result != nil {
		result := *status.Result
		status.Result = &result
	}
	return status, nil
}
``````

``````
func (h *host) requireWritableToolContext(ctx context.Context) error {
	if readOnly, _ := ctx.Value(readOnlyToolContextKey{}).(bool); readOnly {
		h.noteDenied("read-only tool")
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: read-only tool cannot write", ErrPermissionDenied)
``````

``````
func (h *host) record(ctx context.Context) (Record, Grants, error) {
	r, err := h.m.store.record(ctx, h.plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return Record{}, Grants{}, err
	}
	if !r.Enabled {
		return Record{}, Grants{}, ErrDisabled
	}
	g, err := h.m.store.grants(ctx, h.plugin)
	return r, g, err
``````

``````
		h.noteDenied(key)
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrPermissionDenied, key)
	}
	return nil
}
``````

``````
func (h *host) noteDenied(key string) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if hh, err := h.m.store.health(ctx, h.plugin); err == nil && hh.Status == "ok" {
		hh.Status = "attention"
		hh.Reason = "A permission it needs was taken back: " + key
		_ = h.m.store.putHealth(ctx, h.plugin, hh)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.SecretGet

``````
func (h *host) SecretGet(ctx context.Context, name string) (string, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	declared := false
	for _, s := range r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Secrets {
		if s == name {
			declared = true
		}
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "secrets", "", func(string) bool { return declared }); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	row, err := h.m.store.settings(ctx, h.plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	stored, ok := row.Secrets[name]
	if !ok {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: secret %s is not saved", ErrUnavailable, name)
	}
	return h.m.store.openSecret(h.plugin, name, stored)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.AllowNetworkHost

``````
// AllowNetworkHost reports whether pluginID is enabled, still holds its
// network grant, and declared hostName in permissions.network.
func (m *Manager) AllowNetworkHost(ctx context.Context, pluginID, hostName string) bool {
	h := &host{m: m, plugin: pluginID}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil || r.Manifest.Ether == nil {
		return false
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "network", "", func(string) bool {
		return hostAllowed(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, hostName)
	}); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	return true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#hostAllowed

``````
// hostAllowed matches a host against the manifest network list.
func hostAllowed(patterns []string, host string) bool {
	host = strings.ToLower(host)
	for _, p := range patterns {
		p = strings.ToLower(p)
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "*.") {
			if strings.HasSuffix(host, p[1:]) && host != p[2:] {
				return true
			}
			continue
		}
		if p == host {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#ErrFetchFailed

``````
// ErrFetchFailed is returned when a plugin's outbound request fails. Its
// message names only the host and a category: request URLs can carry
// plugin secrets (API keys in the query), and net/http errors include the
// full URL, so neither the URL nor the underlying error text is exposed.
var ErrFetchFailed = errors.New("plugins: request failed")
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#fetchError

``````
func fetchError(host string, err error) error {
	reason := "network error"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		reason = "timed out"
	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
		reason = "canceled"
	case errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied):
		// A redirect left the plugin's network grant.
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: a redirect from %s left the granted hosts", ErrPermissionDenied, host)
	case errors.Is(err, safefetch.ErrBlocked):
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s is not allowed (%w)", ErrFetchFailed, host, safefetch.ErrBlocked)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s: %s", ErrFetchFailed, host, reason)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.openFetch

``````
func (h *host) openFetch(ctx context.Context, req FetchRequest) (*http.Response, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(req.URL)
	if err != nil || (u.Scheme != "https" && u.Scheme != "http") {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: bad url", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "network", "", func(string) bool {
		return hostAllowed(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, u.Hostname())
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	method := req.Method
	if method == "" {
		method = http.MethodGet
	}
	hr, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, req.URL, bytes.NewReader(req.Body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for k, v := range req.Headers {
		hr.Header.Set(k, v)
	}
	// Recheck the current grant before every redirect, as well as the SSRF
	// guard's own redirect policy. A redirect is another network request.
	client := *h.m.client
	if deadline, ok := ctx.Deadline(); ok {
		client.Timeout = time.Until(deadline)
	}
	previousRedirect := client.CheckRedirect
	client.CheckRedirect = func(next *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
		current, grants, err := h.record(next.Context())
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := h.deny(current, grants, "network", "", func(string) bool {
			return hostAllowed(current.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Network, next.URL.Hostname())
		}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if previousRedirect != nil {
			return previousRedirect(next, via)
		}
		if len(via) >= 10 {
			return errors.New("plugins: stopped after 10 redirects")
		}
		return nil
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(hr)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fetchError(u.Hostname(), err)
	}
	return resp, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.HTTPFetch

``````
func (h *host) HTTPFetch(ctx context.Context, req FetchRequest) (FetchResponse, error) {
	resp, err := h.openFetch(ctx, req)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchResponse{}, err
	}
	u, _ := url.Parse(req.URL)
	defer resp.Body.Close() //nolint:errcheck
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, MaxFetchBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return FetchResponse{}, fetchError(u.Hostname(), err)
	}
	if len(body) > MaxFetchBytes {
		return FetchResponse{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: response larger than %d bytes", MaxFetchBytes)
	}
	h.noteFetchTraffic(ctx, req, int64(len(body)))
	out := FetchResponse{Status: resp.StatusCode, Headers: map[string]string{}, Body: body}
	for k := range resp.Header {
		out.Headers[k] = resp.Header.Get(k)
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

``````
func (h *host) ViewerGranted(ctx context.Context) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	p := r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Viewers
	allowed := (!g.revoked("viewers.watch_history") && normLevel(p.WatchHistory) != "none") || (!g.revoked("viewers.identity") && normLevel(p.Identity) != "none")
	if !allowed || len(g.Viewers) == 0 {
		return json.RawMessage(`[]`), nil
	}
	if h.m.deps.Backends.ViewerNames == nil {
		return nil, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return h.m.deps.Backends.ViewerNames(ctx, g.Viewers)
}
``````

``````
// journalWrite records a write (and, unless shadow, has already applied
// it; callers pass the inverse they obtained).
func (h *host) journal(ctx context.Context, r Record, op, detail string, inverse any) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(inverse)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = h.m.store.journal(ctx, JournalEntry{Plugin: h.plugin, Op: op, Detail: detail, Inverse: raw, Shadow: r.Shadow})
	return err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.SetWatchState

``````
func (h *host) SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "viewers.write_watch_state", normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Viewers.WriteWatchState),
		func(l string) bool { return viewerOK(g, l, viewerID) }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.Shadow {
		return h.journal(ctx, r, "viewers.setWatchState", titleID, watchInverse{Op: "viewers.setWatchState", ViewerID: viewerID, TitleID: titleID, Watched: !watched})
	}
	if h.m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState == nil {
		return ErrUnavailable
	}
	prev, err := h.m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState(ctx, viewerID, titleID, watched)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return h.journal(ctx, r, "viewers.setWatchState", titleID, watchInverse{Op: "viewers.setWatchState", ViewerID: viewerID, TitleID: titleID, Watched: prev})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.CollectionsUpsert

``````
func (h *host) CollectionsUpsert(ctx context.Context, doc json.RawMessage) error {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "collections", normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Collections),
		func(l string) bool { return l == "write" }); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if r.Shadow {
		return h.journal(ctx, r, "collections.upsert", "", collectionInverse{Op: "collections.upsert", Doc: doc})
	}
	if h.m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert == nil {
		return ErrUnavailable
	}
	prev, err := h.m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert(collectionContext(ctx, h.plugin), doc)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return h.journal(ctx, r, "collections.upsert", "", collectionInverse{Op: "collections.upsert", Previous: prev, Doc: doc})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.UndoSince

``````
// UndoSince reverses the plugin's changes back to and including entry
// since (0 means all of them), newest first, so an older change is never
// reversed underneath a later one.
func (m *Manager) UndoSince(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, since int64) (int, error) {
	entries, err := m.store.journalList(ctx, pluginID, 10000, true)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	undone := 0
	for _, e := range entries { // journalList is newest first
		if e.ID < since {
			break
		}
		if err := m.applyInverse(ctx, e); err != nil {
			return undone, err
		}
		if err := m.store.markUndone(ctx, e.ID); err != nil {
			return undone, err
		}
		undone++
	}
	return undone, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.applyInverse

``````
func (m *Manager) applyInverse(ctx context.Context, e JournalEntry) error {
	switch e.Op {
	case "viewers.setWatchState":
		var inv watchInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		_, err := m.deps.Backends.SetWatchState(ctx, inv.ViewerID, inv.TitleID, inv.Watched)
		return err
	case "collections.upsert":
		var inv collectionInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			if m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			_, err := m.deps.Backends.CollectionsUpsert(collectionContext(ctx, e.Plugin), inv.Previous)
			return err
		}
		if m.deps.Backends.CollectionsDelete == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		return m.deps.Backends.CollectionsDelete(collectionContext(ctx, e.Plugin), inv.Doc)
	case "kinds.upsert":
		var inv kindInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b := m.kindBackends()
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			if b.KindUpsert == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			if _, err := b.KindUpsert(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Previous); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if len(inv.Items) > 0 {
			if b.KindDelete == nil {
				return ErrUnavailable
			}
			if err := b.KindDelete(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Items); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		return nil
	case "kinds.delete":
		var inv kindInverse
		if err := json.Unmarshal(e.Inverse, &inv); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		b := m.kindBackends()
		if b.KindUpsert == nil {
			return ErrUnavailable
		}
		if len(inv.Previous) > 0 {
			_, err := b.KindUpsert(ctx, e.Plugin, inv.Kind, inv.Previous)
			return err
		}
		return nil
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: no inverse for journal op %q", e.Op)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.folderCheck

``````
func (h *host) folderCheck(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (string, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "folders", normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Folders),
		func(l string) bool { return l == "read" }); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	granted := false
	for _, f := range g.Folders {
		if f == root {
			granted = true
		}
	}
	if !granted {
		h.noteDenied("folders")
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: folder was not picked for this plugin", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	cleanRoot := filepath.Clean(root)
	joined := filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(cleanRoot, path))
	if joined != cleanRoot && !strings.HasPrefix(joined, cleanRoot+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: path leaves the picked folder", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	return joined, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.FoldersList

``````
func (h *host) FoldersList(ctx context.Context, root, path string) ([]FolderEntry, error) {
	_, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	fs, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer fs.Close()
	name := path
	if name == "" {
		name = "."
	}
	dir, err := fs.Open(name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer dir.Close()
	entries, err := dir.ReadDir(1000)
	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make([]FolderEntry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		fe := FolderEntry{Name: e.Name(), Path: filepath.Join(path, e.Name()), Dir: e.IsDir()}
		if e.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			// Follow a link only when its target stays inside the grant;
			// the rooted Stat fails for one that escapes.
			info, err := fs.Stat(filepath.Join(name, e.Name()))
			if err != nil {
				continue
			}
			fe.Dir, fe.Size, fe.Mtime = info.IsDir(), info.Size(), info.ModTime().Unix()
			out = append(out, fe)
			if len(out) >= 1000 {
				break
			}
			continue
		}
		if info, err := e.Info(); err == nil {
			fe.Size, fe.Mtime = info.Size(), info.ModTime().Unix()
		}
		out = append(out, fe)
		if len(out) >= 1000 {
			break
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*Manager.rateOK

``````
func (m *Manager) rateOK(bucket map[string][]time.Time, key string, limit int, window time.Duration) bool {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	now := m.now()
	kept := bucket[key][:0:0]
	for _, t := range bucket[key] {
		if now.Sub(t) < window {
			kept = append(kept, t)
		}
	}
	if len(kept) >= limit {
		bucket[key] = kept
		return false
	}
	bucket[key] = append(kept, now)
	return true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host.go#*host.hashFile

``````
func (h *host) hashFile(ctx context.Context, root, path string, background bool, progress func(int64)) (FolderHash, error) {
	const capBytes = 256 << 20
	if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	for _, seg := range strings.FieldsFunc(path, func(r rune) bool { return r == '/' || r == '\\' }) {
		if seg == ".." {
			return FolderHash{}, ErrPermissionDenied
		}
	}
	realRoot, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(root)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	target, err := filepath.EvalSymlinks(filepath.Join(realRoot, path))
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	rel, err := filepath.Rel(realRoot, target)
	if err != nil || filepath.IsAbs(path) || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
		return FolderHash{}, ErrPermissionDenied
	}
	fs, err := os.OpenRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	defer fs.Close()
	f, err := fs.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	info, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash requires a regular file")
	}
	if !background && info.Size() > capBytes {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash requires a regular file of at most 256 MiB")
	}
	key := fmt.Sprintf("host.hash.%x", sha256.Sum256([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s:%d:%d", realRoot, rel, info.Size(), info.ModTime().UnixNano()))))
	if raw, ok, err := h.m.store.hashCacheGet(ctx, h.plugin, key); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	} else if ok {
		var cached FolderHash
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &cached) == nil {
			if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
				return FolderHash{}, err
			}
			return cached, nil
		}
	}
	crc, md, sha := crc32.NewIEEE(), md5.New(), sha1.New()
	w := io.MultiWriter(crc, md, sha)
	buf := make([]byte, 1<<20)
	var total int64
	for {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
		if _, err := h.folderCheck(ctx, root, path); err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
		n, err := f.Read(buf)
		total += int64(n)
		if !background && total > capBytes {
			return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash size limit exceeded")
		}
		if n > 0 {
			_, _ = w.Write(buf[:n])
			if progress != nil {
				progress(total)
			}
			if background {
				timer := time.NewTimer(2 * time.Millisecond)
				select {
				case <-ctx.Done():
					timer.Stop()
					return FolderHash{}, ctx.Err()
				case <-timer.C:
				}
			}
		}
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return FolderHash{}, err
		}
	}
	after, err := f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	if total != info.Size() || after.Size() != info.Size() || !after.ModTime().Equal(info.ModTime()) {
		return FolderHash{}, fmt.Errorf("folders.hash file changed while hashing")
	}
	result := FolderHash{Size: total, ModTime: info.ModTime().Unix(), CRC32: fmt.Sprintf("%08x", crc.Sum32()), MD5: fmt.Sprintf("%x", md.Sum(nil)), SHA1: fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha.Sum(nil))}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(result)
	if err := h.m.store.hashCachePut(ctx, h.plugin, key, raw); err != nil {
		return FolderHash{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#boundedDataReader

``````
// boundedDataReader propagates cancellation and rejects overflow instead of
// turning a truncated file into a successful content-addressed cache entry.
type boundedDataReader struct {
	ctx  context.Context
	r    io.Reader
	left int64
	size int64
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*boundedDataReader.Read

``````
func (r *boundedDataReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if r.left < 0 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data exceeds size limit")
	}
	if int64(len(p)) > r.left+1 {
		p = p[:r.left+1]
	}
	n, err := r.r.Read(p)
	r.left -= int64(n)
	r.size += int64(n)
	if r.left < 0 {
		return n, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data exceeds size limit")
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#*host.HTTPFetchToCache

``````
func (h *host) HTTPFetchToCache(ctx context.Context, req FetchCacheRequest) (FetchCacheResult, error) {
	if req.Method != "" && req.Method != "GET" {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache supports GET only")
	}
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	decl, err := h.cacheWriteCheck(ctx, req.LibraryKey, req.Name)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	resp, err := h.openFetch(ctx, req.FetchRequest)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache HTTP %d", resp.StatusCode)
	}
	crc, m, s := crc32.NewIEEE(), md5.New(), sha1.New()
	reader := &boundedDataReader{ctx: ctx, r: resp.Body, left: min(h.DataLimits(ctx).FetchBytes, decl.Cache.EffectiveMaxBytes())}
	ref, err := h.CachePut(ctx, req.LibraryKey, req.Name, io.TeeReader(reader, io.MultiWriter(crc, m, s)))
	h.noteFetchTraffic(ctx, req.FetchRequest, reader.size)
	if err != nil {
		return FetchCacheResult{}, err
	}
	return FetchCacheResult{Blob: ref, Size: reader.size, CRC32: fmt.Sprintf("%08x", crc.Sum32()), MD5: fmt.Sprintf("%x", m.Sum(nil)), SHA1: fmt.Sprintf("%x", s.Sum(nil)), Status: resp.StatusCode}, nil
}
``````

``````
func validDataRange(r DataRange) error {
	if r.Offset < 0 || r.Length <= 0 || r.Length > MaxDataRangeBytes || r.Offset > 1<<60 {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..%d", MaxDataRangeBytes)
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#readDataRange

``````
// Always return base64: arbitrary text/control bytes then have a predictable
// JSON envelope well below the 4 MiB host-result limit.
func readDataRange(ctx context.Context, r io.Reader, opt DataRange) (map[string]any, error) {
	if err := validDataRange(opt); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cr := &boundedDataReader{ctx: ctx, r: r, left: opt.Offset + opt.Length}
	if _, err := io.CopyN(io.Discard, cr, opt.Offset); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(cr, opt.Length))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return map[string]any{"bodyBase64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data), "size": len(data)}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#seekReaderAt

``````
// seekReaderAt gives zip.Reader random access without materializing an archive.
// It is used by one synchronous host call, never shared between goroutines.
type seekReaderAt struct {
	ctx context.Context
	r   io.ReadSeeker
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#seekReaderAt.ReadAt

``````
func (r seekReaderAt) ReadAt(p []byte, off int64) (int, error) {
	if err := r.ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if _, err := r.r.Seek(off, io.SeekStart); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	n, err := io.ReadFull(r.r, p)
	if err == io.ErrUnexpectedEOF {
		err = io.EOF
	}
	return n, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#openDataZIP

``````
func openDataZIP(ctx context.Context, rc io.ReadSeeker, grants ...RuntimeLimits) (*zip.Reader, error) {
	limits := defaultDataLimits()
	if len(grants) > 0 {
		limits = grants[0]
	}
	directoryCap := min(int64(maxArchiveDirectory), int64(limits.ArchiveMembers)*65536)

	size, err := rc.Seek(0, io.SeekEnd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if size < 22 || size > limits.FetchBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP size outside limit")
	}
	ra := seekReaderAt{ctx, rc}
	tailSize := min(size, int64(65557))
	tail := make([]byte, tailSize)
	if _, err := ra.ReadAt(tail, size-tailSize); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// Inspect classic/ZIP64 EOCD before zip.NewReader allocates the directory.
	// Split archives are refused; counts and bytes use owner ceilings.
	found := false
	for i := len(tail) - 22; i >= 0; i-- {
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(tail[i:]) != 0x06054b50 || i+22+int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(tail[i+20:])) != len(tail) {
			continue
		}
		e := tail[i:]
		count := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[10:]))
		directory := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(e[12:]))
		offset := uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(e[16:]))
		directoryEnd := size - tailSize + int64(i)
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[4:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[6:]) != 0 || uint64(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(e[8:])) != count {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: split ZIP archives are unsupported")
		}
		if count == 65535 || directory == 0xffffffff || offset == 0xffffffff {
			locator := make([]byte, 20)
			if directoryEnd < 20 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 locator")
			}
			if _, err := ra.ReadAt(locator, directoryEnd-20); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator) != 0x07064b50 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator[4:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(locator[16:]) != 1 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid or split ZIP64 archive")
			}
			recordAt := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(locator[8:])
			if recordAt > uint64(directoryEnd-20) || uint64(directoryEnd-20)-recordAt < 56 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 directory offset")
			}
			record := make([]byte, 56)
			if _, err := ra.ReadAt(record, int64(recordAt)); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			recordLength := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[4:])
			if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record) != 0x06064b50 || recordLength < 44 || recordLength > 1<<20 || recordAt+12+recordLength != uint64(directoryEnd-20) || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record[16:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(record[20:]) != 0 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[24:]) != binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[32:]) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP64 directory")
			}
			count = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[32:])
			directory = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[40:])
			offset = binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(record[48:])
			directoryEnd = int64(recordAt)
		}
		if count > uint64(limits.ArchiveMembers) || directory > uint64(directoryCap) || offset > uint64(directoryEnd) || directory > uint64(directoryEnd)-offset || offset+directory != uint64(directoryEnd) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory exceeds owner limits or has unsupported layout")
		}
		raw := make([]byte, int(directory))
		if _, err := ra.ReadAt(raw, int64(offset)); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		pos := 0
		for n := 0; n < int(count); n++ {
			if pos+46 > len(raw) || binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(raw[pos:]) != 0x02014b50 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP directory")
			}
			header := raw[pos:]
			pos += 46 + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[28:])) + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[30:])) + int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(header[32:]))
			if pos > len(raw) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: invalid ZIP directory length")
			}
		}
		if pos != len(raw) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory count mismatch")
		}
		found = true
		break
	}
	if !found {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP directory not found")
	}
	z, err := zip.NewReader(ra, size)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(z.File) > limits.ArchiveMembers {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP has too many members")
	}
	var total uint64
	names := 0
	for _, f := range z.File {
		name := strings.TrimSuffix(f.Name, "/")
		names += len(f.Name)
		if name == "" || len(f.Name) > 1024 || int64(names) > directoryCap || strings.ContainsAny(name, "\\:\x00") || strings.HasPrefix(name, "/") || path.Clean(name) != name || name == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(name, "../") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: unsafe ZIP member name")
		}
		if !f.FileInfo().IsDir() && !f.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: unsupported ZIP member type")
		}
		if f.Flags&1 != 0 || (f.Method != zip.Store && f.Method != zip.Deflate) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: encrypted or unsupported ZIP member")
		}
		if f.CompressedSize64 > uint64(size) || f.UncompressedSize64 > uint64(limits.ArchiveMemberBytes) || (f.UncompressedSize64 > 0 && (f.CompressedSize64 == 0 || (f.CompressedSize64 <= ^uint64(0)/maxArchiveRatio && f.UncompressedSize64 > f.CompressedSize64*maxArchiveRatio))) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP member exceeds size or compression-ratio limit")
		}
		if f.UncompressedSize64 > uint64(limits.ArchiveExpandedBytes)-total {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP expanded size exceeds limit")
		}
		total += f.UncompressedSize64
	}
	return z, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_data.go#CallDataHost

``````
// CallDataHost is the shared hosted/remote data-service funnel. Only the four
// named services are accepted; cache access rechecks plugin ownership each call.
func CallDataHost(ctx context.Context, h Host, name string, raw json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	// Remote callers receive the same maximum I/O deadline as hosted calls.
	limits := defaultDataLimits()
	if provider, ok := h.(interface {
		DataLimits(context.Context) RuntimeLimits
	}); ok {
		limits = provider.DataLimits(ctx)
	}
	deadline, err := time.ParseDuration(limits.Deadline)
	if err != nil || deadline <= 0 {
		deadline = 12 * time.Hour
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, deadline)
	defer cancel()
	var args []json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &args); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var value any
	err = nil
	if name == "http.fetchToCache" {
		var req struct {
			Method     string            `json:"method"`
			URL        string            `json:"url"`
			Headers    map[string]string `json:"headers"`
			LibraryKey string            `json:"libraryKey"`
			Name       string            `json:"name"`
		}
		if len(args) != 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache takes one request")
		}
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &req); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if req.Method != "" && req.Method != "GET" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: fetchToCache supports GET only")
		}
		service, ok := h.(interface {
			HTTPFetchToCache(context.Context, FetchCacheRequest) (FetchCacheResult, error)
		})
		if !ok {
			return nil, ErrUnavailable
		}
		value, err = service.HTTPFetchToCache(ctx, FetchCacheRequest{FetchRequest: FetchRequest{Method: req.Method, URL: req.URL, Headers: req.Headers}, LibraryKey: req.LibraryKey, Name: req.Name})
	} else {
		if name != "cache.read" && name != "archive.list" && name != "archive.open" {
			return nil, ErrPermissionDenied
		}
		if len(args) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: data service needs a blob reference")
		}
		var ref string
		if err = json.Unmarshal(args[0], &ref); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var opt DataRange
		var member int
		switch name {
		case "archive.list":
			if len(args) != 1 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.list takes one blob reference")
			}
		case "cache.read":
			if len(args) != 2 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache.read takes (blob, range)")
			}
			err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &opt)
		case "archive.open":
			if len(args) != 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: archive.open takes (blob, memberIndex, range)")
			}
			if err = json.Unmarshal(args[1], &member); err == nil {
				err = json.Unmarshal(args[2], &opt)
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if name != "archive.list" {
			if err = validDataRange(opt); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
		rc, e := h.CacheOpen(ctx, ref)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		defer rc.Close()
		if name == "cache.read" {
			if _, err = rc.Seek(opt.Offset, io.SeekStart); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			opt.Offset = 0
			value, err = readDataRange(ctx, rc, opt)
		} else {
			z, e := openDataZIP(ctx, rc, limits)
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			if name == "archive.list" {
				members := make([]ArchiveMember, 0, len(z.File))
				for i, f := range z.File {
					members = append(members, ArchiveMember{i, f.Name, f.UncompressedSize64})
				}
				value = members
			} else {
				if member < 0 || member >= len(z.File) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP member index outside range")
				}
				f := z.File[member]
				if uint64(opt.Offset) > f.UncompressedSize64 {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: ZIP member offset outside range")
				}
				stream, e := f.Open()
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				defer stream.Close()
				value, err = readDataRange(ctx, io.LimitReader(stream, int64(f.UncompressedSize64)+1), opt)
			}
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return json.Marshal(value)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#KindBackends

``````
// KindBackends are the Ether services the kind host calls end in: the
// plugin-item store, the source resolver and the blob cache. Any field
// may be nil, in which case the matching host call returns
// ErrUnavailable. App wiring fills them (pluginitems, the indexer and
// debrid services, blobcache); the plugin id is always the caller's,
// so a plugin can only ever reach its own kinds and cache.
type KindBackends struct {
	KindUpsert     func(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, items []core.KindItem) (accepted int, err error)
	KindDelete     func(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error
	KindItems      func(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (core.KindPage, error)
	ResolveSources func(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, q core.SourceQuery) ([]core.SourceCandidate, error)
	CachePut       func(ctx context.Context, pluginID, libraryKey, name string, r io.Reader) (blobRef string, err error)
	CacheOpen      func(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) (io.ReadSeekCloser, error)
	// StreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's own
	// kind items for one viewer and returns the Ether stream URL (spec
	// §6.5). The backend re-checks item ownership and library visibility.
	StreamURL func(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string) (string, error)
}
``````

``````
	m.deps.Backends.CachePut = b.CachePut
	m.deps.Backends.CacheOpen = b.CacheOpen
	m.deps.Backends.StreamURL = b.StreamURL
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#CheckKindItem

``````
// CheckKindItem validates one item envelope against its kind
// declaration: identity, level, the string caps and the hints shape.
// Field-value typing against KindField is the item store's deeper
// check (spec §3.3); this one is shared by the host and the kit so a
// plugin is told the same thing everywhere. It returns a plain
// reason, or "" when the item passes.
func CheckKindItem(decl MediaKindMeta, it core.KindItem) string {
	switch {
	case !ValidExternalID(it.ID):
		return "id must start with a letter or digit and use letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore or tilde, at most 128 characters"
	case it.ParentID != "" && !ValidExternalID(it.ParentID):
		return "parentId must be a valid external id"
	case strings.TrimSpace(it.Title) == "":
		return "title is required"
	case utf8.RuneCountInString(it.Title) > 500:
		return "title is longer than 500 characters"
	case utf8.RuneCountInString(it.Summary) > 20000:
		return "summary is longer than 20000 characters"
	case len(it.Art) > MaxKindArtRoles:
		return "art lists more than 16 roles"
	case len(it.Hints) > MaxKindHintsBytes:
		return "hints are larger than 16 KiB"
	}
	lv, at, ok := decl.Level(it.Level)
	if !ok {
		return "level " + it.Level + " is not declared for this kind"
	}
	if at == 0 && it.ParentID != "" {
		return "a root-level item cannot name a parent"
	}
	if at > 0 && it.ParentID == "" {
		return "a " + it.Level + " item needs a parentId"
	}
	if it.Playable && !lv.Playable {
		return "level " + it.Level + " is not declared playable"
	}
	if len(it.Hints) > 0 {
		var obj map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(it.Hints, &obj); err != nil || obj == nil {
			return "hints must be a JSON object"
		}
	}
	seenArt := map[string]bool{}
	for _, a := range it.Art {
		if a.Role == "" || a.URL == "" || seenArt[a.Role] {
			return "each art entry needs a distinct role and a url"
		}
		seenArt[a.Role] = true
	}
	for key := range it.Fields {
		if !kindFieldRe.MatchString(key) {
			return "field names must match the declared field pattern"
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.kindCheck

``````
// kindCheck resolves the caller's record and one declared kind,
// requiring one of caps. Roles the owner switched off are absent from
// the effective manifest, so they deny like a missing capability.
func (h *host) kindCheck(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, caps ...Capability) (Record, MediaKindMeta, error) {
	r, _, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return Record{}, MediaKindMeta{}, err
	}
	man := r.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	allowed := false
	for _, c := range caps {
		if man.HasCapability(c) {
			allowed = true
		}
	}
	if !allowed {
		h.noteDenied(string(caps[0]))
		return Record{}, MediaKindMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrPermissionDenied, caps[0])
	}
	decl, ok := man.MediaKindByKey(kindKey)
	if !ok {
		return Record{}, MediaKindMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: kind %q is not declared", ErrUnavailable, kindKey)
	}
	return r, decl, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.snapshotKindItems

``````
// snapshotKindItems looks up any existing items for kindKey whose IDs
// are in ids so a live KindUpsert or KindDelete can record a real
// inverse in the journal.
func (h *host) snapshotKindItems(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, ids []string) (existing []core.KindItem, missing []string) {
	readFn := h.m.kindBackends().KindItems
	if readFn == nil || len(ids) == 0 {
		return nil, append([]string(nil), ids...)
	}
	want := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		want[id] = true
	}
	found := make(map[string]core.KindItem, len(ids))
	cursor := ""
	seenCursor := map[string]bool{}
	for pageNum := 0; pageNum < 50 && len(found) < len(want); pageNum++ {
		seenCursor[cursor] = true
		page, err := readFn(ctx, h.plugin, kindKey, cursor, MaxKindUpsertItems)
		if err != nil {
			break
		}
		for _, it := range page.Items {
			if want[it.ID] {
				if _, dup := found[it.ID]; !dup {
					found[it.ID] = it
				}
			}
		}
		if page.NextCursor == "" || seenCursor[page.NextCursor] {
			break
		}
		cursor = page.NextCursor
	}
	seenID := map[string]bool{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if seenID[id] {
			continue
		}
		seenID[id] = true
		if prev, ok := found[id]; ok {
			existing = append(existing, prev)
		} else {
			missing = append(missing, id)
		}
	}
	return existing, missing
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.KindUpsert

``````
func (h *host) KindUpsert(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, items []core.KindItem) (int, error) {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	r, decl, err := h.kindCheck(ctx, kindKey, CapCatalogProvider)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if decl.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPush {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: kind %s is pull-synced by Ether and takes no pushes", ErrPermissionDenied, kindKey)
	}
	if len(items) > MaxKindUpsertItems {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: kind upsert batch larger than %d items", MaxKindUpsertItems)
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(items))
	for _, it := range items {
		if msg := CheckKindItem(decl, it); msg != "" {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("plugins: kind item %q: %s", it.ID, msg)
		}
		ids = append(ids, it.ID)
	}
	if r.Shadow {
		return len(items), h.journal(ctx, r, "kinds.upsert", kindKey, kindInverse{Op: "kinds.upsert", Kind: kindKey, Items: ids})
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().KindUpsert
	if backend == nil {
		return 0, ErrUnavailable
	}
	prev, created := h.snapshotKindItems(ctx, kindKey, ids)
	accepted, err := backend(ctx, h.plugin, kindKey, items)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := h.journal(ctx, r, "kinds.upsert", kindKey, kindInverse{
		Op:       "kinds.upsert",
		Kind:     kindKey,
		Items:    created,
		Previous: prev,
	}); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return accepted, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.KindDelete

``````
func (h *host) KindDelete(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r, decl, err := h.kindCheck(ctx, kindKey, CapCatalogProvider)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if decl.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPush {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kind %s is pull-synced by Ether and takes no pushes", ErrPermissionDenied, kindKey)
	}
	if len(externalIDs) > MaxKindUpsertItems {
		return fmt.Errorf("plugins: kind delete batch larger than %d items", MaxKindUpsertItems)
	}
	for _, id := range externalIDs {
		if !ValidExternalID(id) {
			return fmt.Errorf("plugins: kind item id %q is not a valid external id", id)
		}
	}
	if r.Shadow {
		return h.journal(ctx, r, "kinds.delete", kindKey, kindInverse{Op: "kinds.delete", Kind: kindKey, Items: externalIDs})
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().KindDelete
	if backend == nil {
		return ErrUnavailable
	}
	prev, _ := h.snapshotKindItems(ctx, kindKey, externalIDs)
	if err := backend(ctx, h.plugin, kindKey, externalIDs); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return h.journal(ctx, r, "kinds.delete", kindKey, kindInverse{
		Op:       "kinds.delete",
		Kind:     kindKey,
		Items:    externalIDs,
		Previous: prev,
	})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.KindItems

``````
func (h *host) KindItems(ctx context.Context, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (core.KindPage, error) {
	if _, _, err := h.kindCheck(ctx, kindKey, CapCatalogProvider); err != nil {
		return core.KindPage{}, err
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().KindItems
	if backend == nil {
		return core.KindPage{}, ErrUnavailable
	}
	if limit <= 0 {
		limit = 200
	}
	if limit > MaxKindUpsertItems {
		limit = MaxKindUpsertItems
	}
	return backend(ctx, h.plugin, kindKey, cursor, limit)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.ResolveSources

``````
func (h *host) ResolveSources(ctx context.Context, q core.SourceQuery) ([]core.SourceCandidate, error) {
	r, g, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	man := r.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	if !man.HasCapability(CapKindResolver) {
		h.noteDenied(string(CapKindResolver))
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrPermissionDenied, CapKindResolver)
	}
	need := "search"
	switch q.Kind {
	case "indexer_search":
		if strings.TrimSpace(q.Query) == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: indexer_search needs a query")
		}
	case "debrid_check":
		if len(q.InfoHashes) == 0 && q.InfoHash == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: debrid_check needs an info hash")
		}
	case "debrid_acquire":
		need = "acquire"
		if q.InfoHash == "" && q.Magnet == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: debrid_acquire needs an info hash or magnet")
		}
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: unknown source query kind %q", q.Kind)
	}
	level := normLevel(r.Manifest.Ether.Permissions.Sources)
	if err := h.deny(r, g, "sources", level, func(l string) bool {
		return l == "acquire" || (l == "search" && need == "search")
	}); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().ResolveSources
	if backend == nil {
		return nil, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return backend(ctx, h.plugin, q)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.CachePut

``````
func (h *host) CachePut(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string, r io.Reader) (string, error) {
	if err := h.requireWritableToolContext(ctx); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	decl, err := h.cacheWriteCheck(ctx, libraryKey, name)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().CachePut
	if backend == nil {
		return "", ErrUnavailable
	}
	// A single blob can never exceed the whole per-library quota.
	limited := io.LimitReader(r, decl.Cache.EffectiveMaxBytes()+1)
	return backend(ctx, h.plugin, libraryKey, name, limited)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#withViewerHeader

``````
// withViewerHeader reads the X-Ether-Viewer header the frontend adapter
// proxy injects and attaches that viewer to the context. A missing or
// malformed header leaves the context unchanged.
func withViewerHeader(ctx context.Context, headers map[string]string) context.Context {
	if headers == nil {
		return ctx
	}
	raw := headers["X-Ether-Viewer"]
	if raw == "" {
		return ctx
	}
	id, err := strconv.ParseInt(raw, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || id <= 0 {
		return ctx
	}
	return WithViewer(ctx, id)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.StreamURL

``````
// StreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's own kind
// items and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5). The viewer is the one
// the proxied request authenticated, carried on the call context as
// X-Ether-Viewer. The backend re-checks that the item belongs to this plugin
// and that the viewer may see its library.
func (h *host) StreamURL(ctx context.Context, itemRef string) (string, error) {
	rec, _, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	man := rec.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	if man.Ether == nil || !man.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) {
		h.noteDenied(string(CapFrontendAdapter))
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrPermissionDenied, CapFrontendAdapter)
	}
	viewerID, ok := ViewerFromContext(ctx)
	if !ok || viewerID <= 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%w: stream url needs an authenticated viewer", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(itemRef) == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("plugins: stream url needs an item ref")
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().StreamURL
	if backend == nil {
		return "", ErrUnavailable
	}
	return backend(ctx, h.plugin, viewerID, itemRef)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.CacheOpen

``````
func (h *host) CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, blobRef string) (io.ReadSeekCloser, error) {
	if _, _, err := h.record(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hexPart, ok := strings.CutPrefix(blobRef, "blob:")
	if !ok || len(hexPart) != 64 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache reference must be blob:<sha256>")
	}
	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(hexPart); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache reference must be blob:<sha256>")
	}
	backend := h.m.kindBackends().CacheOpen
	if backend == nil {
		return nil, ErrUnavailable
	}
	return backend(ctx, h.plugin, blobRef)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/host_kinds.go#*host.cacheWriteCheck

``````
func (h *host) cacheWriteCheck(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string) (MediaKindMeta, error) {
	rec, _, err := h.record(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return MediaKindMeta{}, err
	}
	man := rec.Manifest
	man.Ether = man.EffectiveEther()
	// The library key must name one of this plugin's own kinds; the
	// blob cache namespace follows from it, so a plugin can never
	// write into another library's cache.
	var decl MediaKindMeta
	found := false
	if man.Ether != nil {
		for _, k := range man.Ether.Contributes.MediaKinds {
			if core.PluginLibraryKey(h.plugin, k.Key) == libraryKey {
				decl, found = k, true
			}
		}
	}
	if !found || !(man.HasCapability(CapCatalogProvider) || man.HasCapability(CapKindResolver)) {
		h.noteDenied("cache")
		return MediaKindMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: cache", ErrPermissionDenied)
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(name) == "" {
		return MediaKindMeta{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: cache put needs a name")
	}
	return decl, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#HotRuntime

``````
// HotRuntime is implemented by hosted runtimes whose plugin exports the
// hot-path ABI (SPEC §5.2): ranking steps and rule conditions. The ranking
// adapters reach it through Manager.Hot. Budgets are the manifest's
// (lowered, never raised) and every call reports a classified outcome.
type HotRuntime interface {
	Runtime
	// RankBatch returns one key per candidate (higher ranks first). A
	// candidate that exceeded its budget gets the neutral key 0 and counts
	// in HotOutcome.Slow; a batch that ran out of time returns neutral keys
	// for the rest.
	RankBatch(ctx context.Context, cands []CandidateFacts, config json.RawMessage) (keys []int64, out HotOutcome, err error)
	// CondMatch evaluates a rule condition; false when the budget runs out.
	CondMatch(ctx context.Context, cand CandidateFacts, operator string, value json.RawMessage) (match bool, out HotOutcome, err error)
	HasRankKey() bool
	HasCondMatch() bool
	// Budgets reports the effective per-candidate and per-batch limits.
	Budgets() HotBudgets
}
``````

``````
// rankingBudget is the manifest's per-step budget (SPEC §4.3: budget).
type rankingBudget struct {
	PerCandidateMicros int64 `json:"perCandidateMicros"`
	PerBatchMicros     int64 `json:"perBatchMicros"`
	PerBatchMillis     int64 `json:"perBatchMillis"`
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#HotLimits

``````
// HotLimits lowers the runtime's hot-path defaults to the tightest budget a
// manifest declares across its ranking steps. The engine clamps anything
// above its defaults, so a manifest can lower budgets but never raise them.
// Studio replay uses it to run a plugin under its installed budgets.
func HotLimits(m Manifest) wasm.Limits {
	lim := RuntimeLimitsFor(m)
	if m.Ether == nil {
		return lim
	}
	for _, step := range m.Ether.Contributes.RankingSteps {
		if len(step.Budget) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		var b rankingBudget
		if json.Unmarshal(step.Budget, &b) != nil {
			continue
		}
		if b.PerCandidateMicros > 0 {
			d := time.Duration(b.PerCandidateMicros) * time.Microsecond
			if lim.RankPerCandidate == 0 || d < lim.RankPerCandidate {
				lim.RankPerCandidate = d
			}
		}
		batch := time.Duration(b.PerBatchMicros) * time.Microsecond
		if b.PerBatchMillis > 0 {
			batch = time.Duration(b.PerBatchMillis) * time.Millisecond
		}
		if batch > 0 && (lim.RankBatch == 0 || batch < lim.RankBatch) {
			lim.RankBatch = batch
		}
	}
	return lim
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#hotOutcome

``````
func hotOutcome(o wasm.Outcome) HotOutcome {
	return HotOutcome{Status: string(o.Status), Duration: o.Duration, Units: o.Units, Slow: o.SlowCandidates, MemoHits: o.MemoHits, Trap: o.Trap}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#HostedRuntimeFactory

``````
// HostedRuntimeFactory opens hosted plugins (runtime.kind "hosted") on the
// wazero engine: JavaScript and TypeScript entries run on QuickJS, raw
// modules through the documented WASM ABI.
func HostedRuntimeFactory(eng *wasm.Engine) RuntimeFactory {
	return func(inst Installed) (Runtime, error) {
		if inst.Manifest.Ether == nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s: hosted plugins need an ether block", inst.ID)
		}
		decl := inst.Manifest.Ether.Runtime
		host := hostBridge{h: inst.Host}
		lim := HotLimits(inst.Manifest)
		if inst.RuntimeLimits != nil {
			l := inst.RuntimeLimits
			lim.MemoryBytes = l.MemoryBytes
			lim.Deadline, _ = time.ParseDuration(l.Deadline)
			lim.UnitBudget = l.UnitBudget
		}
		lim.Busy = inst.Busy
		switch {
		case decl.Module != "":
			module, ok := inst.Files(decl.Module)
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s: module %q is missing", inst.ID, decl.Module)
			}
			p, err := eng.LoadWASM(inst.ID, inst.Manifest.Version, module, host, lim)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &hostedRuntime{p: p}, nil
		case decl.Entry != "":
			src, ok := inst.Files(decl.Entry)
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s: entry %q is missing", inst.ID, decl.Entry)
			}
			js := string(src)
			if ext := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(decl.Entry)); ext == ".ts" || ext == ".tsx" || ext == ".mts" {
				out, _, diags := wasm.Compile(map[string]string{decl.Entry: js}, decl.Entry)
				if err := diagnosticsError(diags); err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s: %w", inst.ID, err)
				}
				js = string(out)
			}
			p, err := eng.LoadJS(inst.ID, inst.Manifest.Version, js, host, lim)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return &hostedRuntime{p: p}, nil
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("plugin %s: hosted runtime needs an entry or a module", inst.ID)
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#diagnosticsError

``````
func diagnosticsError(diags []wasm.Diagnostic) error {
	var msgs []string
	for _, d := range diags {
		if d.Severity == "error" {
			msgs = append(msgs, d.Text)
		}
	}
	if len(msgs) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return errors.New("compile: " + strings.Join(msgs, "; "))
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#EffectiveBudgets

``````
// EffectiveBudgets mirrors the engine's clamping: the budgets a manifest
// gets as SPEC 5.2 states them, in reference-machine time. The engine
// scales them by its measured speed (wasm.HotScale); Budgets reports that.
func EffectiveBudgets(lim wasm.Limits) HotBudgets {
	per, batch := lim.RankPerCandidate, lim.RankBatch
	if per <= 0 || per > wasm.DefaultRankPerCandidate {
		per = wasm.DefaultRankPerCandidate
	}
	if batch <= 0 || batch > wasm.DefaultRankBatch {
		batch = wasm.DefaultRankBatch
	}
	return HotBudgets{PerCandidate: per, PerBatch: batch}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*hostedRuntime.Budgets

``````
// Budgets reports the limits in force on this machine: the manifest's,
// scaled by the engine's measured speed.
func (r *hostedRuntime) Budgets() HotBudgets {
	per, batch := r.p.Budgets()
	return HotBudgets{PerCandidate: per, PerBatch: batch}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*hostedRuntime.Call

``````
func (r *hostedRuntime) Call(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Response, error) {
	q := make(map[string][]string, len(req.Query))
	for k, v := range req.Query {
		q[k] = []string{v}
	}
	headers := req.Headers
	if req.Locale != "" {
		headers = cloneHeaders(headers)
		headers["X-Ether-Locale"] = req.Locale
	}
	resp, err := r.p.Call(ctx, wasm.Request{Op: req.Op, ID: req.ID, Method: req.Method, Path: req.Path, Query: q, Headers: headers, Body: req.Body})
	if err != nil {
		return Response{}, err
	}
	return Response{Status: resp.Status, Headers: resp.Headers, Body: resp.Body}, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*hostedRuntime.RankBatch

``````
func (r *hostedRuntime) RankBatch(ctx context.Context, cands []CandidateFacts, config json.RawMessage) ([]int64, HotOutcome, error) {
	in := make([]wasm.Candidate, len(cands))
	for i, c := range cands {
		facts, err := json.Marshal(c)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, HotOutcome{Status: string(wasm.StatusError)}, err
		}
		in[i] = wasm.Candidate{ReleaseID: c.ReleaseID, Facts: facts}
	}
	keys, out, err := r.p.RankBatch(ctx, in, config)
	return keys, hotOutcome(out), err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*hostedRuntime.CondMatch

``````
func (r *hostedRuntime) CondMatch(ctx context.Context, cand CandidateFacts, operator string, value json.RawMessage) (bool, HotOutcome, error) {
	facts, err := json.Marshal(cand)
	if err != nil {
		return false, HotOutcome{Status: string(wasm.StatusError)}, err
	}
	ok, out, err := r.p.CondMatch(ctx, wasm.Candidate{ReleaseID: cand.ReleaseID, Facts: facts}, operator, value)
	return ok, hotOutcome(out), err
}
``````

``````
func cloneHeaders(h map[string]string) map[string]string {
	out := make(map[string]string, len(h)+1)
	for k, v := range h {
		out[k] = v
	}
	return out
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*Manager.Hot

``````
// Hot returns the hosted runtime of an enabled plugin when it exports the
// hot-path ABI, loading it if needed. It may block on a load, so it is for
// background work (replay, Studio); the play path uses HotReady.
func (m *Manager) Hot(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (HotRuntime, bool) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil || !r.Enabled {
		return nil, false
	}
	rt, err := m.runtimeFor(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, false
	}
	hot, ok := rt.(HotRuntime)
	return hot, ok
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*Manager.HotReady

``````
// HotReady is the play-path accessor. It never blocks: it returns the
// plugin's hosted runtime only when it is already loaded, and otherwise
// starts loading it in the background and reports false, so the caller
// treats the plugin's steps and conditions as neutral for this resolve.
// Plugins in shadow mode are never ready on the play path. Runtimes are dropped on update, disable, remove and failure (closeRuntime)
// and warmed again when descriptors sync.
func (m *Manager) HotReady(pluginID string) (HotRuntime, bool) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	rt, ok := m.runtimes[pluginID]
	shadow := m.shadow[pluginID]
	m.mu.Unlock()
	if shadow {
		// A plugin in shadow mode never changes real picks; replay and the
		// shadow report show what it would have done.
		return nil, false
	}
	if !ok {
		m.warmAsync(pluginID)
		return nil, false
	}
	hot, ok := rt.(HotRuntime)
	return hot, ok
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*Manager.prewarmHot

``````
// prewarmHot loads, in the background, the runtime of an enabled plugin
// that contributes ranking steps or rule conditions, so the first resolve
// after start, install, update or enable finds it ready.
func (m *Manager) prewarmHot(r Record) {
	if !r.Enabled || r.Manifest.Ether == nil {
		return
	}
	c := r.Manifest.Ether.Contributes
	if len(c.RankingSteps) == 0 && len(c.RuleConditions) == 0 {
		return
	}
	m.warmAsync(r.ID)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/hosted.go#*Manager.warmAsync

``````
// warmAsync loads one plugin's runtime once in the background.
func (m *Manager) warmAsync(pluginID string) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	if m.warming[pluginID] {
		m.mu.Unlock()
		return
	}
	m.warming[pluginID] = true
	m.mu.Unlock()
	go func() {
		defer func() {
			m.mu.Lock()
			delete(m.warming, pluginID)
			m.mu.Unlock()
		}()
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
		if err != nil || !r.Enabled {
			return
		}
		if _, err := m.runtimeFor(ctx, r); err != nil {
			m.log.Warn("plugins: warm hot runtime", "plugin", pluginID, "err", err)
		}
	}()
}
``````
