## Source: internal/plugins/kit/templates.go#Scaffold

``````
// Scaffold generates a minimal working plugin for the requested kind and
// language in opts.Dir. Every generated template passes kit.Check out of
// the box.
func Scaffold(opts TemplateOptions) error {
	if opts.Kind == "" {
		opts.Kind = string(plugins.KindLiveTVSource)
	}
	switch plugins.Kind(opts.Kind) {
	case plugins.KindSource, plugins.KindIntegration, plugins.KindNotificationChannel, plugins.KindLiveTVSource, plugins.KindExtension:
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown plugin kind %q (must be source, integration, notification_channel, livetv_source or extension)", opts.Kind)
	}
	if opts.Lang == "" {
		opts.Lang = "ts"
	}
	switch opts.Lang {
	case "ts", "js", "python":
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown language %q (must be ts, js or python)", opts.Lang)
	}
	if opts.Dir == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("target directory is required")
	}
	if entries, err := os.ReadDir(opts.Dir); err == nil {
		if len(entries) != 0 {
			return fmt.Errorf("target directory %q is not empty", opts.Dir)
		}
	} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return err
	}
	base := strings.ToLower(filepath.Base(opts.Dir))
	slug := strings.Trim(slugCleanRe.ReplaceAllString(base, "-"), "-")
	if slug == "" || !(slug[0] >= 'a' && slug[0] <= 'z') {
		slug = "sample-" + slug
		slug = strings.Trim(slug, "-")
	}
	if opts.ID == "" {
		opts.ID = "community.example." + strings.ReplaceAll(slug, "-", "")
	}
	if opts.Name == "" {
		opts.Name = humanName(slug)
	}

	files, err := GenerateTemplateFiles(opts)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for rel, content := range files {
		full := filepath.Join(opts.Dir, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(full), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(full, content, 0o644); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/templates.go#humanName

``````
func humanName(slug string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(slug, "-")
	for i, p := range parts {
		if len(p) > 0 {
			if i == 0 {
				parts[i] = strings.ToUpper(p[:1]) + p[1:]
			} else {
				parts[i] = p
			}
		}
	}
	name := strings.Join(parts, " ")
	if name == "" {
		return "Sample plugin"
	}
	return name
}
``````

``````
	switch opts.Lang {

	case "js":
		files["dist/plugin.js"] = []byte(code)
	case "python":

	}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/kit/templates.go#generatePluginCode

``````
func generatePluginCode(lang string) string {
	if lang == "python" {
		return `#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal Ether remote sidecar plugin."""

import json
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer


def handle_request(method: str, path: str, headers: dict, body: bytes) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    if path == "/ether/health":
        return 200, {"status": "ok"}
    if path == "/ether/configure":
        return 200, {"errors": {}}
    if path == "/ether/test":
        return 200, {"ok": True, "message": "Connection verified"}
    if path == "/ether/channels.json":
        return 200, {
            "channels": [
                {
                    "id": "ch-1",
                    "number": "101",
                    "name": "Sample Channel",
                    "group": "General",
                    "streams": [{"url": "https://example.org/live/stream.m3u8"}],
                }
            ]
        }
    if path.startswith("/ether/guide/"):
        return 200, {"programmes": []}
    if path.startswith("/stream/"):
        return 200, {"streams": []}
    if path.startswith("/catalog/"):
        return 200, {"metas": []}
    if path == "/ether/subtitles/download":
        if not headers.get("X-Ether-Pick") and not headers.get("x-ether-pick"):
            return 403, {"error": {"code": "pick_required", "message": "Subtitle download requires a viewer pick token"}}
        return 200, {"format": "srt", "encoding": "utf8", "data": ""}
    if path.startswith("/subtitles/"):
        return 200, {"subtitles": []}
    if path == "/ether/event":
        payload = json.loads(body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
        events = payload.get("events", [])
        return 200, {"ack": [e.get("id", "") for e in events if e.get("id")]}
    if path.startswith("/ether/view/"):
        return 200, {
            "spec": {
                "specVersion": 1,
                "layout": "detail",
                "header": [{"kind": "page-header", "title": "$t:pageTitle", "description": "$t:pageDesc"}],
                "body": [{"kind": "stat-tile", "iconKey": "globe", "accent": "teal", "label": "$t:statLabel", "value": {"$": "activeLanguage"}}],
            },
            "data": {"activeLanguage": "en"},
        }
    if path.startswith("/ether/tool/"):
        return 200, {"status": "ok"}
    return 404, {"error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "Route not found"}}


class PluginHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        status, payload = handle_request("GET", self.path.split("?")[0], dict(self.headers), b"")
        self._respond(status, payload)

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        body = self.rfile.read(length) if length > 0 else b""
        status, payload = handle_request("POST", self.path.split("?")[0], dict(self.headers), body)
        self._respond(status, payload)

    def _respond(self, status: int, payload: dict):
        raw = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8787), PluginHandler).serve_forever()
`
	}

	if lang == "js" {
		return `function jsonResponse(status, data) {
  return {
    status: status,
    headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  };
}

function handle(req) {
  const p = req.path || "/";
  if (p === "/ether/health") {
    return jsonResponse(200, { status: "ok" });
  }
  if (p === "/ether/configure") {
    return jsonResponse(200, { errors: {} });
  }
  if (p === "/ether/test") {
    return jsonResponse(200, { ok: true, message: "Ready" });
  }
  if (p === "/ether/channels.json") {
    return jsonResponse(200, {
      channels: [
        {
          id: "ch-1",
          number: "101",
          name: "Sample Channel",
          group: "General",
          streams: [{ url: "https://example.org/live/stream.m3u8" }],
        },
      ],
    });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/guide/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { programmes: [] });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/stream/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { streams: [] });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/catalog/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { metas: [] });
  }
  if (p === "/ether/subtitles/download") {
    const hdrs = req.headers || {};
    const pick = hdrs["X-Ether-Pick"] || hdrs["x-ether-pick"];
    if (!pick) return jsonResponse(403, { error: { code: "pick_required", message: "Subtitle download requires a viewer pick token" } });
    return jsonResponse(200, { format: "srt", encoding: "utf8", data: "" });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/subtitles/") === 0) return jsonResponse(200, { subtitles: [] });
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/markers/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { markers: [] });
  }
  if (p === "/ether/event") {
    let payload = {};
    if (typeof req.body === "string" && req.body.length > 0) {
      payload = JSON.parse(req.body);
    } else if (req.body && typeof req.body === "object") {
      payload = req.body;
    }
    const events = Array.isArray(payload.events) ? payload.events : [];
    return jsonResponse(200, { ack: events.map((e) => e.id) });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/view/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, {
      spec: {
        specVersion: 1,
        layout: "detail",
        header: [
          {
            kind: "page-header",
            title: "$t:pageTitle",
            description: "$t:pageDesc",
          },
        ],
        body: [
          {
            kind: "stat-tile",
            iconKey: "globe",
            accent: "teal",
            label: "$t:statLabel",
            value: { $: "activeLanguage" },
          },
        ],
      },
      data: { activeLanguage: "English" },
    });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/action/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { refresh: true });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/tool/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { status: "ok" });
  }
  if (p.indexOf("/ether/job/") === 0) {
    return jsonResponse(200, { status: "ok" });
  }
  return jsonResponse(404, {
    error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found" },
  });
}

function rank_key(candidate, config) {
  const target = (config && config.preferred) ? String(config.preferred) : "en";
  const langs = Array.isArray(candidate.languages) ? candidate.languages : [];
  return langs.indexOf(target) >= 0 ? 10 : 0;
}

function cond_match(candidate, operator, value) {
  const langs = Array.isArray(candidate.languages) ? candidate.languages : [];
  const has = langs.indexOf(String(value)) >= 0;
  return operator === "is_not" ? !has : has;
}

export function handle(req: PluginRequest): PluginResponse {
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#ParseManifest

``````
// ParseManifest decodes manifest JSON. Unknown fields are ignored (SPEC
// §5.1.1). Call Validate before trusting the result.
func ParseManifest(raw []byte) (Manifest, error) {
	var m Manifest
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err := dec.Decode(&m); err != nil {
		return Manifest{}, fmt.Errorf("plugins: manifest: %w", err)
	}
	return m, nil
}
``````

``````
// UnmarshalJSON completes a Stremio-backed plugin's roles from its
// catalogs and resources wherever a manifest is read: packages, stored
// records and drafts alike.
func (m *Manifest) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	type plain Manifest
	var p plain
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &p); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	*m = Manifest(p)
	if m.Ether != nil && m.Ether.Stremio {
		m.Ether = m.withStremioRoles()
	}
	return nil
}
``````

``````
var (
	idRe       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9]+(\.[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*)+$`)
	keyRe      = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$`)
	toolNameRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}$`)
	hostRe     = regexp.MustCompile(`^(\*\.)?([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?\.)*[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$`)
	bannedRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b(simply|easily|just)\b`)
	// dockerImageRe accepts registry/name:tag or name@sha256:digest, with no
	// spaces or shell metacharacters.
	dockerImageRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/:@-]*$`)
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#LintCopy

``````
// LintCopy checks one user-visible string against the copy rules: at most
// max characters (0 means no limit), no em or en dashes, no exclamation
// marks, no "simply", "just" or "easily", and sentence case. It returns a
// plain reason, or "" when the copy passes. Shared with the kit (WS11).
func LintCopy(s string, max int) string {
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	switch {
	case max > 0 && utf8.RuneCountInString(s) > max:
		return fmt.Sprintf("is longer than %d characters", max)
	case strings.ContainsAny(s, "—–"):
		return "must not contain em or en dashes"
	case strings.Contains(s, "!"):
		return "must not contain exclamation marks"
	case bannedRe.MatchString(s):
		return "must not use the words simply, just or easily"
	}
	for _, r := range s {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
			if unicode.IsLower(r) {
				return "must use sentence case"
			}
			break
		}
	}
	// Reject Title Case: more than two thirds of words capitalised, so one
	// proper noun ("Screenings this Friday") still passes.
	words := strings.Fields(s)
	if len(words) >= 3 {
		caps := 0
		for _, w := range words {
			r, _ := utf8.DecodeRuneInString(w)
			if unicode.IsUpper(r) {
				caps++
			}
		}
		if caps*3 > len(words)*2 {
			return "must use sentence case"
		}
	}
	return ""
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#Manifest.Validate

``````
// Validate checks every field rule in SPEC §5.1.1 and §5.1.3 and the copy
// rules for summary and contribution labels. It returns a
// *ValidationError listing all problems, or nil.
func (m Manifest) Validate() error {
	var f []FieldError
	add := func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) }

	switch {
	case !(idRe.MatchString(m.ID) || (m.Ether == nil && regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)+$`).MatchString(m.ID))):
		add("id", "must be a reverse-DNS id in lower case, such as community.example.plugin")
	case len(m.ID) > 120:
		add("id", "is longer than 120 characters")
	}
	if _, ok := ParseSemVer(m.Version); !ok {
		add("version", "must be a version such as 1.2.0")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(m.Name) == "" {
		add("name", "is required")
	} else if m.Ether != nil && utf8.RuneCountInString(m.Name) > 60 {
		add("name", "is longer than 60 characters")
	}
	if m.Ether != nil && strings.TrimSpace(m.Description) != "" {
		if msg := LintCopy(m.Description, 300); msg != "" {
			add("description", msg)
		}
	}
	if m.Ether == nil {
		if len(f) > 0 {
			return &ValidationError{f}
		}
		return nil
	}
	e := m.Ether
	if e.Protocol != Protocol {
		add("ether.protocol", fmt.Sprintf("this version of Ether speaks plugin protocol %d", Protocol))
	}
	if !knownKinds[e.Kind] {
		add("ether.kind", "must be source, integration, notification_channel, livetv_source, extension or content")
	}
	if e.Kind == "sign_in" {
		add("ether.kind", "sign_in is reserved for a later release")
	}
	seenCap := map[Capability]bool{}
	for i, c := range e.Capabilities {
		field := fmt.Sprintf("ether.capabilities[%d]", i)
		switch {
		case ReservedCapabilities[c]:
			add(field, string(c)+" is reserved for a later release")
		case capabilityKinds[c] == nil && !isAnyKindCap(c):
			add(field, "unknown capability "+strconv.Quote(string(c)))
		case seenCap[c]:
			add(field, "is listed twice")
		default:
			// An add-on-backed plugin's roles come from its Stremio
			// resources, which may combine (a catalogue that also streams).
			if allowed := capabilityKinds[c]; allowed != nil && !allowed[e.Kind] && !e.Stremio {
				add(field, string(c)+" is not allowed for kind "+string(e.Kind))
			}
		}
		seenCap[c] = true
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(e.Summary, "$t:") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(e.Summary) == "" {
			add("ether.summary", "is required")
		} else if msg := LintCopy(e.Summary, 80); msg != "" {
			add("ether.summary", msg)
		}
	}
	if e.Icon != "" && !strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(e.Icon), ".svg") && !strings.HasPrefix(e.Icon, "http") {
		add("ether.icon", "must be an SVG file")
	}
	if len(e.Contributes.Looks) > 0 && !m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) {
		add("ether.capabilities", "livetv_pack is required for style contributions")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) && e.Runtime.Kind != "data" {
		add("ether.runtime.kind", "style packs require the data runtime")
	}
	switch e.Runtime.Kind {
	case "data":
		if e.Kind != KindExtension || len(e.Capabilities) != 1 || !m.HasCapability(CapLiveTVPack) || len(e.Contributes.Looks) != 1 {
			add("ether.contributes.looks", "a data package must contribute exactly one style")
		}
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" || e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "data packages run no code")
		}
		c := e.Contributes
		c.Looks = nil
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c)
		if string(raw) != "{}" {
			add("ether.contributes", "data packages may contribute only styles")
		}
		permissions, _ := json.Marshal(e.Permissions)
		empty, _ := json.Marshal(Permissions{})
		if string(permissions) != string(empty) || len(e.Schedule) > 0 {
			add("ether.permissions", "data packages require no permissions or schedules")
		}
		for _, look := range e.Contributes.Looks {
			if look.ID == "" || look.File == "" || unsafePath(look.File) {
				add("ether.contributes.looks", "style files must stay inside the package")
			}
		}

	case "hosted":
		if e.Runtime.Entry == "" && e.Runtime.Module == "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "a hosted plugin needs an entry or module file")
		}
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" && e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "give either entry or module, not both")
		}
		for _, p := range []string{e.Runtime.Entry, e.Runtime.Module} {
			if unsafePath(p) {
				add("ether.runtime", "file paths must stay inside the package")
			}
		}
	case "remote":
		if e.Runtime.Entry != "" || e.Runtime.Module != "" {
			add("ether.runtime", "a remote plugin has no entry or module file")
		}
	default:
		add("ether.runtime.kind", "must be hosted, remote or data")
	}
	if l := e.Runtime.Limits; l != nil {
		if e.Runtime.Kind != "hosted" {
			add("ether.runtime.limits", "only hosted plugins can request runtime limits")
		}
		if l.Deadline != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(l.Deadline); err != nil || d <= 0 {
				add("ether.runtime.limits.deadline", "must be a positive duration such as 120s")
			}
		}
		if l.FetchBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveMemberBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveExpandedBytes < 0 || l.ArchiveMembers < 0 {
			add("ether.runtime.limits", "data ceilings must not be negative")
		}
		if l.UnitBudget < 0 {
			add("ether.runtime.limits.unitBudget", "must not be negative")
		}
	}
	validateSidecar(e, add)
	if e.Cluster != "" && e.Cluster != "leader" && e.Cluster != "every_node" {
		add("ether.cluster", "must be leader or every_node")
	}
	if e.Health.Interval != "" {
		d, err := time.ParseDuration(e.Health.Interval)
		if err != nil || d < 15*time.Second {
			add("ether.health.interval", "must be a duration of at least 15s")
		}
	}
	for i, s := range e.Schedule {
		field := fmt.Sprintf("ether.schedule[%d]", i)
		d, err := time.ParseDuration(s.Every)
		if err != nil || d < 15*time.Minute {
			add(field+".every", "must be a duration of at least 15m")
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(s.Call, "/") {
			add(field+".call", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
	validatePermissions(e.Permissions, add)
	if normLevel(e.Permissions.Sources) != "none" && !m.HasCapability(CapKindResolver) {
		add("ether.permissions.sources", "needs the kind_resolver capability")
	}
	validateSettings(e.Settings, add)
	usesT := strings.HasPrefix(e.Summary, "$t:") || contributesUseT(e.Contributes)
	if usesT {
		if _, ok := e.Strings["en"]; !ok {
			add("ether.strings", "an en strings file is required when $t: keys are used")
		}
	}
	validateContributes(m, add)
	validateOnAir(m, add)
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSidecar

``````
// validateSidecar checks the ether.sidecar block. It is additive and only
// meaningful for a remote runtime: a hosted plugin cannot ship one.
func validateSidecar(e *EtherBlock, add func(string, string)) {
	if e.Sidecar == nil {
		return
	}
	if e.Runtime.Kind != "remote" {
		add("ether.sidecar", "only a remote plugin has a sidecar block")
	}
	s := e.Sidecar
	if s.Docker != "" {
		if len(s.Docker) > 255 || !dockerImageRe.MatchString(s.Docker) || strings.Contains(s.Docker, "..") {
			add("ether.sidecar.docker", "must be an image reference such as registry/name:tag")
		}
	}
	if s.Download != "" && !isHTTPSURL(s.Download) {
		add("ether.sidecar.download", "must be an https URL")
	}
	if s.Docs != "" && !isHTTPSURL(s.Docs) {
		add("ether.sidecar.docs", "must be an https URL")
	}
	if s.Command != "" {
		if strings.ContainsAny(s.Command, "\r\n") || len(s.Command) > 200 {
			add("ether.sidecar.command", "must be a single line of at most 200 characters")
		}
	}
	// A download with no way to start it is not usable.
	if s.Download != "" && s.Command == "" {
		add("ether.sidecar.command", "is required when a download is given")
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validatePermissions

``````
func validatePermissions(p Permissions, add func(string, string)) {
	for i, h := range p.Network {
		if !hostRe.MatchString(strings.ToLower(h)) || strings.Contains(h, "://") {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("ether.permissions.network[%d]", i), "must be a host name, with a wildcard only as *.example.com")
		}
	}
	level := func(field, v string, allowed ...string) {
		for _, a := range allowed {
			if v == a {
				return
			}
		}
		add(field, "must be one of "+strings.Join(allowed, ", "))
	}
	level("ether.permissions.catalog", normLevel(p.Catalog), "none", "read")
	level("ether.permissions.collections", normLevel(p.Collections), "none", "write")
	level("ether.permissions.folders", normLevel(p.Folders), "none", "read")
	level("ether.permissions.sources", normLevel(p.Sources), "none", "search", "acquire")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.identity", normLevel(p.Viewers.Identity), "none", "granted_viewers", "all")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.watch_history", normLevel(p.Viewers.WatchHistory), "none", "granted_viewers", "all")
	level("ether.permissions.viewers.write_watch_state", normLevel(p.Viewers.WriteWatchState), "none", "granted_viewers")
	for i, s := range p.Secrets {
		if !keyRe.MatchString(s) {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("ether.permissions.secrets[%d]", i), "must be a simple name")
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#validateSettings

``````
// validateSettings checks the settings schema shape (SPEC §5.5). A $ref is
// validated again after resolution at install.
func validateSettings(raw json.RawMessage, add func(string, string)) {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return
	}
	var doc map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		add("ether.settings", "must be a JSON object")
		return
	}
	if ref, ok := doc["$ref"].(string); ok {
		if unsafePath(ref) || ref == "" {
			add("ether.settings.$ref", "must name a file inside the package")
		}
		return
	}
	lintSettingsNode(doc, "ether.settings", add)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#LintSettingsSchema

``````
// LintSettingsSchema validates a resolved settings schema document
// (SPEC §5.5 copy rules). Shared with the kit.
func LintSettingsSchema(raw json.RawMessage) error {
	var f []FieldError
	validateSettings(raw, func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) })
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#lintSettingsNode

``````
func lintSettingsNode(node any, path string, add func(string, string)) {
	switch n := node.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if k, ok := n["kind"].(string); ok {
			if k == "json" {
				add(path+".kind", "the json field kind is not allowed in plugin settings")
			} else if !settingKinds[k] {
				add(path+".kind", "unknown field kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
			}
		}
		if label, ok := n["label"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(label, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(label, 40); msg != "" {
				add(path+".label", msg)
			}
		}
		if hint, ok := n["hint"].(string); ok && !strings.HasPrefix(hint, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(hint, 120); msg != "" {
				add(path+".hint", msg)
			}
			if strings.Count(strings.TrimRight(hint, "."), ".") > 0 {
				add(path+".hint", "must be one sentence")
			}
		}
		for key, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, path+"."+key, add)
		}
	case []any:
		for i, v := range n {
			lintSettingsNode(v, fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", path, i), add)
		}
	}
}
``````

``````
func contributesUseT(c Contributes) bool {
	any := false
	check := func(s string) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			any = true
		}
	}
	for _, x := range c.ListSources {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RankingSteps {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.RuleConditions {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Tools {
		check(x.Title)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Pages {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Slots {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	for _, x := range c.Commands {
		check(x.Label)
	}
	if c.Integration != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
			check(s)
		}
	}
	for _, k := range c.MediaKinds {
		check(k.Label)
		check(k.Library.Name)
		for _, lv := range k.Levels {
			check(lv.Label)
		}
		for _, f := range k.Fields {
			check(f.Label)
		}
		for _, a := range k.Art {
			check(a.Label)
		}
	}
	for _, a := range c.FrontendAdapters {
		check(a.Label)
	}
	if c.Setup != nil {
		for _, s := range c.Setup.Steps {
			check(s.Label)
			check(s.Hint)
		}
	}
	return any
}
``````

``````
func validateContributes(m Manifest, add func(string, string)) {
	e := m.Ether
	c := e.Contributes
	hosted := e.Runtime.Kind == "hosted"
	label := func(field, s string, max int) {
		if strings.HasPrefix(s, "$t:") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "$t:")) {
				add(field, "must name a string key after $t:")
			}
			return
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" {
			add(field, "is required")
		} else if msg := LintCopy(s, max); msg != "" && !e.Stremio {
			// Labels an add-on brings (its catalogue names) are its own
			// words; Ether shows them as the add-on wrote them.
			add(field, msg)
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapStreamSource) {
		if c.Source == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.source", "is required for stream_source")
		} else if !map[string]bool{"debrid": true, "usenet": true, "indexer": true, "direct": true}[c.Source.Class] {
			add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid, usenet, indexer or direct")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapDebridProvider) && (c.Source == nil || c.Source.Class != "debrid") {
		add("ether.contributes.source.class", "must be debrid for debrid_provider")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapLiveTV) {
		if c.Channels == nil || !c.Channels.Test {
			add("ether.contributes.channels", "is required for livetv_channels, with test set")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapPluginDirectory) && len(c.Directories) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.directories", "is required for plugin_directory")
	}
	seenDirectories := map[string]bool{}
	for i, d := range c.Directories {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.directories[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(d.Key) || seenDirectories[d.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique simple key")
		}
		seenDirectories[d.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", d.Label, 80)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMetadata) {
		if c.Metadata == nil || len(c.Metadata.Types) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "is required for metadata")
		} else {
			for _, typ := range c.Metadata.Types {
				if typ != "movie" && typ != "show" {
					add("ether.contributes.metadata.types", "must contain movie or show")
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapSubtitles) && c.Subtitles == nil {
		add("ether.contributes.subtitles", "is required for subtitles")
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapMarkers) {
		if c.Markers == nil || len(c.Markers.Kinds) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "is required for markers")
		} else {
			for _, k := range c.Markers.Kinds {
				if !map[string]bool{"intro": true, "credits": true, "recap": true, "preview": true}[k] {
					add("ether.contributes.markers.kinds", "unknown marker kind "+strconv.Quote(k))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapNotify) {
		if c.Notification == nil || !c.Notification.SendTest {
			add("ether.contributes.notification", "is required for notify, with sendTest set")
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapEvents) {
		if c.Events == nil || len(c.Events.Subscribe) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.events.subscribe", "is required for events")
		} else {
			for _, n := range c.Events.Subscribe {
				if !KnownEvents[n] {
					add("ether.contributes.events.subscribe", "unknown event "+strconv.Quote(n))
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapListSource) && len(c.ListSources) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.listSources", "is required for list_source")
	}
	for i, ls := range c.ListSources {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.listSources[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(ls.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", ls.Label, 40)
		if ls.Catalog == "" {
			add(base+".catalog", "is required")
		}
		if ls.MaxItems < 0 || ls.MaxItems > 2000 {
			add(base+".maxItems", "must be at most 2000")
		}
		if ls.Refresh != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(ls.Refresh); err != nil || d < time.Hour {
				add(base+".refresh", "must be a duration of at least 1h")
			}
		}
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapRankingStep) {
		if !hosted {
			add("ether.capabilities", "ranking_step needs the hosted runtime")
		}
		if len(c.RankingSteps) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.rankingSteps", "is required for ranking_step")
		}
	}
	for i, rs := range c.RankingSteps {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.rankingSteps[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(rs.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", rs.Label, 40)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapRuleCondition) {
		if !hosted {
			add("ether.capabilities", "rule_condition needs the hosted runtime")
		}
		if len(c.RuleConditions) == 0 {
			add("ether.contributes.ruleConditions", "is required for rule_condition")
		}
	}
	for i, rc := range c.RuleConditions {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.ruleConditions[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(rc.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", rc.Label, 40)
	}
	if m.HasCapability(CapTools) && len(c.Tools) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.tools", "is required for tools")
	}
	for i, tl := range c.Tools {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.tools[%d]", i)
		if !toolNameRe.MatchString(tl.Name) {
			add(base+".name", "must be snake_case")
		}
		label(base+".title", tl.Title, 60)
		if strings.TrimSpace(tl.Description) == "" {
			add(base+".description", "is required")
		}
		var schema map[string]any
		if len(tl.InputSchema) == 0 || json.Unmarshal(tl.InputSchema, &schema) != nil || schema["type"] != "object" {
			add(base+".inputSchema", "must be a JSON object schema")
		}
		if tl.ReadOnly && tl.Destructive {
			add(base, "a tool cannot be both read-only and destructive")
		}
	}
	for i, pg := range c.Pages {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.pages[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(pg.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", pg.Label, 40)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(pg.Route, "/") {
			add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
	for i, sl := range c.Slots {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.slots[%d]", i)
		if !knownSlots[sl.Slot] {
			add(base+".slot", "unknown slot "+strconv.Quote(sl.Slot))
		}
		label(base+".label", sl.Label, 40)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(sl.Slot, "actionMenu.") {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(sl.Action) {
				add(base+".action", "must be a simple action name")
			}
			if sl.Route != "" {
				add(base+".route", "action slots use an action instead of a route")
			}
		} else {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(sl.Route, "/") {
				add(base+".route", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
			}
			if sl.Action != "" {
				add(base+".action", "view slots use a route instead of an action")
			}
		}
	}
	for i, cm := range c.Commands {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.commands[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(cm.Key) {
			add(base+".key", "must be a simple key")
		}
		label(base+".label", cm.Label, 40)
		if cm.Action == "" {
			add(base+".action", "is required")
		}
	}
	validateMediaKinds(m, add, label)
	validateFrontendAdapters(m, add, label)
	validateSetup(e, add, label)
	if e.Kind == KindIntegration {
		if c.Integration == nil {
			add("ether.contributes.integration", "is required for the integration kind")
		} else {
			if c.Integration.Category == "" {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.category", "is required")
			}
			if len(c.Integration.Adds) < 1 || len(c.Integration.Adds) > 4 {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.adds", "must list one to four things the plugin adds")
			}
			for i, s := range c.Integration.Adds {
				label(fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.integration.adds[%d]", i), s, 80)
			}
			if !map[string]bool{"fields": true, "device_code": true, "none": true}[c.Integration.Connect] {
				add("ether.contributes.integration.connect", "must be fields, device_code or none")
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#ParseSemVer

``````
// ParseSemVer parses a plain major.minor.patch version.
func ParseSemVer(v string) ([3]int, bool) {
	var out [3]int
	v = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(v), "v")
	if i := strings.IndexAny(v, "-+"); i >= 0 {
		v = v[:i]
	}
	parts := strings.Split(v, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		return out, false
	}
	for i, p := range parts {
		n, err := strconv.Atoi(p)
		if err != nil || n < 0 {
			return out, false
		}
		out[i] = n
	}
	return out, true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest.go#CompareSemVer

``````
// CompareSemVer returns -1, 0 or 1. Unparseable versions compare equal to 0.
func CompareSemVer(a, b string) int {
	va, _ := ParseSemVer(a)
	vb, _ := ParseSemVer(b)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		if va[i] != vb[i] {
			if va[i] < vb[i] {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
	}
	// A release sorts after any prerelease of the same core version.
	pre := func(v string) string {
		v, _, _ = strings.Cut(v, "+")
		_, p, _ := strings.Cut(v, "-")
		return p
	}
	pa, pb := pre(a), pre(b)
	if pa == pb {
		return 0
	}
	if pa == "" {
		return 1
	}
	if pb == "" {
		return -1
	}
	as, bs := strings.Split(pa, "."), strings.Split(pb, ".")
	for i := 0; i < len(as) && i < len(bs); i++ {
		x, y := as[i], bs[i]
		if x == y {
			continue
		}
		isNumeric := func(s string) bool {
			if s == "" {
				return false
			}
			for _, c := range s {
				if c < '0' || c > '9' {
					return false
				}
			}
			return true
		}
		xn, yn := isNumeric(x), isNumeric(y)
		if xn != yn {
			if xn {
				return -1
			}
			return 1
		}
		if xn {
			x, y = strings.TrimLeft(x, "0"), strings.TrimLeft(y, "0")
			if len(x) < len(y) {
				return -1
			}
			if len(x) > len(y) {
				return 1
			}
		}
		if x < y {
			return -1
		}
		if x > y {
			return 1
		}
	}
	if len(as) < len(bs) {
		return -1
	}
	if len(as) > len(bs) {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
``````

``````
func validateMediaKinds(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	e := m.Ether
	kinds := e.Contributes.MediaKinds
	hasProvider := m.HasCapability(CapCatalogProvider)
	hasResolver := m.HasCapability(CapKindResolver)
	if e.Kind == KindContent && !hasProvider && !hasResolver {
		add("ether.capabilities", "a content plugin needs catalog_provider or kind_resolver")
	}
	if (hasProvider || hasResolver) && len(kinds) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "is required for catalog_provider and kind_resolver")
	}
	if !hasProvider && !hasResolver && len(kinds) > 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.mediaKinds", "needs the catalog_provider or kind_resolver capability")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, k := range kinds {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.mediaKinds[%d]", i)
		validateMediaKind(m, k, base, hasProvider, add, label)
		if seen[k.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		seen[k.Key] = true
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateMediaKind

``````
func validateMediaKind(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, hasProvider bool, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(k.Key) {
		add(base+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
	}
	label(base+".label", k.Label, 60)
	if k.Library != (KindLibraryDecl{}) {
		label(base+".library.name", k.Library.Name, 60)
		if unsafePath(k.Library.Icon) {
			add(base+".library.icon", "must stay inside the package")
		}
	}

	if len(k.Levels) < 1 || len(k.Levels) > 5 {
		add(base+".levels", "must declare one to five levels")
	}
	levelKeys := map[string]bool{}
	playable := false
	for j, lv := range k.Levels {
		lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, j)
		if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(lv.Key) {
			add(lbase+".key", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		}
		if levelKeys[lv.Key] {
			add(lbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		levelKeys[lv.Key] = true
		label(lbase+".label", lv.Label, 40)
		if lv.Playable {
			playable = true
		}
	}
	if len(k.Levels) > 0 && !playable {
		add(base+".levels", "at least one level must be playable")
	}

	fields := map[string]KindField{}
	for j, f := range k.Fields {
		fbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindFieldRe.MatchString(f.Key):
			add(fbase+".key", "must start with a lower case letter and use letters, digits and underscores, at most 40 characters")
		case kindEnvelopeKeys[f.Key]:
			add(fbase+".key", "collides with an item envelope key")
		case fields[f.Key].Key != "":
			add(fbase+".key", "is listed twice")
		}
		fields[f.Key] = f
		if !kindFieldTypes[f.Type] {
			add(fbase+".type", "must be string, int, float, bool, date, duration, enum, strings or people")
		}
		label(fbase+".label", f.Label, 40)
		if f.Type == "enum" {
			if len(f.Enum) == 0 {
				add(fbase+".enum", "an enum field needs at least one value")
			}
			seenEnum := map[string]bool{}
			for _, v := range f.Enum {
				if strings.TrimSpace(v) == "" || seenEnum[v] {
					add(fbase+".enum", "values must be non-empty and listed once")
					break
				}
				seenEnum[v] = true
			}
		} else if len(f.Enum) > 0 {
			add(fbase+".enum", "only enum fields list values")
		}
	}

	seenArt := map[string]bool{}
	for j, a := range k.Art {
		abase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.art[%d]", base, j)
		switch {
		case !kindArtRe.MatchString(a.Role):
			add(abase+".role", "must be lower case letters, digits and dashes, at most 32 characters")
		case BuiltinKindArtRoles[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is a built-in role and needs no declaration")
		case seenArt[a.Role]:
			add(abase+".role", "is listed twice")
		}
		seenArt[a.Role] = true
		label(abase+".label", a.Label, 40)
	}

	validatePresentations(m, k, base+".present", levelKeys, add)

	seenSort := map[string]bool{}
	for j, s := range k.Browse.Sorts {
		if !kindSorts[s] || seenSort[s] {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.sorts[%d]", base, j), "must be title, added, released, year, rating or index, listed once")
		}
		seenSort[s] = true
	}
	for j, f := range k.Browse.Facets {
		if f == "year" || f == "released" || f == "rating" {
			continue
		}
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if !field.Indexed {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.facets[%d]", base, j), "a facet field must be indexed")
		}
	}
	for j, f := range k.Browse.SearchFields {
		field, ok := fields[f]
		if !ok {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared field")
		} else if field.Type != "string" && field.Type != "strings" && field.Type != "people" {
			add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.browse.searchFields[%d]", base, j), "a search field must hold text")
		}
	}
	if len(k.Browse.SearchFields) > 0 && !k.Browse.Search {
		add(base+".browse.search", "searchFields need search to be set")
	}
	if k.Browse.LiveSearch && !hasProvider {
		add(base+".browse.liveSearch", "live search needs the catalog_provider capability")
	}

	switch k.Sync.Mode {
	case "":
		if hasProvider && k.HasLibrary() {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "a catalog provider kind must be pull or push")
		}
	case KindSyncPull, KindSyncPush:
		if !hasProvider {
			add(base+".sync.mode", "sync needs the catalog_provider capability")
		}
	case "ondemand":
		add(base+".sync.mode", "ondemand is not supported; kinds sync with pull or push")
	default:
		add(base+".sync.mode", "must be pull or push")
	}
	if k.Sync.Refresh != "" {
		if k.Sync.Mode != KindSyncPull {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "only pull kinds refresh on a schedule")
		} else if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Sync.Refresh); err != nil || d < 15*time.Minute {
			add(base+".sync.refresh", "must be a duration of at least 15m")
		}
	}
	if k.Cache.MaxBytes < 0 {
		add(base+".cache.maxBytes", "must not be negative")
	}
	if k.Cache.TTL != "" {
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(k.Cache.TTL); err != nil || d <= 0 {
			add(base+".cache.ttl", "must be a positive duration")
		}
	}
	if k.Match.ThresholdDefault < 0 || k.Match.ThresholdDefault > 1 {
		add(base+".match.thresholdDefault", "must be between 0 and 1")
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validatePresentations

``````
func validatePresentations(m Manifest, k MediaKindMeta, base string, levelKeys map[string]bool, add func(string, string)) {
	p := k.Present
	protocols := 0
	if p.Plex != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.Silo != nil {
		protocols++
	}
	if p.AdapterOnly {
		if protocols > 0 {
			add(base, "adapterOnly cannot be combined with a protocol presentation")
		}
		if !m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) {
			add(base+".adapterOnly", "needs a frontend adapter")
		}
		return
	}
	if protocols == 0 {
		if k.HasLibrary() {
			add(base, "declare at least one protocol presentation, or adapterOnly with a frontend adapter")
		}
		return
	}
	levels := len(k.Levels)
	if p.Plex != nil {
		switch p.Plex.Base {
		case "movie", "photo":
		case "show", "artist":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".plex.base", p.Plex.Base+" needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".plex.base", "must be movie, show, artist or photo")
		}
	}
	if p.MediaBrowser != nil {
		if !mediaBrowserCollectionTypes[p.MediaBrowser.CollectionType] {
			add(base+".mediaBrowser.collectionType", "must be movies, tvshows, music, audiobooks, books, photos or homevideos")
		}
		for level, itemType := range p.MediaBrowser.ItemTypes {
			if !levelKeys[level] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown level "+level)
			}
			if !mediaBrowserItemTypes[itemType] {
				add(base+".mediaBrowser.itemTypes", "unknown item type "+itemType)
			}
		}
	}
	if p.Stremio != nil {
		switch p.Stremio.Type {
		case "movie", "channel", "tv":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".stremio.type", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".stremio.type", "must be movie, series, channel or tv")
		}
	}
	if p.Xtream != nil {
		switch p.Xtream.Category {
		case "movie", "live":
		case "series":
			if levels < 2 {
				add(base+".xtream.category", "series needs at least two levels")
			}
		default:
			add(base+".xtream.category", "must be movie, series or live")
		}
	}
	if p.Silo != nil && !mediaBrowserItemTypes[p.Silo.Type] {
		add(base+".silo.type", "must be a MediaBrowser item type such as Movie or Series")
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#validateFrontendAdapters

``````
func validateFrontendAdapters(m Manifest, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	adapters := m.Ether.Contributes.FrontendAdapters
	if m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) && len(adapters) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters", "is required for frontend_adapter")
	}
	if !m.HasCapability(CapFrontendAdapter) && len(adapters) > 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters", "needs the frontend_adapter capability")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, a := range adapters {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.frontendAdapters[%d]", i)
		if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(a.Key) || seen[a.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique lower case key, at most 32 characters")
		}
		seen[a.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", a.Label, 60)
		if !map[string]bool{"opds": true, "subsonic": true, "custom": true}[a.ProtocolHint] {
			add(base+".protocolHint", "must be opds, subsonic or custom")
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(a.PathPrefix, "/") || a.PathPrefix == "/" {
			add(base+".pathPrefix", "must be a path below the shared listener root, such as /opds")
		}
		if a.DefaultPort < 0 || a.DefaultPort > 65535 {
			add(base+".defaultPort", "must be a port number")
		}
		if a.Auth != "" && !map[string]bool{"ether_token": true, "basic": true, "none_lan": true}[a.Auth] {
			add(base+".auth", "must be ether_token, basic or none_lan")
		}
		seenLib := map[string]bool{}
		for j, key := range a.Libraries {
			if !kindKeyRe.MatchString(key) || seenLib[key] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.libraries[%d]", base, j), "must name a declared media kind key")
			}
			seenLib[key] = true
			if _, ok := m.MediaKindByKey(key); !ok {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.libraries[%d]", base, j), "must name a media kind declared by this plugin")
			}
		}
	}
}
``````

``````
// MediaKindByKey returns the declared kind with this key, if any.
func (m Manifest) MediaKindByKey(key string) (MediaKindMeta, bool) {
	if e := m.EffectiveEther(); e != nil {
		for _, k := range e.Contributes.MediaKinds {
			if k.Key == key {
				return k, true
			}
		}
	}
	return MediaKindMeta{}, false
}
``````

``````
// HasLibrary reports whether this media kind declares a library block.
// Creating a library is optional per kind: a kind without a library block
// (for example, a resolver-only kind) creates no library.
func (k MediaKindMeta) HasLibrary() bool {
	return strings.TrimSpace(k.Library.Name) != ""
}
``````

``````
// Level returns the declared level with this key and its position.
func (k MediaKindMeta) Level(key string) (KindLevel, int, bool) {
	for i, lv := range k.Levels {
		if lv.Key == key {

		}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#MediaKindMeta.DeclHash

``````
// DeclHash is the upgrade gate for an installed kind (spec §2.3/§2.5):
// the SHA-256 of the declaration's canonical JSON. Go marshals struct
// fields in declaration order and map keys sorted, so equal
// declarations always hash equal.
func (k MediaKindMeta) DeclHash() string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(k)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/manifest_kinds.go#ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade

``````
// ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade applies the additive-only upgrade rule
// (spec §2.5): a new manifest may add kinds, fields, trailing levels
// and art roles, and may change labels, presentations, browse, cache
// and match defaults, but it may not drop or rename a kind, drop or
// retype a field, shrink an enum, drop a field's index, or remove,
// reorder or re-flag a level. A caller that gets an error refuses the
// upgrade unless the owner chose to replace the library contents.
func ValidateMediaKindsUpgrade(prev, next []MediaKindMeta) error {
	var f []FieldError
	add := func(field, msg string) { f = append(f, FieldError{field, msg}) }
	nextByKey := map[string]MediaKindMeta{}
	for _, k := range next {
		nextByKey[k.Key] = k
	}
	for _, old := range prev {
		base := "ether.contributes.mediaKinds." + old.Key
		nk, ok := nextByKey[old.Key]
		if !ok {
			add(base, "kind was removed; removing a kind needs the owner to replace its library")
			continue
		}
		for i, lv := range old.Levels {
			lbase := fmt.Sprintf("%s.levels[%d]", base, i)
			if i >= len(nk.Levels) {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" was removed")
				continue
			}
			nl := nk.Levels[i]
			if nl.Key != lv.Key {
				add(lbase+".key", "levels cannot be removed or reordered; add new levels at the end")
			}
			if nl.Playable != lv.Playable || nl.Container != lv.Container {
				add(lbase, "level "+lv.Key+" changed its playable or container flag")
			}
		}
		nextFields := map[string]KindField{}
		for _, nf := range nk.Fields {
			nextFields[nf.Key] = nf
		}
		for _, of := range old.Fields {
			fbase := base + ".fields." + of.Key
			nf, ok := nextFields[of.Key]
			if !ok {
				add(fbase, "field was removed")
				continue
			}
			if nf.Type != of.Type {
				add(fbase+".type", "field changed type from "+of.Type+" to "+nf.Type)
			}
			if of.Indexed && !nf.Indexed {
				add(fbase+".indexed", "field lost its index")
			}
			if of.Type == "enum" && nf.Type == "enum" {
				have := map[string]bool{}
				for _, v := range nf.Enum {
					have[v] = true
				}
				for _, v := range of.Enum {
					if !have[v] {
						add(fbase+".enum", "enum value "+v+" was removed")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(f) > 0 {
		return &ValidationError{f}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#Host

``````
// Host is the set of Ether services a remote plugin may call back
// into (SPEC §5.1.5). It mirrors plugins.Host method for method for
// the services remote plugins may use; secret.get is hosted-only and
// deliberately absent (remote plugins receive secrets in
// /ether/configure). Every method is expected to re-check the
// plugin's live grants and return ErrPermissionDenied when a grant
// is missing or revoked.
type Host interface {
	KVGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) ([]byte, bool, error)
	KVPut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string, value []byte) error
	KVDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, key string) error
	KVList(ctx context.Context, pluginID, prefix string) ([]string, error)

	CatalogSearch(ctx context.Context, pluginID, query string, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	CatalogGet(ctx context.Context, pluginID, id string) (json.RawMessage, error)

	ViewerGranted(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (json.RawMessage, error)
	ViewerHistory(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, limit, offset int) (json.RawMessage, error)
	SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error

	CollectionsUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, collection json.RawMessage) error

	KindUpsert(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, items []core.KindItem) (int, error)
	KindDelete(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error
	KindItems(ctx context.Context, pluginID, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (core.KindPage, error)
	ResolveSources(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, q core.SourceQuery) ([]core.SourceCandidate, error)
	CachePut(ctx context.Context, pluginID, libraryKey, name string, r io.Reader) (string, error)
	CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, pluginID, blobRef string) (io.ReadSeekCloser, error)

	// StreamURL mints a scoped stream ticket for one of the plugin's own
	// kind items for viewerID and returns the Ether stream URL (spec §6.5).
	StreamURL(ctx context.Context, pluginID string, viewerID int64, itemRef string) (string, error)

	Settings(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) (map[string]any, error)

	NotifyOwner(ctx context.Context, pluginID, text string) error
	Log(ctx context.Context, pluginID, level, msg string, attrs map[string]any) error
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#HostHandler

``````
// HostHandler serves /ether/plugin-host/* for remote plugins. Every
// request is authenticated with a plugin credential; the resolved
// plugin id is the only identity a call can act as, so a plugin can
// never name another plugin in a request body and be believed.
type HostHandler struct {
	host Host
	auth CredentialResolver
	log  *slog.Logger
	mux  *http.ServeMux
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#NewHostHandler

``````
// NewHostHandler builds the plugin-host API. Mount the result at
// HostPath (or use Mount to register it on a mux).
func NewHostHandler(opts HostOptions) *HostHandler {
	h := &HostHandler{host: opts.Host, auth: opts.Auth, log: opts.Logger}
	if h.log == nil {
		h.log = slog.Default()
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/data/{service}", h.dataCall)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kv", h.kvList)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvGet)
	mux.HandleFunc("PUT /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvPut)
	mux.HandleFunc("DELETE /ether/plugin-host/kv/{key...}", h.kvDelete)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/catalog/search", h.catalogSearch)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/catalog/{id...}", h.catalogGet)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/viewers/{viewerId}/history", h.viewerHistory)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/viewers/granted", h.viewerGranted)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/viewers/watch-state", h.setWatchState)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/collections/upsert", h.collectionsUpsert)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/items", h.kindItems)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/upsert", h.kindUpsert)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/kinds/{kind}/delete", h.kindDelete)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/sources/resolve", h.resolveSources)
	mux.HandleFunc("PUT /ether/plugin-host/cache/{libraryKey}/{name...}", h.cachePut)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/cache/{libraryKey}", h.cachePut)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/cache/{blobRef...}", h.cacheOpen)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/frontend/stream-url", h.frontendStreamURL)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /ether/plugin-host/settings", h.settings)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/notify", h.notify)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /ether/plugin-host/log", h.logLine)
	h.mux = mux
	return h
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.ServeHTTP

``````
func (h *HostHandler) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if h.auth == nil || h.host == nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Plugin host API is not configured")
		return
	}
	pluginID, err := h.auth.ResolvePluginCredential(r.Context(), credentialFromRequest(r))
	if err != nil || pluginID == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
		return
	}
	r = r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), pluginIDContextKey{}, pluginID))
	h.mux.ServeHTTP(w, r)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kvGet

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvGet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	value, ok, err := h.host.KVGet(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "No value for this key")
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"key": key, "value": string(value)})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kvPut

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kvPut(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	key := r.PathValue("key")
	var body struct {
		Value *string `json:"value"`
	}
	// Accept either {"value": "..."} or a raw text body: the SDKs send
	// JSON, hand-rolled sidecars often send the bare value.
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKVValueBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	value := raw
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"), "application/json") {
		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &body); err != nil || body.Value == nil {
			writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"value": "..."}`)
			return
		}
		value = []byte(*body.Value)
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.KVPut(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), key, value)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

``````
func (h *HostHandler) setWatchState(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var body struct {
		ViewerID int64  `json:"viewerId"`
		TitleID  string `json:"titleId"`
		Watched  bool   `json:"watched"`
	}
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &body) {
		return
	}
	if body.ViewerID <= 0 || body.TitleID == "" {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", "viewerId and titleId are required")
		return
	}
	if !h.finishErr(w, h.host.SetWatchState(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), body.ViewerID, body.TitleID, body.Watched)) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true})
}
``````

``````
func (h *HostHandler) collectionsUpsert(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.kindUpsert

``````
func (h *HostHandler) kindUpsert(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, maxKindUpsertBytes)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return
	}
	var items []core.KindItem
	var envelope struct {
		Items []core.KindItem `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &envelope); err == nil && envelope.Items != nil {
		items = envelope.Items
	} else if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &items); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", `Body must be {"items": [...]} or a JSON array of KindItem`)
		return
	}
	accepted, err := h.host.KindUpsert(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("kind"), items)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"ok": true, "accepted": accepted})
}
``````

``````
func (h *HostHandler) writeRaw(w http.ResponseWriter, out json.RawMessage, err error) {
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		out = json.RawMessage("null")
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_, _ = w.Write(out)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.decode

``````
func (h *HostHandler) decode(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64, into any) bool {
	raw, err := readBody(w, r, max)
	if err != nil {
		h.finishErr(w, err)
		return false
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, into); err != nil {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", "Body is not valid JSON")
		return false
	}
	return true
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#*HostHandler.finishErr

``````
// finishErr maps a host error onto the EPP error shape and reports
// whether the handler may continue. Host errors are mapped, never
// echoed raw: a storage error must not leak SQL or paths to a
// plugin.
func (h *HostHandler) finishErr(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) bool {
	if err == nil {
		return true
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, ErrPermissionDenied):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "permission_denied", "This plugin does not have the grant this call needs")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "Not found")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrTooLarge):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusRequestEntityTooLarge, "too_large", "Request body is too large")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalid):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid", cleanMessage(err))
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnavailable):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "This host service is not available")
	case errors.Is(err, ErrUnauthorized):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized", "Plugin credential rejected")
	case errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusGatewayTimeout, "deadline", "The call ran past its deadline")
	default:
		h.log.Warn("plugin host call failed", "err", err)
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "error", "The host call failed")
	}
	return false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#cleanMessage

``````
// cleanMessage strips the sentinel prefix from an ErrInvalid so the
// plugin sees the specific reason ("path escapes...") only.
func cleanMessage(err error) string {
	msg := err.Error()
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request: ")
	msg = strings.TrimPrefix(msg, "remote: invalid request")
	if msg == "" {
		return "The request is not valid"
	}
	return msg
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#pageParams

``````
// pageParams reads limit/offset, or page/pageSize, clamped.
func pageParams(r *http.Request) (limit, offset int) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	limit = defaultPageLimit
	if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("limit")); err == nil && v > 0 {
		limit = v
	}
	if v, err := paging.ParseOffset(q.Get("offset"), limit); err == nil && v >= 0 {
		offset = v
	}
	if q.Get("page") != "" {
		pageSize := limit
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("pageSize")); err == nil && v > 0 {
			pageSize = v
		}
		if v, err := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("page")); err == nil && v >= 1 {
			limit = pageSize
			offset = paging.PageOffset(v, pageSize)
		}
	}
	if limit > maxPageLimit {
		limit = maxPageLimit
	}
	return limit, offset
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/remote/host.go#readBody

``````
func readBody(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, max int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if r.Body == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, max+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if int64(len(raw)) > max {
		return nil, ErrTooLarge
	}
	return raw, nil
}
``````

``````
// dataCall exposes only bounded blob/archive services, authenticated like all
// other plugin-host calls. HostAdapter performs the live grant checks.
func (h *HostHandler) dataCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var args json.RawMessage
	if !h.decode(w, r, maxHostBodyBytes, &args) {
		return
	}
	service, ok := h.host.(interface {
		CallDataHost(context.Context, string, string, json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		writeHostError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "Data services unavailable")
		return
	}
	out, err := service.CallDataHost(r.Context(), pluginIDOf(r), r.PathValue("service"), args)
	if !h.finishErr(w, err) {
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, out)
}
``````

``````
func defaultRuntimeCeilings() runtimeCeilings {
	return runtimeCeilings{memory: 2 << 30, deadline: 12 * time.Hour, units: 1 << 60, fetch: 8 << 30, member: 8 << 30, expanded: 32 << 30, members: 65535}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#applyRuntimeCeilings

``````
func applyRuntimeCeilings(c runtimeCeilings, l config.PluginRuntimeLimits) runtimeCeilings {
	if l.MemoryBytes > 0 {
		c.memory = min(l.MemoryBytes, uint64(wasm.MaxMemoryBytes))
	}
	if d, err := time.ParseDuration(l.Deadline); err == nil && d > 0 {
		c.deadline = min(d, 365*24*time.Hour)
	}
	if l.UnitBudget > 0 {
		c.units = l.UnitBudget
	}
	if l.FetchBytes > 0 {
		c.fetch = min(l.FetchBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveMemberBytes > 0 {
		c.member = min(l.ArchiveMemberBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveExpandedBytes > 0 {
		c.expanded = min(l.ArchiveExpandedBytes, int64(1<<60))
	}
	if l.ArchiveMembers > 0 {
		c.members = min(l.ArchiveMembers, 1000000)
	}
	return c
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#runtimeLimitsWithCeilings

``````
func runtimeLimitsWithCeilings(m Manifest, c runtimeCeilings) wasm.Limits {
	l := wasm.Limits{MemoryBytes: min(uint64(32<<20), c.memory), Deadline: c.deadline, UnitBudget: c.units}
	if m.Ether != nil && m.Ether.Runtime.Limits != nil {
		r := m.Ether.Runtime.Limits
		if r.MemoryBytes > 0 {
			l.MemoryBytes = min(r.MemoryBytes, c.memory)
		}
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(r.Deadline); err == nil && d > 0 {
			l.Deadline = min(d, c.deadline)
		}
		if r.UnitBudget > 0 {
			l.UnitBudget = min(r.UnitBudget, c.units)
		}
	}
	return l
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.grantedRuntimeLimits

``````
func (m *Manager) grantedRuntimeLimits(man Manifest) *RuntimeLimits {
	if man.RuntimeKind() != "hosted" {
		return nil
	}
	c := m.runtimeCeilings(man.ID)
	l := runtimeLimitsWithCeilings(man, c)
	r := &RuntimeLimits{MemoryBytes: l.MemoryBytes, Deadline: l.Deadline.String(), UnitBudget: l.UnitBudget}
	r.FetchBytes = c.fetch
	r.ArchiveMemberBytes = c.member
	r.ArchiveExpandedBytes = c.expanded
	r.ArchiveMembers = c.members
	if req := man.Ether.Runtime.Limits; req != nil {
		if req.FetchBytes > 0 {
			r.FetchBytes = min(r.FetchBytes, req.FetchBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveMemberBytes > 0 {
			r.ArchiveMemberBytes = min(r.ArchiveMemberBytes, req.ArchiveMemberBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveExpandedBytes > 0 {
			r.ArchiveExpandedBytes = min(r.ArchiveExpandedBytes, req.ArchiveExpandedBytes)
		}
		if req.ArchiveMembers > 0 {
			r.ArchiveMembers = min(r.ArchiveMembers, req.ArchiveMembers)
		}
	}
	return r
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/runtime_limits.go#*Manager.handleRuntimeLimits

``````
func (m *Manager) handleRuntimeLimits(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method == http.MethodPut {
		var req struct {
			Plugin string                     `json:"plugin"`
			Limits config.PluginRuntimeLimits `json:"limits"`
		}
		if err := decode(r, &req); err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		if req.Limits.MemoryBytes > wasm.MaxMemoryBytes || req.Limits.UnitBudget < 0 || req.Limits.FetchBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMemberBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveExpandedBytes < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMembers < 0 || req.Limits.ArchiveMembers > 1000000 {
			m.fail(w, fmt.Errorf("memory must be at most 4 GiB and work units must not be negative"))
			return
		}
		if req.Limits.Deadline != "" {
			if d, err := time.ParseDuration(req.Limits.Deadline); err != nil || d <= 0 || d > 365*24*time.Hour {
				m.fail(w, fmt.Errorf("time limit must be positive and at most one year"))
				return
			}
		}
		if req.Plugin != "" {
			if _, err := m.Get(r.Context(), req.Plugin); err != nil {
				m.fail(w, err)
				return
			}
		}
		if m.deps.SaveRuntimeConfig == nil {
			m.fail(w, fmt.Errorf("runtime settings are unavailable"))
			return
		}
		if err := m.deps.SaveRuntimeConfig(req.Plugin, req.Limits); err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		// Closing runtimes cancels jobs so lowered ceilings take effect immediately.
		recs, err := m.List(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			m.fail(w, err)
			return
		}
		for _, rec := range recs {
			if req.Plugin == "" || req.Plugin == rec.ID {
				m.closeRuntime(rec.ID)
			}
		}
		m.broadcast(r.Context())
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, m.runtimeConfig())
}
``````

``````
// DataLimits exposes owner grants to shared hosted/remote data services.
func (h *host) DataLimits(ctx context.Context) RuntimeLimits {
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/settings_public.go#NonSecretSettings

``````
// NonSecretSettings applies declared defaults, then stored public settings.
// Explicit zero, false, empty and null values take precedence over defaults.
// Studio uses the same secret field classifier as installed settings storage.
func NonSecretSettings(settings map[string]any, schema json.RawMessage, declaredSecrets []string) map[string]any {
	secretNames := secretFieldNames(schema)
	for _, key := range declaredSecrets {
		secretNames[key] = true
	}
	out := make(map[string]any, len(settings))
	var doc map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(schema, &doc) == nil {
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if field["kind"] == "secret" || field["type"] == "secret" {
				secretNames[key] = true
			}
		})
		visitSettingsFields(doc, func(key string, field map[string]any) {
			if value, exists := field["default"]; exists && !secretNames[key] {
				out[key] = value
			}
		})
	}
	for key, value := range settings {
		if !secretNames[key] {
			out[key] = value
		}
	}
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/settings_public.go#visitSettingsFields

``````
// Only traverse the schema's supported field containers, never default values or
// arbitrary nested objects that happen to contain a key/default pair.
func visitSettingsFields(doc map[string]any, visit func(string, map[string]any)) {
	for _, container := range []string{"fields", "groups"} {
		entries, _ := doc[container].([]any)
		for _, entry := range entries {
			field, ok := entry.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if container == "fields" && field["kind"] != "group" {
				if key, ok := firstString(field, "key", "name", "id", "field"); ok {
					visit(key, field)
				}
			}
			visitSettingsFields(field, visit)
		}
	}
	properties, _ := doc["properties"].(map[string]any)
	for key, raw := range properties {
		if field, ok := raw.(map[string]any); ok {
			visit(key, field)
		}
	}
}
``````

``````
	}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#validateSetup

``````
func validateSetup(e *EtherBlock, add func(string, string), label func(string, string, int)) {
	if e.Contributes.Setup == nil {
		return
	}
	steps := e.Contributes.Setup.Steps
	if len(steps) == 0 {
		add("ether.contributes.setup.steps", "must list at least one step")
	}
	schemaFields := settingsFieldKeys(e.Settings)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, s := range steps {
		base := fmt.Sprintf("ether.contributes.setup.steps[%d]", i)
		if !keyRe.MatchString(s.Key) || seen[s.Key] {
			add(base+".key", "must be a unique simple key")
		}
		seen[s.Key] = true
		label(base+".label", s.Label, 60)
		if s.Hint != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(s.Hint, "$t:") {
			if msg := LintCopy(s.Hint, 120); msg != "" {
				add(base+".hint", msg)
			}
			if strings.Count(strings.TrimRight(s.Hint, "."), ".") > 0 {
				add(base+".hint", "must be one sentence")
			}
		}
		for j, f := range s.Fields {
			if !keyRe.MatchString(f) {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j), "must be a settings field key")
			} else if schemaFields != nil && !schemaFields[f] {
				add(fmt.Sprintf("%s.fields[%d]", base, j), "is not a field in the settings schema")
			}
		}
		if s.Test != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(s.Test, "/") {
			add(base+".test", "must be a plugin route starting with /")
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#settingsFieldKeys

``````
// settingsFieldKeys extracts every "key" string from an inline settings
// schema. A "$ref" schema is resolved at install, so it returns nil
// and field membership is not checked here.
func settingsFieldKeys(raw json.RawMessage) map[string]bool {
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return map[string]bool{}
	}
	var doc any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &doc); err != nil {
		return nil
	}
	if obj, ok := doc.(map[string]any); ok {
		if _, isRef := obj["$ref"]; isRef {
			return nil
		}
	}
	out := map[string]bool{}
	var walk func(v any)
	walk = func(v any) {
		switch n := v.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			if k, ok := n["key"].(string); ok {
				out[k] = true
			}
			for _, child := range n {
				walk(child)
			}
		case []any:
			for _, child := range n {
				walk(child)
			}
		}
	}
	walk(doc)
	return out
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*storage.setupState

``````
func (s *storage) setupState(ctx context.Context, plugin string) ([]SetupStepState, error) {
	rows, err := s.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT step,status,detail,at FROM plugins_setup WHERE plugin=? ORDER BY step`, plugin)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []SetupStepState
	for rows.Next() {
		var st SetupStepState
		var at int64
		if err := rows.Scan(&st.Step, &st.Status, &st.Detail, &at); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		st.At = time.Unix(at, 0).UTC()
		out = append(out, st)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*storage.putSetupState

``````
func (s *storage) putSetupState(ctx context.Context, plugin, step, status, detail string) error {
	_, err := s.db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO plugins_setup(plugin,step,status,detail,at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
ON CONFLICT(plugin,step) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status,detail=excluded.detail,at=excluded.at`,
		plugin, step, status, detail, s.now().Unix())
	return err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SetupState

``````
// SetupState returns every recorded setup step result for a plugin,
// with unrecorded steps reported as pending, in manifest order.
func (m *Manager) SetupState(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) ([]SetupStepState, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	stored, err := m.store.setupState(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byStep := map[string]SetupStepState{}
	for _, st := range stored {
		byStep[st.Step] = st
	}
	var out []SetupStepState
	if e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther(); e != nil && e.Contributes.Setup != nil {
		for _, step := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
			if st, ok := byStep[step.Key]; ok {
				out = append(out, st)
			} else {
				out = append(out, SetupStepState{Step: step.Key, Status: SetupPending})
			}
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SetupBlockers

``````
// SetupBlockers lists the required setup steps still holding a plugin
// back: steps that have neither passed nor been skipped by the owner
// (spec §8). Content adapters keep libraries hidden and sync stopped
// while this is non-empty.
func (m *Manager) SetupBlockers(ctx context.Context, pluginID string) ([]string, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther()
	if e == nil || e.Contributes.Setup == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	state, err := m.SetupState(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	byStep := map[string]SetupStepState{}
	for _, st := range state {
		byStep[st.Step] = st
	}
	var blocked []string
	for _, step := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
		if !step.Required {
			continue
		}
		if st := byStep[step.Key]; st.Status != SetupOK && st.Status != SetupSkipped {
			blocked = append(blocked, step.Key)
		}
	}
	return blocked, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#setupStepOf

``````
func setupStepOf(r Record, key string) (SetupStep, bool) {
	if e := r.Manifest.EffectiveEther(); e != nil && e.Contributes.Setup != nil {
		for _, s := range e.Contributes.Setup.Steps {
			if s.Key == key {
				return s, true
			}
		}
	}
	return SetupStep{}, false
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.TestSetupStep

``````
// TestSetupStep runs one setup step's test against the saved settings
// and records the result. Only the step's non-secret field values are
// sent; secrets reach the plugin through SecretGet, never in the test
// body (spec §8). A step with no test route passes once it is run.
func (m *Manager) TestSetupStep(ctx context.Context, pluginID, stepKey string) (SetupTestResult, error) {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	step, ok := setupStepOf(r, stepKey)
	if !ok {
		return SetupTestResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: plugin has no setup step %q", ErrUnavailable, stepKey)
	}
	if step.Test == "" {
		res := SetupTestResult{OK: true}
		if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupOK, ""); err != nil {
			return res, err
		}
		m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
		m.broadcast(ctx)
		return res, nil
	}
	settings, err := m.HostFor(pluginID).Settings(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	values := map[string]any{}
	for _, f := range step.Fields {
		if v, present := settings[f]; present {
			values[f] = v
		}
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"step": stepKey, "fields": values})
	if err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	resp, err := m.Call(callCtx, pluginID, Request{Method: "POST", Path: step.Test, Body: body})
	if err != nil {
		_ = m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupFailed, "The plugin did not answer")
		m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
		m.broadcast(ctx)
		return SetupTestResult{OK: false, Detail: "The plugin did not answer"}, nil
	}
	var res SetupTestResult
	if len(resp.Body) > 0 {
		_ = json.Unmarshal(resp.Body, &res)
	}
	if resp.Status >= 300 {
		res.OK = false
		if res.Detail == "" {
			res.Detail = fmt.Sprintf("The plugin answered with status %d", resp.Status)
		}
	}
	res.Detail = textclip.Bytes(res.Detail, 500)
	status := SetupFailed
	if res.OK {
		status = SetupOK
	}
	if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, status, res.Detail); err != nil {
		return SetupTestResult{}, err
	}
	m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
	m.broadcast(ctx)
	return res, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/setup.go#*Manager.SkipSetupStep

``````
// SkipSetupStep records the owner's "skip for now" on one step, which
// unblocks the plugin while leaving the step visibly unfinished.
func (m *Manager) SkipSetupStep(ctx context.Context, pluginID, stepKey string) error {
	r, err := m.Get(ctx, pluginID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, ok := setupStepOf(r, stepKey); !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: plugin has no setup step %q", ErrUnavailable, stepKey)
	}
	if err := m.store.putSetupState(ctx, pluginID, stepKey, SetupSkipped, ""); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	m.syncDescriptors(ctx, r)
	m.broadcast(ctx)
	return nil
}
``````

``````
// Tools returns the 8 Studio and extensibility tools (WS11h):
// registry_describe, viewspec_validate, viewspec_render, plugin_scaffold,
// plugin_check, plugin_replay, plugin_shadow_report, and plugin_install.
func Tools(deps ToolDeps) []tools.Tool {

		viewspecRenderTool(deps),

		pluginCheckTool(deps),
		pluginReplayTool(deps),
		pluginShadowReportTool(deps),
		pluginInstallTool(deps),
	}
``````
