## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#registryDescribeTool

``````
func registryDescribeTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional descriptor kind to filter by (for example rankingStep, ruleField, collectionSource, page, widget, tool)."
			},
			"id": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional descriptor ID to inspect."
			},
			"owner": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional owner filter (builtin or a plugin ID)."
			},
			"locale": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Locale code for resolving copy, defaulting to en."
			},
			"limit": {
				"type": "integer",
				"minimum": 1,
				"maximum": 200,
				"description": "Maximum number of descriptors to return (1 to 200)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "registry_describe",
		Title:       "Describe extension registry",
		Description: "List registered extension descriptors by kind or owner, or inspect one descriptor in detail.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(_ context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Registry == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The extension registry is not available.")
			}
			kindStr, err := optString(input, "kind", 64)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			idStr, err := optString(input, "id", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			ownerStr, err := optString(input, "owner", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			locale, err := optString(input, "locale", 16)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			if locale == "" {
				locale = "en"
			}
			limit, err := optInt(input, "limit", 100, 1, 200)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}

			if kindStr != "" && !extend.Known(extend.Kind(kindStr)) {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Unknown descriptor kind %q.", kindStr)
			}

			resolver := deps.TextResolver
			if resolver == nil && deps.Manager != nil {
				resolver = deps.Manager.TextResolver()
			}
			resolveDescriptor := func(d extend.Descriptor) extend.Descriptor {
				if resolver != nil {
					if d.Label.Plugin != "" && d.Label.Key != "" {
						if s, ok := resolver(d.Label.Plugin, d.Label.Key, locale); ok {
							d.Label.Resolved = s
						}
					}
					if d.Hint.Plugin != "" && d.Hint.Key != "" {
						if s, ok := resolver(d.Hint.Plugin, d.Hint.Key, locale); ok {
							d.Hint.Resolved = s
						}
					}
				}
				return d
			}

			if kindStr != "" && idStr != "" {
				d, ok := deps.Registry.Get(extend.Kind(kindStr), idStr)
				if !ok {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Descriptor %q of kind %q was not found.", idStr, kindStr)
				}
				return tools.Result{
					Data: map[string]any{
						"descriptor": resolveDescriptor(d),
					},
				}, nil
			}

			var list []extend.Descriptor
			if kindStr != "" {
				list = deps.Registry.List(extend.Kind(kindStr))
			} else {
				list = deps.Registry.List()
			}
			filtered := make([]extend.Descriptor, 0, len(list))
			for _, d := range list {
				if idStr != "" && d.ID != idStr {
					continue
				}
				if ownerStr != "" && d.Owner != ownerStr {
					continue
				}
				filtered = append(filtered, resolveDescriptor(d))
				if len(filtered) >= limit {
					break
				}
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"count":       len(filtered),
					"descriptors": filtered,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open plugins", Route: "/settings/plugins"},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#viewspecValidateTool

``````
func viewspecValidateTool() tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["spec"],
		"properties": {
			"spec": {
				"description": "The ViewSpec JSON object or JSON string to validate."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "viewspec_validate",
		Title:       "Validate ViewSpec document",
		Description: "Validate a ViewSpec JSON document against Ether's plugin UI rules and report any field errors.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(_ context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			rawSpec, ok := input["spec"]
			if !ok || rawSpec == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide a spec object to validate.")
			}
			specBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawSpec, maxManifestBytes, "spec")
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			res := viewspec.ValidatePlugin(specBytes)
			errs := res.Errors
			if errs == nil {
				errs = []string{}
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":     res.OK,
					"errors": errs,
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#viewspecRenderTool

``````
func viewspecRenderTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"spec": {
				"description": "The ViewSpec JSON object or JSON string to validate and prepare for console rendering."
			},
			"data": {
				"description": "Optional data object bound to the ViewSpec document."
			},
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional installed plugin ID to load a contributed page from."
			},
			"page": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional contributed page key on the installed plugin."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "viewspec_render",
		Title:       "Render ViewSpec preview",
		Description: "Validate a ViewSpec document and data payload, and return the validated spec, data, and console preview URL.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			pluginID, err := optString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			pageKey, err := optString(input, "page", 64)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}

			var specBytes []byte
			var dataObj map[string]any

			if rawSpec, ok := input["spec"]; ok && rawSpec != nil {
				specBytes, err = encodeBoundedJSON(rawSpec, maxManifestBytes, "spec")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
			}
			if rawData, ok := input["data"]; ok && rawData != nil {
				dataBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawData, maxManifestBytes, "data")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				if err := json.Unmarshal(dataBytes, &dataObj); err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The data field must be a JSON object.")
				}
			}

			if len(specBytes) == 0 {
				if pluginID == "" || pageKey == "" {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either spec or both plugin and page.")
				}
				if deps.Manager == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
				}
				rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
				}
				route := ""
				if rec.Manifest.Ether != nil {
					for _, p := range rec.Manifest.Ether.Contributes.Pages {
						if p.Key == pageKey {
							route = p.Route
							break
						}
					}
				}
				if route == "" {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Page %q was not found on plugin %q.", pageKey, pluginID)
				}
				resp, err := deps.Manager.Call(ctx, pluginID, plugins.Request{
					PluginID: pluginID,
					Method:   "GET",
					Path:     route,
				})
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not load page %q from plugin %q.", pageKey, pluginID)
				}
				body := unwrapResponseBody(resp.Body)
				var pageEnvelope struct {
					Spec json.RawMessage `json:"spec"`
					Data map[string]any  `json:"data"`
				}
				if json.Unmarshal(body, &pageEnvelope) == nil && len(pageEnvelope.Spec) > 0 {
					specBytes = pageEnvelope.Spec
					if dataObj == nil {
						dataObj = pageEnvelope.Data
					}
				} else {
					specBytes = body
				}
			}

			if dataObj == nil {
				dataObj = map[string]any{}
			}

			valRes := viewspec.ValidatePlugin(specBytes)
			if !valRes.OK {
				return tools.Result{
					Data: map[string]any{
						"ok":     false,
						"errors": valRes.Errors,
					},
				}, nil
			}

			var specObj map[string]any
			_ = json.Unmarshal(specBytes, &specObj)

			consoleURL := "/settings/plugins/studio/preview"
			if pluginID != "" && pageKey != "" {
				consoleURL = fmt.Sprintf("/plugins/%s/pages/%s", pluginID, pageKey)
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":         true,
					"spec":       specObj,
					"data":       dataObj,
					"consoleUrl": consoleURL,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open preview in console", Route: consoleURL},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#Scaffold

``````
// Scaffold builds a valid manifest and TypeScript entry file for the requested
// plugin kind and capabilities.
func Scaffold(req ScaffoldRequest) (ScaffoldResult, error) {
	id := strings.TrimSpace(req.ID)
	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if id == "" || len(id) > 120 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Provide a reverse-DNS plugin id of at most 120 characters.")
	}
	if name == "" || len(name) > 80 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Provide a plugin name of at most 80 characters.")
	}
	summary := strings.TrimSpace(req.Summary)
	if summary == "" {
		summary = "Custom plugin for Ether."
	}
	if len(summary) > 140 {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Summary must be at most 140 characters.")
	}

	kind := plugins.Kind(strings.TrimSpace(req.Kind))
	if kind == "" {
		kind = plugins.KindExtension
	}
	var caps []plugins.Capability
	for _, c := range req.Capabilities {
		c = strings.TrimSpace(c)
		if c != "" {
			caps = append(caps, plugins.Capability(c))
		}
	}
	if len(caps) == 0 {
		switch kind {
		case plugins.KindSource:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapStreamSource}
		case plugins.KindNotificationChannel:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapNotify}
		case plugins.KindLiveTVSource:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapLiveTV}
		default:
			caps = []plugins.Capability{plugins.CapRankingStep}
		}
	}

	m := plugins.Manifest{
		ID:          id,
		Version:     "0.1.0",
		Name:        name,
		Description: summary,
		Types:       []string{"movie", "series"},
		Ether: &plugins.EtherBlock{
			Protocol:     plugins.Protocol,
			Kind:         kind,
			Capabilities: caps,
			Summary:      summary,
			Runtime: plugins.RuntimeDecl{
				Kind:  "hosted",
				Entry: "plugin.ts",
			},
		},
	}

	if kind == plugins.KindIntegration {
		m.Ether.Contributes.Integration = &plugins.IntegrationMeta{
			Category: "automation",
			Adds:     []string{"Syncs watch activity."},
			Connect:  "none",
		}
	}

	var codeLines []string
	codeLines = append(codeLines, `type Request = { method: string; path: string; query?: Record<string, string[]>; body?: unknown };`)
	codeLines = append(codeLines, `type Response = { status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body?: unknown };`)

	needHandle := false
	for _, cap := range caps {
		switch cap {
		case plugins.CapStreamSource:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Source = &plugins.SourceMeta{Class: "direct"}
		case plugins.CapListSource:
			needHandle = true
			m.Catalogs = []plugins.StremioCat{{Type: "movie", ID: "picks", Name: "Picked movies"}}
			m.Ether.Contributes.ListSources = []plugins.ListSourceMeta{
				{Key: "picks", Label: "Picked movies", Catalog: "picks", MaxItems: 100, Refresh: "1h"},
			}
		case plugins.CapLiveTV:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Channels = &plugins.ChannelsMeta{Refresh: "1h", Test: true}
		case plugins.CapSubtitles:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Subtitles = &plugins.SubtitlesMeta{
				Languages: json.RawMessage(`"any"`),
				Formats:   []string{"srt", "vtt"},
			}
		case plugins.CapMarkers:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Markers = &plugins.MarkersMeta{Kinds: []string{"intro", "credits"}}
		case plugins.CapNotify:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Notification = &plugins.NotificationMeta{
				SendTest:  true,
				Formats:   []string{"plain"},
				MaxLength: 2000,
			}
		case plugins.CapEvents:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Events = &plugins.EventsMeta{
				Subscribe: []string{plugins.EventPlaybackCompleted},
			}
		case plugins.CapRankingStep:
			m.Ether.Contributes.RankingSteps = []plugins.RankingStepMeta{
				{Key: "prefer_custom", Label: "Prefer matching releases"},
			}
		case plugins.CapRuleCondition:
			m.Ether.Contributes.RuleConditions = []plugins.RuleConditionMeta{
				{Key: "custom_match", Label: "Custom release match", Operators: []string{"equals", "contains"}},
			}
		case plugins.CapTools:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Tools = []plugins.ToolMeta{
				{
					Name:        "status_summary",
					Title:       "Status summary",
					Description: "Return a short status summary from the plugin.",
					InputSchema: json.RawMessage(`{"type":"object","properties":{}}`),
					ReadOnly:    true,
				},
			}
		case plugins.CapUI:
			needHandle = true
			m.Ether.Contributes.Pages = []plugins.PageMeta{
				{Key: "overview", Label: "Overview", Route: "/ether/view/overview"},
			}
		}
	}

	if needHandle || (!slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRankingStep) && !slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRuleCondition)) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function handle(req: Request): Response {
  if (req.path === "/ether/health" || req.path === "/ether/test") {
    return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok" } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/event") {
    return { status: 200, body: { ack: [] } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/channels.json") {
    return { status: 200, body: { channels: [] } };
  }
  return { status: 200, body: { metas: [] } };
}
(globalThis as any).handle = handle;`)
	}
	if slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRankingStep) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function rank_key(candidate: { name: string }, _config: Record<string, unknown>): number {
  return candidate.name ? 0 : 0;
}
(globalThis as any).rank_key = rank_key;`)
	}
	if slices.Contains(caps, plugins.CapRuleCondition) {
		codeLines = append(codeLines, `
function cond_match(candidate: { name: string }, operator: string, value: unknown): boolean {
  const target = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
  if (operator === "contains" && target !== "") {
    return candidate.name.includes(target);
  }
  return candidate.name === target;
}
(globalThis as any).cond_match = cond_match;`)
	}

	if err := m.Validate(); err != nil {
		return ScaffoldResult{}, tools.Userf("Generated manifest is not valid: %s", err.Error())
	}

	return ScaffoldResult{
		Manifest: m,
		Files: map[string]string{
			"plugin.ts": strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(codeLines, "\n")) + "\n",
		},
	}, nil
}
``````

	OK      bool                 `json:"ok"`
	Issues  []plugins.FieldError `json:"issues"`
	Exports map[string]bool      `json:"exports,omitempty"`
}

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#Check

``````
// Check validates a plugin's manifest, copy rules, settings schema, ViewSpec
// files, and hosted TypeScript or JavaScript entry code.
func Check(ctx context.Context, _ *wasm.Engine, req CheckRequest) (ToolCheckReport, error) {
	files := make(map[string][]byte, len(req.Files))
	for name, contents := range req.Files {
		files[name] = []byte(contents)
	}
	rep := kit.Check(ctx, &kit.Package{ManifestRaw: req.Manifest, Files: files})
	out := ToolCheckReport{OK: rep.OK, Issues: []plugins.FieldError{}, Exports: rep.Exports}
	for _, issue := range rep.Errors {
		out.Issues = append(out.Issues, plugins.FieldError{Field: issue.Field, Message: issue.Message})
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

``````
func pluginCheckTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Optional installed plugin ID to check."
			},
			"manifest": {
				"description": "Manifest JSON object or JSON string to check."
			},
			"files": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Map of file paths to file contents for the plugin."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_check",
		Title:       "Check plugin",
		Description: "Validate a plugin manifest, copy rules, settings schema, ViewSpec documents, and TypeScript or JavaScript entry code.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			pluginID, err := optString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			var manifestBytes []byte
			files := map[string]string{}

			if pluginID != "" {
				if deps.Manager == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
				}
				rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
				}
				manifestBytes = rec.ManifestRaw
				if len(manifestBytes) == 0 {
					manifestBytes, _ = json.Marshal(rec.Manifest)
				}
				if deps.Runner != nil {
					for k, v := range deps.Runner.loadArtifactFiles(ctx, rec.ID, rec.Version) {
						files[k] = string(v)
					}
				}
			} else {
				rawManifest, ok := input["manifest"]
				if !ok || rawManifest == nil {
					return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either an installed plugin id or a manifest.")
				}
				manifestBytes, err = encodeBoundedJSON(rawManifest, maxManifestBytes, "manifest")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				files, err = optFileMap(input, "files")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
			}

			eng := deps.Engine
			rep, err := Check(ctx, eng, CheckRequest{
				Manifest: manifestBytes,
				Files:    files,
			})
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"ok":      rep.OK,
					"issues":  rep.Issues,
					"exports": rep.Exports,
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

func pluginReplayTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["kind"],
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Installed plugin ID to replay."
			},
			"devInstance": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Unsaved Studio plugin instance with manifest, entry or files, and settings."
			},
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"enum": ["ranking", "events", "list", "channels"],
				"description": "Replay mode to run: ranking, events, list, or channels."
			},
			"params": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Mode-specific replay parameters (stepKey, position, limit, days, sourceKey, probeLimit)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_replay",
		Title:       "Replay plugin",
		Description: "Replay recorded resolution history, events, list pages, or channels against an installed plugin or Studio dev instance.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		OpenWorld:   true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Runner == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The Studio replay runner is not available.")
			}
			rawInput, err := encodeBoundedJSON(input, maxRequestBytes, "input")
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			var req ReplayRequest
			if err := json.Unmarshal(rawInput, &req); err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Invalid replay parameters: %s", err.Error())
			}
			report, err := deps.Runner.Replay(ctx, req)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Replay failed: %s", err.Error())
			}
			dataBytes, _ := json.Marshal(report)
			var dataMap map[string]any
			_ = json.Unmarshal(dataBytes, &dataMap)
			return tools.Result{
				Data: dataMap,
			}, nil
		},
	}
}

func pluginShadowReportTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"required": ["plugin"],
		"properties": {
			"plugin": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Installed plugin ID to inspect."
			},
			"limit": {
				"type": "integer",
				"minimum": 1,
				"maximum": 500,
				"description": "Maximum number of shadow journal entries to return (1 to 500)."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_shadow_report",
		Title:       "Read plugin shadow report",
		Description: "Read the recorded shadow-mode journal entries for an installed plugin to see what it would have changed.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Manager == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
			}
			pluginID, err := reqString(input, "plugin", 128)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			limit, err := optInt(input, "limit", 100, 1, 500)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			rec, err := deps.Manager.Get(ctx, pluginID)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin %q is not installed.", pluginID)
			}
			entries, err := deps.Manager.Journal(ctx, pluginID, limit, true)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not read shadow journal for %q.", pluginID)
			}
			if entries == nil {
				entries = []plugins.JournalEntry{}
			}
			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"plugin":  pluginID,
					"shadow":  rec.Shadow,
					"count":   len(entries),
					"entries": entries,
				},
				Links: []tools.Link{
					{Label: "Open plugin", Route: "/settings/plugins/" + pluginID},
				},
			}, nil
		},
	}
}

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#pluginInstallTool

``````
func pluginInstallTool(deps ToolDeps) tools.Tool {
	schema := json.RawMessage(`{
		"type": "object",
		"properties": {
			"url": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Manifest or repository URL for remote or GitHub plugins."
			},
			"kind": {
				"type": "string",
				"description": "Source kind: url, github, or studio."
			},
			"lan": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Allow private LAN addresses for remote plugins."
			},
			"manifest": {
				"description": "Manifest JSON object or JSON string when installing from Studio."
			},
			"files": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Map of file paths to file contents when installing from Studio."
			},
			"settings": {
				"type": "object",
				"description": "Initial plugin settings."
			},
			"shadow": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Start the plugin in shadow mode so writes are recorded without applying."
			},
			"autoUpdate": {
				"type": "boolean",
				"description": "Enable automatic updates when permissions do not increase."
			}
		},
		"additionalProperties": false
	}`)

	return tools.Tool{
		Name:        "plugin_install",
		Title:       "Install plugin",
		Description: "Preview a plugin and create an owner approval proposal to install it.",
		InputSchema: schema,
		ReadOnly:    false,
		Destructive: true,
		OpenWorld:   true,
		Audience:    tools.AudienceOwner,
		Owner:       extend.Builtin,
		Execute: func(ctx context.Context, _ tools.Principal, input map[string]any) (tools.Result, error) {
			if deps.Manager == nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("The plugin manager is not available.")
			}
			rawURL, err := optString(input, "url", 2048)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			kindStr, err := optString(input, "kind", 32)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, err
			}
			lan, _ := input["lan"].(bool)
			shadow, _ := input["shadow"].(bool)
			autoUpdate, _ := input["autoUpdate"].(bool)
			settings, _ := input["settings"].(map[string]any)

			src := plugins.Source{
				Kind: kindStr,
				URL:  rawURL,
				LAN:  lan,
			}
			if rawManifest, ok := input["manifest"]; ok && rawManifest != nil {
				manifestBytes, err := encodeBoundedJSON(rawManifest, maxManifestBytes, "manifest")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				fileMap, err := optFileMap(input, "files")
				if err != nil {
					return tools.Result{}, err
				}
				byteFiles := make(map[string][]byte, len(fileMap))
				for k, v := range fileMap {
					byteFiles[k] = []byte(v)
				}
				src.Kind = "studio"
				src.Manifest = manifestBytes
				src.Files = byteFiles
			} else if rawURL == "" {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Provide either a plugin URL or a Studio manifest.")
			}

			preview, err := deps.Manager.PreviewInstall(ctx, src)
			if err != nil {
				return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Plugin preview failed: %s", err.Error())
			}

			// Owner-facing copy: what it adds and what it can reach, in plain
			// words. Identifiers and runtimes stay out of the approval card.
			details := []tools.ProposalDetail{{Label: "What it adds", Value: plainContributions(preview.Manifest)}}
			access := "Nothing beyond its own storage"
			if len(preview.PermissionLines) > 0 {
				access = strings.Join(preview.PermissionLines, "; ")
			}
			details = append(details, tools.ProposalDetail{Label: "What it can access", Value: access})
			details = append(details, tools.ProposalDetail{Label: "Version", Value: preview.Manifest.Version})

			opts := plugins.InstallOptions{
				Grants:     plugins.Grants{LAN: lan},
				Settings:   settings,
				AutoUpdate: autoUpdate,
				Shadow:     shadow,
			}

			proposal := &tools.Proposal{
				Category:    "Install plugin",
				Description: fmt.Sprintf("Add %s to Ether.", preview.Manifest.Name),
				Details:     details,
				Input:       input,
				Apply: func(applyCtx context.Context) (tools.Result, error) {
					rec, err := deps.Manager.Install(applyCtx, preview, opts)
					if err != nil {
						return tools.Result{}, tools.Userf("Could not install plugin: %s", err.Error())
					}
					deps.Studio.NotifyInstalled(applyCtx, rec)
					return tools.Result{
						Data: map[string]any{
							"id":      rec.ID,
							"name":    rec.Name,
							"version": rec.Version,
							"enabled": rec.Enabled,
							"shadow":  rec.Shadow,
						},
						Links: []tools.Link{
							{Label: "Open plugin", Route: "/settings/plugins/" + rec.ID},
						},
					}, nil
				},
			}

			return tools.Result{
				Data: map[string]any{
					"id":          preview.Manifest.ID,
					"name":        preview.Manifest.Name,
					"version":     preview.Manifest.Version,
					"permissions": preview.PermissionLines,
					"verified":    preview.Verified,
				},
				Proposal: proposal,
			}, nil
		},
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#reqString

``````
func reqString(input map[string]any, key string, maxLen int) (string, error) {
	v, err := optString(input, key, maxLen)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if v == "" {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q is required.", key)
	}
	return v, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optString

``````
func optString(input map[string]any, key string, maxLen int) (string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return "", nil
	}
	s, ok := raw.(string)
	if !ok {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q must be a string.", key)
	}
	s = strings.TrimSpace(s)
	if maxLen > 0 && len(s) > maxLen {
		return "", tools.Userf("Field %q must be at most %d characters.", key, maxLen)
	}
	return s, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optInt

``````
func optInt(input map[string]any, key string, def, minVal, maxVal int) (int, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return def, nil
	}
	var n int
	switch v := raw.(type) {
	case float64:
		n = int(v)
	case int:
		n = v
	case int64:
		n = int(v)
	case json.Number:
		i, err := v.Int64()
		if err != nil {
			return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an integer.", key)
		}
		n = int(i)
	default:
		return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an integer.", key)
	}
	if n < minVal || n > maxVal {
		return 0, tools.Userf("Field %q must be between %d and %d.", key, minVal, maxVal)
	}
	return n, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optStringSlice

``````
func optStringSlice(input map[string]any, key string, maxItems, maxItemLen int) ([]string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var out []string
	switch v := raw.(type) {
	case []string:
		out = v
	case []any:
		for _, item := range v {
			s, ok := item.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Every entry in %q must be a string.", key)
			}
			out = append(out, s)
		}
	default:
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an array of strings.", key)
	}
	if len(out) > maxItems {
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d items.", key, maxItems)
	}
	for _, s := range out {
		if len(s) > maxItemLen {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Entries in %q must be at most %d characters.", key, maxItemLen)
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#optFileMap

``````
func optFileMap(input map[string]any, key string) (map[string]string, error) {
	raw, ok := input[key]
	if !ok || raw == nil {
		return map[string]string{}, nil
	}
	out := map[string]string{}
	total := 0
	switch m := raw.(type) {
	case map[string]string:
		if len(m) > maxFilesCount {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d files.", key, maxFilesCount)
		}
		for k, v := range m {
			total += len(v)
			if total > maxFileBytes {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Files in %q exceed the size limit.", key)
			}
			out[k] = v
		}
	case map[string]any:
		if len(m) > maxFilesCount {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q allows at most %d files.", key, maxFilesCount)
		}
		for k, v := range m {
			s, ok := v.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, tools.Userf("File %q in %q must be a string.", k, key)
			}
			total += len(s)
			if total > maxFileBytes {
				return nil, tools.Userf("Files in %q exceed the size limit.", key)
			}
			out[k] = s
		}
	default:
		return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q must be an object mapping file names to strings.", key)
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#encodeBoundedJSON

``````
func encodeBoundedJSON(v any, maxBytes int, field string) ([]byte, error) {
	switch val := v.(type) {
	case string:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return []byte(val), nil
	case json.RawMessage:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return val, nil
	case []byte:
		if len(val) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return val, nil
	default:
		b, err := json.Marshal(v)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q is not valid JSON.", field)
		}
		if len(b) > maxBytes {
			return nil, tools.Userf("Field %q exceeds the maximum size of %d bytes.", field, maxBytes)
		}
		return b, nil
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/mcp_tools.go#plainContributions

``````
// plainContributions says where an installed plugin shows up, for owners.
func plainContributions(m plugins.Manifest) string {
	var parts []string
	e := m.EffectiveEther()
	for _, c := range e.Capabilities {
		switch c {
		case plugins.CapLiveTV:
			parts = append(parts, "live channels in the Live TV guide")
		case plugins.CapStreamSource:
			parts = append(parts, "playable sources on catalogue titles")
		case plugins.CapListSource:
			parts = append(parts, "Home rows and collections")
		case plugins.CapSubtitles:
			parts = append(parts, "subtitles in the player")
		case plugins.CapMetadata:
			parts = append(parts, "title details")
		case plugins.CapRankingStep:
			parts = append(parts, "a step in release ranking")
		case plugins.CapNotify:
			parts = append(parts, "notifications")
		}
	}
	if len(e.Contributes.Pages) > 0 {
		parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%d console page(s)", len(e.Contributes.Pages)))
	}
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return "Background behaviour only"
	}
	out := strings.Join(parts, ", ")
	return strings.ToUpper(out[:1]) + out[1:]
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#LookupTemplate

``````
// LookupTemplate finds a template by ID.
func LookupTemplate(id string) (Template, bool) {
	for _, t := range Templates() {
		if t.ID == id {
			return t, true
		}
	}
	return Template{}, false
}

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#prettyJSON

``````
func prettyJSON(v any) string {
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		return "{}"
	}
	return string(b) + "\n"
}

	stringsEN := map[string]string{
		"summary":           "Curated festival winners for Collection Studio and Home shelves.",
		"list_label":        "Festival winners",
		"list_hint":         "Award-winning films refreshed twice a day.",
		"shelf_label":       "Festival shelf",
		"catalogue_matches": "Catalogue matches",
		"collection_sync":   "Collection sync",
		"sync_collection":   "Sync collection now",
	}
	code := `// List source plugin (SPEC §5.1.3 / WS11a List template).
type Request = {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string[]>;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
};

const ITEMS = [
  { id: "tt6751668", type: "movie", name: "Parasite", year: 2019 },
  { id: "tt17009710", type: "movie", name: "Anatomy of a Fall", year: 2023 },
  { id: "tt8367814", type: "movie", name: "The Gentlemen", year: 2019 },
];

export function handle(req: Request) {
  if (req.path === "/ether/configure") { return { status: 200, body: { errors: {} } }; }

    return { status: 200, body: { metas: ITEMS } };

  if (req.path === "/ether/action/syncShelf" || req.path === "/ether/jobs/sync") {

export type CandidateFacts = {
  releaseId: string;
  name: string;
  resolution?: string;
  hdr?: string;
  audioCodec?: string;
  languages?: string[];
  cached?: boolean;
  verified?: boolean;
};

export function rank_key(
  candidate: CandidateFacts,
  config?: { language?: string }
): number {
  const target = (config?.language || "fr").toLowerCase();
  const langs = (candidate.languages || []).map((l) => l.toLowerCase());

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#applyProjectOptions

``````
// applyProjectOptions customizes a template's files for the given PluginID, Name, Slot, or StremioURL.
func applyProjectOptions(tpl Template, opts CreateProjectOptions) (pluginID, name string, files map[string]string) {
	files = make(map[string]string, len(tpl.Files))
	for k, v := range tpl.Files {
		files[k] = v
	}
	pluginID = strings.TrimSpace(opts.PluginID)
	if pluginID == "" {
		pluginID = tpl.DefaultPluginID
	}
	name = strings.TrimSpace(opts.Name)
	if name == "" {
		name = tpl.DefaultName
	}

	var man map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(files["manifest.json"]), &man); err != nil {
		return pluginID, name, files
	}
	man["id"] = pluginID
	man["name"] = name

	etherObj, _ := man["ether"].(map[string]any)
	contributes, _ := etherObj["contributes"].(map[string]any)

	if slot := strings.TrimSpace(opts.Slot); slot != "" && etherObj != nil && contributes != nil {
		ensureUICap(etherObj)
		var en map[string]string
		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(files["i18n/en.json"]), &en) == nil && en != nil {
			if en["slot_label"] == "" {
				en["slot_label"] = "Plugin action"
				files["i18n/en.json"] = prettyJSON(en)
			}
		}
		switch slot {
		case "page":
			contributes["pages"] = []map[string]any{
				{
					"key":   "overview",
					"label": "$t:page_label",
					"route": "/ether/view/overview",
				},
			}
		case "command":
			contributes["commands"] = []map[string]any{
				{
					"key":    "run_command",
					"label":  "$t:slot_label",
					"action": "createHighlight",
				},
			}
		default:
			entry := map[string]any{"slot": slot, "key": "custom_slot", "label": "$t:slot_label"}
			if strings.HasPrefix(slot, "actionMenu.") {
				action := "createHighlight"
				switch tpl.ID {
				case "list":
					action = "syncShelf"
				case "local_files":
					action = "matchFolder"
				}
				entry["action"] = action
			} else {
				entry["route"] = "/ether/view/overview"
			}
			contributes["slots"] = []map[string]any{entry}
		}
	}

	// Add-on links often carry a debrid key in the path, so only the host is
	// written into source; the link itself is never stored with the draft.
	if u, err := url.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(opts.StremioURL)); err == nil && u.Host != "" {
		if src, ok := files["src/plugin.ts"]; ok {
			files["src/plugin.ts"] = fmt.Sprintf("// Upstream Stremio add-on host: %s\n", u.Host) + src
		}
	}

	if opts.LiveSearch != nil && contributes != nil {
		if kinds, ok := contributes["mediaKinds"].([]any); ok {
			for _, k := range kinds {
				if kind, ok := k.(map[string]any); ok {
					browse, _ := kind["browse"].(map[string]any)
					if browse == nil {
						browse = map[string]any{}
						kind["browse"] = browse
					}
					browse["liveSearch"] = *opts.LiveSearch
				}
			}
		}
	}

	files["manifest.json"] = prettyJSON(man)
	return pluginID, name, files
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/studio/templates.go#ensureUICap

``````
func ensureUICap(etherObj map[string]any) {
	raw, _ := etherObj["capabilities"].([]any)
	for _, item := range raw {
		if item == "ui" {
			return
		}
	}
	if strs, ok := etherObj["capabilities"].([]string); ok {
		for _, s := range strs {
			if s == "ui" {
				return
			}
		}
		etherObj["capabilities"] = append(strs, "ui")
		return
	}
	etherObj["capabilities"] = append(raw, "ui")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#ViewerRequestPath

``````
// ViewerRequestPath identifies calls on a viewer's browse/search/playback path.
// Administrative actions, setup and background jobs use owner-granted limits.
func ViewerRequestPath(path string) bool {
	for _, prefix := range []string{"/stream/", "/catalog/", "/meta/", "/subtitles/", "/ether/open", "/ether/metadata/", "/ether/subtitles/", "/ether/markers"} {
		if strings.HasPrefix(path, prefix) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return strings.HasPrefix(path, "/ether/v1/kinds/")
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#WaitBackground

``````
// WaitBackground yields before starting work and at each host-service boundary.
func WaitBackground(ctx context.Context, busy func() bool) error {
	for busy != nil && busy() {
		timer := time.NewTimer(time.Second)
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			timer.Stop()
			return ctx.Err()
		case <-timer.C:
		}
	}
	return ctx.Err()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/background.go#limitsForRequest

``````
func limitsForRequest(l Limits, path string) Limits {
	if ViewerRequestPath(path) {
		l.Deadline = min(l.Deadline, 30*time.Second)
		l.UnitBudget = min(l.UnitBudget, int64(10000))
	}
	return l
}

// faultPrefix marks a classified fault inside a JS exception message, the
// same trick appkit-sandbox uses to carry faults across the boundary.
const faultPrefix = "__ETHER_FAULT__"
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#encodeFault

``````
func encodeFault(f *Fault) string {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]string{"code": f.Code, "message": f.Message})
	return faultPrefix + string(b)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#decodeFault

``````
func decodeFault(msg string) *Fault {
	at := strings.Index(msg, faultPrefix)
	if at < 0 {
		return nil
	}
	var f Fault
	// The payload may be followed by a JS stack trace; decode one value.
	dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(msg[at+len(faultPrefix):]))
	var raw struct {
		Code    string `json:"code"`
		Message string `json:"message"`
	}
	if dec.Decode(&raw) != nil || raw.Code == "" {
		return nil
	}
	f.Code, f.Message = raw.Code, raw.Message
	return &f
}
``````

var qjsOnce sync.Once

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#ensureQJS

``````
// ensureQJS creates the first QuickJS runtime in the process with
// CloseOnContextDone enabled. fastschema/qjs caches its wazero runtime
// config package-globally from the first New call, and context-driven
// module close is the only reliable way to interrupt a tight JS loop
// (its MaxExecutionTime does not interrupt one), so the first runtime
// must be ours.
func ensureQJS() {
	qjsOnce.Do(func() {
		defer func() { _ = recover() }()
		if rt, err := qjs.New(qjs.Option{Context: context.Background(), CloseOnContextDone: true,
			Stdout: io.Discard, Stderr: io.Discard}); err == nil {
			defer func() { _ = recover() }()
			rt.Close()
		}
	})
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#servicePrelude

``````
// servicePrelude builds the ether global for request-ABI instances. Host
// calls are synchronous functions backed by __ether_host, charged by the
// Go side; a Fault comes back as a thrown Error whose message carries the
// fault prefix, and ether.abort throws an aborted fault.
const servicePrelude = `
"use strict";
globalThis.ether = (() => {
  const call = (name, args) => JSON.parse(__ether_host(name, JSON.stringify(args)));
  const ether = {
    log: (...a) => { try { __ether_host("log", JSON.stringify(a.map(String))); } catch (e) {} },
    abort: (msg) => { throw new Error("__ETHER_FAULT__" + JSON.stringify({ code: "aborted", message: String(msg == null ? "aborted" : msg) })); },
    kv: { get: (k) => call("kv.get", [k]), put: (k, v) => call("kv.put", [k, v]),
          delete: (k) => call("kv.delete", [k]), list: (p) => call("kv.list", [p == null ? "" : p]) },
    settings: { get: () => call("settings.get", []) },
    secret: { get: (n) => call("secret.get", [n]) },
    http: { fetch: (req) => call("http.fetch", [req]), fetchToCache: (req) => call("http.fetchToCache", [req]) },

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#hotPrelude

``````
// hotPrelude locks a hot-path instance down: no host services except log
// and abort, Date fixed at the epoch, Math.random a seeded generator that
// __ether_rank_batch resets per batch. The monotonic clock is captured in
// a closure for budget checks, then hidden from plugin code.
//
// Budgets are measured with performance.now (WASI's monotonic clock), not
// Date.now: the wall clock counts whole milliseconds, can step, and on
// Windows advances only once per ~15.6 ms timer tick, so a 2 ms budget read
// from it flagged fast candidates that straddled a tick as slow. wazero
// backs the monotonic clock with QueryPerformanceCounter on Windows.
const hotPrelude = `
"use strict";
globalThis.ether = (() => {
  // Capture the monotonic clock for budget checks before it is replaced.
  // It lives only in this closure; plugin code sees the frozen Date and
  // performance below, and a host-function clock would cost a boundary
  // crossing per check.
  const now = performance.now.bind(performance);
  // The calling thread's CPU time in ms, or -1 without a CPU clock. Hidden
  // from plugin code like the monotonic clock.
  const cpu = typeof __ether_cpu_ms === "function" ? __ether_cpu_ms : () => -1;
  delete globalThis.__ether_cpu_ms;
  let state = 0x2545F491;
  const nextRandom = () => { state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7fffffff; return state / 0x80000000; };
  class FixedDate extends Date { constructor(...a) { super(...(a.length ? a : [0])); } static now() { return 0; } }
  globalThis.Date = FixedDate;
  globalThis.performance = Object.freeze({ now: () => 0, timeOrigin: 0 });
  Math.random = nextRandom;
  // A batch arrives in two calls. __ether_load_batch parses the facts and
  // the config or condition value: host work, run with the JSON functions
  // captured here so no plugin code runs in it, under its own deadline.
  // __ether_rank_batch and __ether_cond_batch then run the plugin over it.
  //
  // Budgets bound the plugin's own time (SPEC 5.2): each candidate gets
  // perMs, and the batch stops starting candidates once batchMs is spent;
  // the rest come back null (neutral, slow, not memoized). Wall time on a
  // busy host includes the time the thread sat descheduled, which is not
  // the plugin's. So the cheap monotonic clock is read first, and when it
  // says a budget is spent the thread's CPU clock decides: the batch goes on
  // while the plugin's CPU time is within budget, and a candidate over
  // budget by the wall clock runs once more and is slow only if that run's
  // CPU time is over budget too. Without a CPU clock the wall clock rules.
  const parse = JSON.parse, stringify = JSON.stringify;
  let batch = [], batchArg = null;
  globalThis.__ether_load_batch = (candsJson, argJson) => {
    batch = parse(candsJson);
    batchArg = parse(argJson);
    return batch.length;
  };
  const each = (perMs, batchMs, call, accept) => {
    const cands = batch;
    batch = [];
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) out.push(null);
    const wall0 = now(), cpu0 = cpu();
    for (let i = 0; i < cands.length; i++) {
      if (now() - wall0 > batchMs && (cpu0 < 0 || cpu() - cpu0 > batchMs)) break;
      let t0 = now(), v = call(cands[i]);
      if (now() - t0 > perMs) {
        // Over by the wall clock: run it again and judge the plugin's own time.
        const c0 = cpu();
        t0 = now();
        v = call(cands[i]);
        if (c0 < 0 ? now() - t0 > perMs : cpu() - c0 > perMs) continue;
      }
      out[i] = accept(v);
    }
    return stringify(out);
  };
  const score = (v) => (typeof v === "bigint" ? Number(v) : v);
  globalThis.__ether_rank_batch = (perMs, batchMs) => {
    state = 0x2545F491;
    const cfg = batchArg;
    return each(perMs, batchMs, (c) => rank_key(c, cfg), score);
  };
  globalThis.__ether_cond_batch = (op, perMs, batchMs) => {
    state = 0x2545F491;
    const value = batchArg;
    return each(perMs, batchMs, (c) => cond_match(c, op, value), (v) => !!v);
  };
  return {
    log: (...a) => { try { __ether_host("log", JSON.stringify(a.map(String))); } catch (e) {} },
    abort: (msg) => { throw new Error("__ETHER_FAULT__" + JSON.stringify({ code: "aborted", message: String(msg == null ? "aborted" : msg) })); },
  };
})();
globalThis.console = { log: (...a) => ether.log(...a), error: (...a) => ether.log(...a), warn: (...a) => ether.log(...a) };
`
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#exportProbe

``````
// exportProbe reports entry points and normalizes esbuild's IIFE exports
// (global name __plugin) onto globalThis so both authoring styles work.
const exportProbe = `
(() => {
  const pick = (n) => (typeof globalThis[n] === "function" ? globalThis[n]
    : (globalThis.__plugin && typeof globalThis.__plugin[n] === "function" ? globalThis.__plugin[n] : undefined));
  for (const n of ["handle", "rank_key", "cond_match"]) { const f = pick(n); if (f) globalThis[n] = f; }
  return JSON.stringify({ handle: typeof globalThis.handle === "function",
    rank_key: typeof globalThis.rank_key === "function",
    cond_match: typeof globalThis.cond_match === "function" });
})()
`

``````
// swapCtx is a context whose target can be swapped atomically per call.
// qjs calls wasm functions with its stored Context value; giving it a
// swapCtx lets one pooled instance take per-call deadlines (which close
// the module on expiry) without racing wazero's cancellation watcher.
type swapCtx struct {

}

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#newJSInstance

``````
func newJSInstance(ctx context.Context, source string, lim *Limits, hot bool, logger *slog.Logger, pluginID string) (in *jsInstance, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			in, err = nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: fmt.Sprintf("create JS instance: %v", r), Trap: true}
		}
	}()
	swap := newSwapCtx()
	initCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, lim.Deadline)
	defer cancel()
	swap.set(initCtx)
	defer swap.reset()
	rt, err2 := qjs.New(qjs.Option{Context: swap, CloseOnContextDone: true,
		MemoryLimit: int(lim.MemoryBytes), MaxStackSize: 1 << 20,
		Stdout: jsLogWriter{logger, pluginID}, Stderr: jsLogWriter{logger, pluginID}})
	if err2 != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "create JS runtime: " + err2.Error(), Trap: true}
	}
	in = &jsInstance{rt: rt, qc: rt.Context(), swap: swap, hot: hot}
	qc := in.qc
	qc.SetFunc("__ether_host", func(this *qjs.This) (*qjs.Value, error) {
		args := this.Args()
		if in.cs == nil || len(args) != 2 {
			return nil, errors.New(encodeFault(Forbidden("host call outside a plugin call")))
		}
		out, fault := in.cs.dispatch(args[0].String(), json.RawMessage(args[1].String()))
		if fault != nil {
			return nil, errors.New(encodeFault(fault))
		}
		return qc.NewString(string(out)), nil
	})
	prelude := servicePrelude
	if hot {
		prelude = hotPrelude
		qc.SetFunc("__ether_cpu_ms", func(*qjs.This) (*qjs.Value, error) {
			d, ok := threadCPU()
			if !ok {
				return qc.NewFloat64(-1), nil
			}
			return qc.NewFloat64(budgetMs(d)), nil
		})
	}
	if _, err := qc.Eval("ether-prelude.js", qjs.Code(prelude)); err != nil {
		in.closeInstance()
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "prelude: " + err.Error(), Trap: true}
	}
	if _, err := qc.Eval("plugin.js", qjs.Code(source)); err != nil {
		in.closeInstance()
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "load plugin: " + firstLine(err.Error()), Trap: false}
	}
	v, err := qc.Eval("ether-probe.js", qjs.Code(exportProbe))
	if err != nil {
		in.closeInstance()
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "probe exports: " + err.Error(), Trap: true}
	}
	var found struct {
		Handle    bool `json:"handle"`
		RankKey   bool `json:"rank_key"`
		CondMatch bool `json:"cond_match"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(v.String()), &found); err != nil {
		in.closeInstance()
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "probe exports: " + err.Error(), Trap: true}
	}
	in.instanceCaps = caps{Handle: found.Handle, RankKey: found.RankKey, CondMatch: found.CondMatch}
	return in, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.jsCall

``````
// jsCall runs fn with the call context installed, converting qjs panics
// (it panics when a deadline closes the module mid-call) into *Error.
func (in *jsInstance) jsCall(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, fn func() (*qjs.Value, error)) (val *qjs.Value, callErr *Error) {
	in.cs = cs
	in.swap.set(ctx)
	defer func() {
		in.cs = nil
		in.swap.reset()
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			val = nil
			if errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				callErr = &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "call exceeded its deadline", Trap: true}
				return
			}
			callErr = &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: fmt.Sprintf("%v", r), Trap: true}
		}
	}()
	v, err := fn()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, classifyJSError(ctx, err)
	}
	if v != nil && v.IsPromise() {
		v, err = v.Await()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, classifyJSError(ctx, err)
		}
	}
	return v, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#classifyJSError

``````
func classifyJSError(ctx context.Context, err error) *Error {
	if errors.Is(ctx.Err(), context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		return &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "call exceeded its deadline", Trap: true}
	}
	msg := err.Error()
	if f := decodeFault(msg); f != nil {
		st := statusForFaultCode(f.Code)
		return &Error{Status: st, Message: f.Message, Trap: st == StatusAborted}
	}
	if strings.Contains(msg, "module closed") || strings.Contains(msg, "interrupted") {
		return &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "call exceeded its deadline", Trap: true}
	}
	return &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: firstLine(msg)}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.handle

``````
func (in *jsInstance) handle(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, reqJSON []byte) ([]byte, *Error) {
	v, err := in.jsCall(ctx, cs, func() (*qjs.Value, error) {
		g := in.qc.Global()
		return in.qc.Invoke(in.globalFn("__ether_dispatch_handle"), g, in.qc.NewString(string(reqJSON)))
	})
	if err != nil {
		// Fall back to calling handle directly with a parsed object; the
		// dispatch wrapper is installed by installDispatch at load. If it is
		// missing this error is the real one.
		return nil, err
	}
	return []byte(v.String()), nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.rankOne

``````
func (in *jsInstance) rankOne(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, cand, cfg []byte) (int64, *Error) {
	unbounded := Limits{RankPerCandidate: 1 << 60, RankBatch: 1 << 60}
	scores, err := in.rankBatch(ctx, cs, [][]byte{cand}, cfg, &unbounded)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if scores[0] == nil {
		return 0, &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "candidate exceeded its budget", Trap: false}
	}
	return *scores[0], nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.loadBatch

``````
// loadBatch hands a batch's facts and its config (or condition value) to
// the instance: one parse of one JSON array, under its own deadline, so
// the host's share of a batch is never charged to the plugin.
func (in *jsInstance) loadBatch(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, cands [][]byte, arg []byte, lim *Limits) *Error {
	candsJSON, ferr := factsArray(cands)
	if ferr != nil {
		return ferr
	}
	loadCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, lim.hotKill())
	defer cancel()
	_, err := in.jsCall(loadCtx, cs, func() (*qjs.Value, error) {
		return in.qc.Invoke(in.globalFn("__ether_load_batch"), in.qc.Global(),
			in.qc.NewString(string(candsJSON)), in.qc.NewString(string(arg)))
	})
	return err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.rankBatch

``````
func (in *jsInstance) rankBatch(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, cands [][]byte, cfg []byte, lim *Limits) ([]*int64, *Error) {
	if err := in.loadBatch(ctx, cs, cands, cfg, lim); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, lim.hotKill())
	defer cancel()
	runtime.LockOSThread() // the budget reads this thread's CPU clock
	defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
	v, err := in.jsCall(runCtx, cs, func() (*qjs.Value, error) {
		return in.qc.Invoke(in.globalFn("__ether_rank_batch"), in.qc.Global(),
			in.qc.NewFloat64(budgetMs(lim.RankPerCandidate)), in.qc.NewFloat64(budgetMs(lim.RankBatch)))
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []*int64
	if uerr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(v.String()), &out); uerr != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "rank_key returned a non-numeric result: " + uerr.Error()}
	}
	if len(out) != len(cands) {
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "rank batch returned the wrong number of scores"}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#factsArray

``````
// factsArray joins candidate facts into one JSON array, parsed once per
// batch instead of once per candidate. Each fact must be one JSON value, so
// a malformed fact cannot shift the others' positions.
func factsArray(cands [][]byte) ([]byte, *Error) {
	n := 2
	for _, c := range cands {
		if !json.Valid(c) {
			return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "candidate facts are not valid JSON"}
		}
		n += len(c) + 1
	}
	b := make([]byte, 0, n)
	b = append(b, '[')
	for i, c := range cands {
		if i > 0 {
			b = append(b, ',')
		}
		b = append(b, c...)
	}
	return append(b, ']'), nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.condBatch

``````
func (in *jsInstance) condBatch(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, cands [][]byte, op string, val []byte, lim *Limits) ([]*bool, *Error) {
	if err := in.loadBatch(ctx, cs, cands, val, lim); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, lim.hotKill())
	defer cancel()
	runtime.LockOSThread() // the budget reads this thread's CPU clock
	defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
	v, err := in.jsCall(runCtx, cs, func() (*qjs.Value, error) {
		return in.qc.Invoke(in.globalFn("__ether_cond_batch"), in.qc.Global(), in.qc.NewString(op),
			in.qc.NewFloat64(budgetMs(lim.RankPerCandidate)), in.qc.NewFloat64(budgetMs(lim.RankBatch)))
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var out []*bool
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(v.String()), &out); err != nil || len(out) != len(cands) {
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "invalid condition batch result"}
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.condOne

``````
func (in *jsInstance) condOne(ctx context.Context, cs *callState, cand []byte, op string, val []byte) (bool, *Error) {
	v, err := in.jsCall(ctx, cs, func() (*qjs.Value, error) {
		g := in.qc.Global()
		c := in.qc.ParseJSON(string(cand))
		value := in.qc.ParseJSON(string(val))
		return in.qc.Invoke(in.globalFn("cond_match"), g, c, in.qc.NewString(op), value)
	})
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return v.Bool(), nil
}

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*Engine.LoadJS

``````
// LoadJS loads a JavaScript plugin (TypeScript authors go through Compile
// first). A probe instance is built eagerly so syntax errors and a missing
// handle surface at load.
func (e *Engine) LoadJS(id, version, source string, host Host, lim Limits) (*Plugin, error) {
	lim.normalize()
	e.scaleHot(&lim)
	p := &Plugin{id: id, version: version, eng: e, host: host, lim: lim, memo: newMemo(4096), source: source}
	makeSvc := func(ctx context.Context) (instance, error) {
		in, err := newJSInstance(ctx, source, &p.lim, false, e.logger, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if err := in.installDispatch(); err != nil {
			in.closeInstance()
			return nil, err
		}
		return in, nil
	}
	makeHot := func(ctx context.Context) (instance, error) {
		return newJSInstance(ctx, source, &p.lim, true, e.logger, id)
	}
	p.svc = newPool(lim.PoolSize, makeSvc)
	p.hot = newWarmPool(lim.PoolSize, makeHot)
	probe, err := p.svc.get(context.Background())
	if err != nil {
		p.Close()
		return nil, err
	}
	p.caps = probe.caps()
	p.svc.put(probe, true)
	if !p.caps.Handle && !p.caps.RankKey && !p.caps.CondMatch {
		p.Close()
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin defines none of handle, rank_key, cond_match"}
	}
	p.warmHot()
	return p, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/js.go#*jsInstance.installDispatch

``````
// installDispatch wraps handle so Go passes one JSON string and gets one
// JSON string back; the plugin sees plain objects either side.
func (in *jsInstance) installDispatch() (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: fmt.Sprintf("install dispatch: %v", r), Trap: true}
		}
	}()
	_, err2 := in.qc.Eval("ether-dispatch.js", qjs.Code(`
globalThis.__ether_dispatch_handle = (reqJson) => {
  const res = handle(JSON.parse(reqJson));
  if (res && typeof res.then === "function") return res.then((r) => JSON.stringify(r == null ? {} : r));
  return JSON.stringify(res == null ? {} : res);
};`))
	if err2 != nil {
		return &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "install dispatch: " + err2.Error(), Trap: true}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#DefaultRankPerCandidate

``````
const (
	// DefaultRankPerCandidate and DefaultRankBatch are the hot-path budgets
	// (SPEC §5.2). A manifest may lower them, never raise them.
	DefaultRankPerCandidate = 2 * time.Millisecond
	DefaultRankBatch        = 50 * time.Millisecond
	// WallUnitInterval is the wall time worth one unit.
	WallUnitInterval = 100 * time.Microsecond
	// BaseCallUnits is charged once per handle call.
	BaseCallUnits = 10
	// MaxMemoryBytes is the hard ceiling for a plugin instance.
	MaxMemoryBytes = 4 << 30
	// MaxResponseBytes caps a plugin response.
	MaxResponseBytes = 8 << 20
	// MaxFetchBodyBytes caps a direct HTTP response before JSON encoding.
	MaxFetchBodyBytes = 10 << 20
	// MaxHostResultBytes caps general results; http.fetch additionally permits
	// the worst-case JSON encoding of MaxFetchBodyBytes plus header space.
	MaxHostResultBytes = 4 << 20
	maxLogsPerCall     = 100
)
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#Limits

``````
// Limits bound one plugin. Zero fields take the defaults in normalize.
type Limits struct {
	MemoryBytes uint64        // per instance; default 32 MiB, max wasm32 4 GiB
	Deadline    time.Duration // per handle call; default 30s
	UnitBudget  int64         // per handle call; default 10000
	Busy        func() bool   // background work yields while playback or host load is high
	PoolSize    int           // instances per pool; default 2
	// Hot-path budgets. A manifest may lower these, never raise them:
	// normalize clamps to the defaults below.
	RankPerCandidate time.Duration // default (and max) 2ms
	RankBatch        time.Duration // default (and max) 50ms
	Costs            map[string]int64
	// unclamped lets this package's tests raise the hot-path budgets so
	// correctness checks do not depend on machine speed. Other packages
	// cannot set it, so production budgets are always clamped.
	unclamped bool
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Limits.normalize

``````
func (l *Limits) normalize() {
	if l.MemoryBytes == 0 || l.MemoryBytes > MaxMemoryBytes {
		if l.MemoryBytes == 0 {
			l.MemoryBytes = 32 << 20
		} else {
			l.MemoryBytes = MaxMemoryBytes
		}
	}
	if l.Deadline <= 0 {
		l.Deadline = 30 * time.Second
	}
	if l.Deadline > 365*24*time.Hour {
		l.Deadline = 365 * 24 * time.Hour
	}
	if l.UnitBudget <= 0 {
		l.UnitBudget = 10000
	}
	if l.PoolSize <= 0 {
		l.PoolSize = 2
	}
	if l.RankPerCandidate <= 0 || (l.RankPerCandidate > DefaultRankPerCandidate && !l.unclamped) {
		l.RankPerCandidate = DefaultRankPerCandidate
	}
	if l.RankBatch <= 0 || (l.RankBatch > DefaultRankBatch && !l.unclamped) {
		l.RankBatch = DefaultRankBatch
	}
	if l.Costs == nil {
		l.Costs = DefaultCosts
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Limits.hotKill

``````
// hotKill is the hard deadline of one hot-path call: the point where the
// instance is killed because plugin code stopped returning (an endless
// loop). It is not the plugin's budget. The budgets bound the plugin's own
// time and are enforced softly between candidates (see hotPrelude), so a
// batch that keeps to them ends normally; the deadline only has to catch
// code that never yields back. It sits one batch budget past the batch
// budget so the host's own work for the call (encoding and parsing the
// facts) and a busy machine's scheduling pauses cannot turn a well-behaved
// batch into a killed one. A JavaScript batch takes the deadline twice:
// once for the host to hand over the facts, once for the plugin's code.
// When the kill and the budget were the same
// instant, the batch lost every score it had already computed, nothing was
// memoized, and the next resolve started from zero and timed out again.
func (l *Limits) hotKill() time.Duration { return 2 * l.RankBatch }
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Limits.costOf

``````
func (l *Limits) costOf(name string) int64 {
	if c, ok := l.Costs[name]; ok {
		return c
	}
	return 25 // unpriced service: charge a middle rate, never free
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*counters.record

``````
func (c *counters) record(o Outcome) {
	c.calls.Add(1)
	c.units.Add(o.Units)
	c.slow.Add(int64(o.SlowCandidates))
	if o.Trap {
		c.traps.Add(1)
	}
	switch o.Status {
	case StatusError:
		c.errors.Add(1)
	case StatusTimeout:
		c.timeouts.Add(1)
	case StatusForbidden:
		c.forbidden.Add(1)
	case StatusAborted:
		c.aborted.Add(1)
	case StatusGovernance:
		c.governance.Add(1)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#callState

``````
// callState is the per-call governance state shared with host functions. One
// instance serves one call at a time, so no locking is needed beyond the
// exceeded flag (read after the call from the same goroutine).
type callState struct {
	ctx        context.Context
	host       Host
	lim        *Limits
	start      time.Time
	last       time.Time
	units      int64
	logs       int
	background bool
	hot        bool
	exceeded   bool
	aborted    bool
	abortCode  uint32
	logger     *slog.Logger
	pluginID   string
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*callState.chargeWall

``````
func (cs *callState) chargeWall() {
	now := time.Now()
	cs.units += int64(now.Sub(cs.last) / WallUnitInterval)
	cs.last = now
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*callState.charge

``````
// charge accounts one host call. It returns a governance Fault when the
// budget is spent; the flag is sticky so a plugin that catches the error
// still ends the call as governance.
func (cs *callState) charge(name string) *Fault {
	cs.chargeWall()
	cs.units += cs.lim.costOf(name)
	if cs.units > cs.lim.UnitBudget {
		cs.exceeded = true
		return &Fault{Code: string(StatusGovernance),
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("governance budget exceeded (%d/%d units)", cs.units, cs.lim.UnitBudget)}
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*callState.finishUnits

``````
func (cs *callState) finishUnits() int64 {
	cs.chargeWall()
	if cs.units > cs.lim.UnitBudget {
		cs.exceeded = true
	}
	return cs.units
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*callState.dispatch

``````
// dispatch runs one host service for a guest, applying governance and the
// hot-path lockdown. It is the single funnel for JS ether.* and raw
// ether.host_call.
func (cs *callState) dispatch(name string, args json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage, *Fault) {
	if cs.background {
		waitedAt := time.Now()
		if err := WaitBackground(cs.ctx, cs.lim.Busy); err != nil {
			return nil, &Fault{Code: string(StatusTimeout), Message: err.Error()}
		}
		cs.last = cs.last.Add(time.Since(waitedAt))
	}
	if cs.hot && name != "log" {
		return nil, Forbidden("host services are not available on the hot path: " + name)
	}
	if name == "log" {
		cs.logs++
		if cs.logs > maxLogsPerCall {
			return json.RawMessage("null"), nil // rate-limited: drop quietly
		}
		if f := cs.charge(name); f != nil {
			return nil, f
		}
		if cs.host != nil {
			_, _ = cs.host.CallHost(cs.ctx, name, args)
		} else {
			cs.logger.Debug("plugin log", "plugin", cs.pluginID, "args", string(args))
		}
		return json.RawMessage("null"), nil
	}
	if f := cs.charge(name); f != nil {
		return nil, f
	}
	if cs.host == nil {
		return nil, Forbidden("no host services are configured for this plugin")
	}
	out, err := cs.host.CallHost(cs.ctx, name, args)
	// Time spent waiting on the host (a network fetch, a catalogue query) is
	// paid by the call's own unit price, not as guest wall time; otherwise
	// one slow upstream response spent the whole budget. The call deadline
	// still bounds the total.
	cs.last = time.Now()
	if err != nil {
		if f, ok := err.(*Fault); ok {
			return nil, f
		}
		return nil, &Fault{Code: "host_error", Message: err.Error()}
	}
	limit := MaxHostResultBytes
	// JSON can escape each text byte as six bytes. HTTPFetch bounds the raw
	// body to 10 MiB; leave room for its headers and JSON envelope.
	if name == "http.fetch" {
		limit = (6 * MaxFetchBodyBytes) + (1 << 20)
	}
	if len(out) > limit {
		return nil, &Fault{Code: "host_error", Message: "host result exceeds size cap"}
	}
	if len(out) == 0 {
		out = json.RawMessage("null")
	}
	return out, nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#pool

``````
// pool lends instances up to size, discarding poisoned ones so crash
// policy (backoff, disable) can count fresh failures.
//
// A service pool builds on demand under the caller's context: a handle
// call has a seconds-long deadline, and a cold build fits in it.
//
// A warm pool (the hot path) never builds on the caller's path. Building
// an instance costs milliseconds (a QuickJS runtime is several), more than
// the 2ms per-candidate and 50ms per-batch budgets, so building inline
// would make the first concurrent call, and every call after a discarded
// instance, time out; on a slow host the hot path then never recovers.
// Instead the pool is filled at load, a discarded instance is replaced in
// the background under the service deadline, and a caller only ever waits
// for an idle instance within its own budget.
type pool struct {
	makeFn func(context.Context) (instance, error)
	idle   chan instance
	slots  chan struct{} // one token per live instance: idle, lent or building
	warm   bool
	mu     sync.Mutex // orders returning an instance against close
	done   atomic.Bool
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#newPool

``````
func newPool(size int, makeFn func(context.Context) (instance, error)) *pool {
	return &pool{makeFn: makeFn, idle: make(chan instance, size), slots: make(chan struct{}, size)}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#newWarmPool

``````
func newWarmPool(size int, makeFn func(context.Context) (instance, error)) *pool {
	p := newPool(size, makeFn)
	p.warm = true
	return p
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.get

``````
func (p *pool) get(ctx context.Context) (instance, error) {
	if p.done.Load() {
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin is closed"}
	}
	select {
	case in := <-p.idle:
		return in, nil
	default:
	}
	if p.warm {
		// A free slot means an earlier build failed; retry it off-path.
		p.refill()
		select {
		case in := <-p.idle:
			return in, nil
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return nil, &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "timed out waiting for a plugin instance"}
		}
	}
	select {
	case in := <-p.idle:
		return in, nil
	case p.slots <- struct{}{}:
		in, err := p.makeFn(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			<-p.slots
			return nil, err
		}
		return in, nil
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return nil, &Error{Status: StatusTimeout, Message: "timed out waiting for a plugin instance"}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.put

``````
func (p *pool) put(in instance, healthy bool) {
	if !healthy {
		in.closeInstance()
		<-p.slots
		if p.warm {
			p.refill()
		}
		return
	}
	p.adopt(in)
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.adopt

``````
// adopt returns a usable instance to the idle set, or closes it when the
// pool is closed or already full.
func (p *pool) adopt(in instance) {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	if !p.done.Load() {
		select {
		case p.idle <- in:
			return
		default:
		}
	}
	in.closeInstance()
	<-p.slots
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.fill

``````
// fill builds instances synchronously until the pool is full or a build
// fails. Plugins call it at load, off any request path.
func (p *pool) fill() {
	for !p.done.Load() {
		select {
		case p.slots <- struct{}{}:
		default:
			return
		}
		in, err := p.makeFn(context.Background())
		if err != nil {
			<-p.slots
			return
		}
		p.adopt(in)
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.refill

``````
// refill builds one replacement in the background if a slot is free. The
// slot is held while building, so builds never exceed the pool size.
func (p *pool) refill() {
	if p.done.Load() {
		return
	}
	select {
	case p.slots <- struct{}{}:
	default:
		return
	}
	go func() {
		in, err := p.makeFn(context.Background())
		if err != nil {
			<-p.slots
			return
		}
		p.adopt(in)
	}()
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*pool.close

``````
func (p *pool) close() {
	p.mu.Lock()
	defer p.mu.Unlock()
	p.done.Store(true)
	for {
		select {
		case in := <-p.idle:
			in.closeInstance()
			<-p.slots
		default:
			return
		}
	}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#Engine

``````
// Engine compiles and caches guest code and builds Plugins. It owns the
// wazero runtimes used by raw modules; JavaScript instances manage their
// own (QuickJS) modules. Safe for concurrent use.
type Engine struct {
	logger *slog.Logger
	mu     sync.Mutex
	raw    map[uint32]*rawRuntime // by memory-limit pages
	closed bool
	// speedLog logs the engine's measured speed once (see HotScale).
	speedLog sync.Once
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#NewEngine

``````
func NewEngine(logger *slog.Logger) *Engine {
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ensureQJS()
	return &Engine{logger: logger, raw: map[uint32]*rawRuntime{}}
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Engine.Close

``````
func (e *Engine) Close() error {
	e.mu.Lock()
	defer e.mu.Unlock()
	e.closed = true
	for _, rt := range e.raw {
		_ = rt.rt.Close(context.Background())
	}
	e.raw = map[uint32]*rawRuntime{}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#Plugin

``````
// Plugin is one loaded hosted plugin. Call serves the request ABI;
// RankBatch and CondMatch serve the hot path. Safe for concurrent use.
type Plugin struct {
	id, version string
	eng         *Engine
	host        Host
	lim         Limits
	caps        caps
	svc         *pool
	hot         *pool
	stats       counters
	memo        *memo
	source      string // JS source (rebuild counts / cold start), raw: ""
	closed      atomic.Bool
}
``````

// Budgets reports the plugin's effective hot-path budgets: the manifest's
// (lowered, never raised), scaled by the engine's measured speed.
func (p *Plugin) Budgets() (perCandidate, perBatch time.Duration) {
	return p.lim.RankPerCandidate, p.lim.RankBatch
}

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Plugin.Close

``````
func (p *Plugin) Close() error {
	if p.closed.Swap(true) {
		return nil
	}
	if p.svc != nil {
		p.svc.close()
	}
	if p.hot != nil {
		p.hot.close()
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Plugin.Call

``````
// Call runs the request ABI. The returned error, when non-nil, is a *Error
// classified for the host's health loop.
func (p *Plugin) Call(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Response, error) {
	resp, _, err := p.CallDetailed(ctx, req)
	return resp, err
}
``````

## Source: internal/plugins/wasm/wasm.go#*Plugin.CallDetailed

``````
// CallDetailed is Call plus the Outcome (units, duration, trap flag).
func (p *Plugin) CallDetailed(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Response, Outcome, error) {
	start := time.Now()
	out := Outcome{Status: StatusOK}
	defer func() {
		out.Duration = time.Since(start)
		p.stats.record(out)
	}()
	if p.closed.Load() {
		out.Status = StatusError
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin is closed"}
	}
	if !p.caps.Handle {
		out.Status = StatusError
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin does not export handle"}
	}
	reqJSON, err := json.Marshal(req)
	if err != nil {
		out.Status = StatusError
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: err.Error()}
	}
	lim := limitsForRequest(p.lim, req.Path)
	callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, lim.Deadline)
	defer cancel()
	cs := &callState{ctx: callCtx, host: p.host, lim: &lim, start: start, last: start,
		background: strings.HasPrefix(req.Path, "/ether/job/"),
		units:      BaseCallUnits, logger: p.eng.logger, pluginID: p.id}
	in, err := p.svc.get(callCtx)
	if err != nil {
		out.Status = StatusTimeout
		if e, ok := err.(*Error); ok {
			out.Status = e.Status
		}
		return Response{}, out, err
	}
	// Waiting for a free instance is the host's queue, not the plugin's
	// work: concurrent calls (a metadata sweep) must not spend the budget
	// of the call at the back of the line.
	cs.last = time.Now()
	respJSON, callErr := in.handle(callCtx, cs, reqJSON)
	out.Units = cs.finishUnits()
	healthy := callErr == nil || !callErr.Trap
	if callErr != nil && callErr.Status == StatusTimeout {
		healthy = false
	}
	p.svc.put(in, healthy)
	if callErr != nil {
		out.Status, out.Trap = callErr.Status, callErr.Trap
		return Response{}, out, callErr
	}
	if cs.exceeded {
		out.Status = StatusGovernance
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusGovernance, Message: "governance budget exceeded"}
	}
	if len(respJSON) > MaxResponseBytes {
		out.Status = StatusError
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin response exceeds size cap"}
	}
	var resp Response
	if err := json.Unmarshal(respJSON, &resp); err != nil {
		out.Status = StatusError
		return Response{}, out, &Error{Status: StatusError, Message: "plugin returned invalid response JSON: " + err.Error()}
	}
	if resp.Status == 0 {
		resp.Status = 200
	}
	return resp, out, nil
}
``````
