## Source: sdk/AGENTS.md

# Build an Ether plugin

## The mental model (read this first)

A plugin is a manifest plus a request handler. **Kind** decides where the owner
finds it; **capabilities** advertise behavior; **contributes** describes that
behavior; **permissions** request access. A capability never grants permission.
Hosted TypeScript/JavaScript runs in QuickJS inside wazero, not Node: no process,
filesystem, npm resolution, or direct network. Export `handle(req)` returning
`{status, headers?, body}`. Use the synchronous permission-checked `ether` global.
Bundle SDK imports before packaging. Go/Python can run as HTTP/tunnel sidecars;
remote plugins have their own OS permissions and cannot use hosted folders or
SecretGet. Read current settings per request; persist state in KV, not globals.
Start with one useful result. Do work only on a viewer/owner request or an
explicitly configured job; page results and bound work so playback comes first.

The schema and generated reference are authoritative. Do not invent APIs from
method names. Open `/ether/plugins/reference/getting-started` in your server,
then search for the exact symbol. [Reference maintenance](../docs/plugin-developer-reference.md).

## Files

```text
my-plugin/
  manifest.json               # identity, runtime, permissions, contributions
  src/index.ts                # hosted handler (or plugin.py for a sidecar)
  dist/plugin.js              # compiled hosted artifact, generated by pack/load
  settings.schema.json        # referenced by ether.settings.$ref
  i18n/en.json                # English fallback for every $t:key
  assets/icon.svg             # optional icon
  tests/fixtures.json         # recorded request/expected-response cases
  README.md                   # setup and permission explanation
```

Paths in the manifest are package-relative and must stay inside the package.
Never ship credentials, node_modules, private media, or absolute local paths.

## First run: exact commands

From an Ether checkout, build the CLI once (pure Go):

```sh
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o ./ether ./cmd/ether
./ether plugin new catalogue --lang ts ./my-plugin
./ether plugin check ./my-plugin
./ether plugin test ./my-plugin
./ether plugin pack -o ./my-plugin.etherpkg ./my-plugin
```

With a **local development server you control** already running, set ETHER_TOKEN
to its admin token in your shell and run:

```sh
./ether plugin dev ./my-plugin --server http://localhost:32400
# Save src/index.ts: compile, install, and read logs. Ctrl-C stops watching.
# One install without a watcher:
./ether plugin dev ./my-plugin --server http://localhost:32400 --once
```

Alternatively open Plugins → Add plugin and upload `my-plugin.etherpkg`. Review
requested permissions and enable it. Do not use a production server for iteration.
`check --json` is the structured report for agents. `dev` installs hosted
packages; remote Python/Go sidecars must run separately and be connected by
manifest URL or tunnel. `test` also runs recorded
fixtures; ETHER_BIN enables its headless integration check, ETHER_PLUGIN_URL tests
an already running remote sidecar. `pack` compiles TypeScript and checks the
package. No separate npm install is needed for generated hosted templates.

## Manifest decisions

| Field | What to set |
|---|---|
| id, version, name | Stable lower-case reverse DNS ID, SemVer, readable name (≤60 characters) |
| description | Sentence case, ≤300 characters |
| types, resources, catalogs, idPrefixes | Stremio types, routes, catalog IDs and identifier prefixes actually served |
| ether.protocol | `1` |
| ether.kind | `source`, `integration`, `notification_channel`, `livetv_source`, `extension`, or `content` |
| ether.capabilities | Only implemented capabilities; the validator checks allowed kinds |
| ether.summary | ≤80 characters, or `$t:summary` with English fallback |
| ether.runtime | Hosted: `{kind:"hosted",entry:"src/index.ts"}` (or WASM `module`); remote: `{kind:"remote"}` |
| ether.permissions | Network hostnames (not URLs), catalog `read`, collections `write`, folders `read`, named secrets, viewers, sources `search`/`acquire`; omit access you do not need |
| ether.settings | Inline `{fields:[...]}` or `{"$ref":"settings.schema.json"}` |
| ether.strings | Locale → package file or inline object; `en` required for `$t:` labels |
| ether.contributes | Capability descriptors, pages, slots, commands, setup steps, mediaKinds; see generated types |
| ether.schedule | `[{every:"1h",call:"/ether/refresh"}]`; intervals ≥15 minutes, bounded idempotent work |
| ether.cluster | `leader` (default), or `every_node` only when each node must run it |
| ether.health | Optional interval ≥15 seconds |
| ether.author, license, repo, icon | Attribution, SPDX license, repository URL, SVG path |
| ether.sidecar | Remote launch instructions: docker, download, command, docs |
| ether.stremio | `true` for a native plugin that retains Stremio add-on routes |

Copy rules apply to contribution labels too: sentence case, no exclamation marks,
no em/en dashes, no “simply”, “just”, or “easily”. Setting secrets are sealed by
Ether; read with SecretGet only where needed, never echo them into views/logs.

## Capability → routes → host services

| Capability | Plugin surface | Host services commonly needed |
|---|---|---|
| list_source | contributes.listSources + `/catalog/{type}/{id}.json` | HTTPFetch, CatalogSearch/Get, KV |
| catalog_provider | mediaKinds; paged browse/changes or push | KindUpsert/Delete/Items, KV |
| kind_resolver / matcher | kind resolve/match handlers | ResolveSources, CachePut/Open; sources permission |
| stream_source / debrid_provider | Stremio stream; lazy open / debrid routes | HTTPFetch, SecretGet |
| metadata | `/meta/{type}/{id}.json`, contributes.metadata | HTTPFetch, CatalogGet |
| notify / events | notify send/test; event subscription + acknowledgement | HTTPFetch, SecretGet, KV for deduplication |
| ui / tools | ViewSpec page/action or declared tool | Settings, KV; grant only data the action needs |
| livetv_channels | channels, guide, stream | HTTPFetch, KV |
| subtitles / markers | subtitle or marker routes and descriptors | HTTPFetch; download only after viewer picks |
| ranking_step / rule_condition | `rank_key` / `cond_match` | Log/abort only: deterministic, no I/O or clock |
| plugin_directory | declared add-on directories | HTTPFetch |
| frontend_adapter | authenticated protocol routes | StreamURL for own items; Ether serves bytes |
| onair_content / livetv_pack | declared feeds/segments/TV packs | Only services the handler actually needs |

Settings, KV, Log and NotifyOwner do not require an extra behavior capability.
FoldersList/Stat/Hash need `folders:read` plus an owner-selected root; they return
metadata/digests, not bytes. Viewer access requires that viewer's grant.
Host calls enforce permissions again on every request; revocation is immediate.

## Ten recipes

Commands below run from the repo root. Existing examples are living recipes;
keep their relative SDK imports at the same directory depth, bundle before
shipping, change the reverse-DNS ID before installing a copy alongside its source.
Read the named handler and its manifest together. Run `./ether plugin check DIR`
and `./ether plugin pack DIR` after editing each recipe.

### 1. Catalogue source

```sh
./ether plugin new --kind integration --lang ts ./my-catalogue
```

Or run `./ether plugin new catalogue ./my-catalogue` for a starter that already
returns The Matrix. Replace the generated `/catalog/` branch's empty `metas` with a small bounded
list of `{id:"tt0133093",type:"movie",name:"The Matrix"}`. Keep the listSources
catalog ID (`featured`) aligned with `/catalog/movie/featured.json`. Full typed
catalogue/meta handlers: `sdk/examples/hello/typescript/plugin.ts`.

### 2. A content kind library

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/kind-library sdk/examples/my-library
./ether plugin check sdk/examples/my-library
```

Edit mediaKinds levels, fields and presentation, then the browse/changes/resolve
handlers in `src/plugin.ts`. Keep cursor pages bounded and item IDs stable. Read
[Content kinds](../docs/plugin-kinds.md) before changing resolve or container semantics.

### 3. Resolver / playable source

```sh
./ether plugin new --kind source --lang ts ./my-source
```

Fill `/stream/{type}/{id}.json` with `{streams:[{url:"https://YOUR_HOST/video.mp4"}]}`
using an owner-configured source, not hard-coded credentials. Declare YOUR_HOST
in network permissions if the plugin fetches it. Return lazy stream descriptors
for work that should happen only on a viewer pick. See `sdk/examples/easydebrid`.

### 4. Notification channel

```sh
./ether plugin new --kind notification_channel --lang ts ./my-notifier
```

Implement the notify send and send-test handlers; the generated event handler
shows acknowledgement IDs. Declare webhook hosts and named secrets. Deduplicate
events by ID before sending; a retried outbox delivery must not send twice.

### 5. Page and action

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/movie-night sdk/examples/my-page
./ether plugin check sdk/examples/my-page
```

Edit the ViewSpec and action in `src/plugin.ts`. Keep labels in i18n files and
use stable action IDs. This example saves a shortlist in KV on an explicit pick;
opening a page should read saved data, not repeatedly scan the catalogue.

### 6. Scheduled job

```sh
./ether plugin new job --lang ts ./my-job
```

The job recipe includes `ether.schedule: [{"every":"1h","call":"/ether/refresh"}]` to the manifest
and a handler for that path. Store a cursor/etag in KV and process a bounded batch per
run. Do not create timers in plugin code. Cache external results; keep the job
unconfigured until the owner needs it. Settings changes must be read each run.

### 7. Settings and setup steps

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/kind-library sdk/examples/my-setup
```

Edit `settings.schema.json`, `contributes.setup.steps`, and `/ether/v1/setup/…/test`
together. Required setup gates library sync until passed or owner-skipped. Use
field-keyed validation errors, never secrets in test responses. The generated
integration template also demonstrates `$ref` settings with translated labels.

### 8. Folder reader

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/local-folders sdk/examples/my-folders
```

Follow `plugin.ts`: ask for a folder setting and `folders:read`, walk only that
root, store an index in KV, and rescan on the owner's action. Owner-selected root
handles are not arbitrary paths. Hash large files with the pollable hash API;
never block a playback request to hash or walk a tree.

### 9. Metadata and artwork

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/hello sdk/examples/my-metadata
```

Use `typescript/plugin.ts`'s meta route (or `go/plugin.go`) as the typed starting
point. Return supported poster/background URLs in metadata. For a canonical
metadata provider add the `metadata` capability and its descriptor from the
reference. **`artwork` is reserved**: do not claim it as a capability. Hosted
requests for images require their hostname in network permissions.

### 10. Stremio-style add-on bridge

```sh
cp -R sdk/examples/hello sdk/examples/my-addon
```

The typed hello implementations serve catalog/meta/subtitles routes. A plain
Stremio manifest without `ether` is already supported: install its manifest URL
through Add plugin. If you add native Ether settings/UI, retain the Stremio
fields and set `ether.stremio:true`; Ether derives roles from those resources.
Do not rewrite IDs or response envelopes. Go sidecar from the copied example:

```sh
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./sdk/examples/my-addon/go/...
# Original runnable sidecar:
CGO_ENABLED=0 go run ./sdk/examples/hello/go/cmd
```

## Fast fixes

| Symptom | Why / exact next step |
|---|---|
| Unknown capability / wrong kind | Check the capability table and change ether.kind or remove the unsupported capability; artwork/ratings are reserved |
| Cannot import module in hosted runtime | Bundle local SDK imports into the entry artifact; no npm resolution in QuickJS |
| `ether` / process / fs unavailable | Use hosted host services, or choose a remote sidecar for OS APIs |
| Permission denied | Declare the exact permission/hostname, reinstall, then have the owner grant it; never retry around revocation |
| Missing settings/strings file | Include the $ref/i18n path inside the package; run check again |
| Empty content library | Complete required setup, enable the plugin, check sync cursors and its mediaKind descriptors |
| Conformance route failed | Read rule + field + route; implement its exact response shape from Reference → Capabilities, then rerun check |
| Dev 401/403 | Set ETHER_TOKEN to the local server's admin token and review its requested grants |
| Dev connection refused | Start your local server and pass its actual --server URL/port |
| Dev install conflicts | Check existing plugin ID/version; do not change identity on every save |
| Labels rejected | Sentence case, length limits, no banned words/punctuation; translate every referenced key |

Before reporting success: review the diff, compile the chosen language, run
conformance, package, and check the visible result on your own development server.
Never claim offline conformance proves playback on a real client. New host
services belong in the generated reference source list and this service map;
regenerate the reference instead of duplicating contracts in prose.


## Source: sdk/catalogue-template/README.md

# Ether catalogue template

Set the repository variable `ETHER_REF` to an immutable Ether release tag or commit that includes `ether plugin check` and `ether-release-sign index -check`. The workflow installs both tools from that ref. Set the `ETHER_CATALOGUE_PRIVATE_KEY` and `ETHER_CATALOGUE_PUBLIC_KEY` repository secrets to the base64 Ed25519 signing key and corresponding public key. Keep the private key secret. Pull requests validate without access to signing secrets; pushes to `main` sign and upload `index.json` and `index.json.sig` as a workflow artifact. Publish both files together at the URL configured in Ether.

Add one reviewed YAML file per plugin under `plugins/`; `examples/` contains an illustrative file with placeholder URLs and checksums. Each version must reference a publicly downloadable `.etherpkg` and its SHA-256 digest. CI downloads every non-revoked version, verifies the digest and identity, and runs `ether plugin check` on its unpacked files. The command runs the conformance kit, including copy lint. The index compiler also validates catalogue copy. A revoked entry requires a reason; it is retained in the signed index and its packages are not executed by CI.

Review permissions for each version. A version may override the entry-level permissions using its own `permissions` field. Ether verifies that the package does not request more than the reviewed permissions before marking it verified. Never use the sample values as a real catalogue entry.

## Source: sdk/examples/dub-language/README.md

# Dub language

Adds a release ranking step and a language condition. In Releases, add the step to a profile and enter ISO language codes in preference order. The first matching language wins; MULTi counts for every selected language. Conditions accept an ISO code or list of codes.

Screenshot placeholder: Releases profile drawer showing the ordered audio languages and the step in the ranking ladder.

## Limits

Release names and indexer language tags are imperfect. A language tag does not prove that a track is a dub, and DUB alone does not identify its language. Untagged releases receive no preference. This plugin makes no network calls.

## Source: sdk/examples/dub-language/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, type Manifest, type CandidateFacts } from '../../typescript/src/index.ts';
import manifest from './manifest.json' with { type: 'json' };

type Config = { value?: string[] };
const aliases: Record<string,string> = { english:'en', eng:'en', french:'fr', fre:'fr', fra:'fr', german:'de', ger:'de', deu:'de', spanish:'es', spa:'es', italian:'it', ita:'it', japanese:'ja', jpn:'ja', portuguese:'pt', por:'pt', korean:'ko', kor:'ko', chinese:'zh', chi:'zh', zho:'zh', hindi:'hi', hin:'hi' };
// normalize maps a language name, ISO code or regional variant
// ("spanish-latino", "pt-BR") to its two-letter base.
function normalize(s: string): string {
  let v = s.toLowerCase().trim();
  const dash = v.indexOf('-');
  if (dash > 0) v = v.slice(0, dash);
  return aliases[v] || v;
}
// available reads the audio languages Ether parsed from the release name
// and indexer tags. Ether's parser skips title words ("The French
// Dispatch") that a token scan would count, and re-reading the name here
// cost most of the step's time: ranking runs on the hot path, where a
// 500-release batch shares one 50 ms budget.
function available(c: CandidateFacts): Set<string> {
  const langs = new Set<string>();
  const list = c.languages || [];
  for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) langs.add(normalize(list[i]));
  return langs;
}
function speaks(langs: Set<string>, lang: string): boolean {
  const target = normalize(lang);
  return !!target && (langs.has(target) || langs.has('multi'));
}
export const dubPlugin = plugin<Config>({ manifest: manifest as Manifest, routes: {
  rankKey(c, cfg) {
    const wanted = Array.isArray(cfg?.value) ? cfg.value : [];
    if (wanted.length === 0) return 0;
    const langs = available(c);
    for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) if (speaks(langs, wanted[i])) return wanted.length - i;
    return 0;
  },
  condMatch(c, op, value) {
    if (op === 'equals') return typeof value === 'string' && speaks(available(c), value);
    if (op === 'in') { const values = Array.isArray(value) ? value : typeof value === 'string' ? value.split(',') : []; const langs = available(c); return values.some(v => typeof v === 'string' && speaks(langs, v)); }
    return false;
  }
}});
export const handle = dubPlugin.handle;
export const rank_key = dubPlugin.rank_key;
export const cond_match = dubPlugin.cond_match;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/easydebrid/src/plugin.ts

``````
function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function token(){try{return String(ether.secret.get('apiKey')||'').trim();}catch{return '';}}
function fail(status:number,message:string):never{throw {status,message};}
function api(path:string,body?:any){const key=token();if(!key)fail(401,'Add an EasyDebrid API token in Setup.');const r=ether.http.fetch({url:'https://easydebrid.com/api/v1'+path,method:body?'POST':'GET',headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'},...(body?{body:JSON.stringify(body)}:{})});if(r.status<200||r.status>=300)fail(r.status===401||r.status===403?401:r.status===429?429:502,'EasyDebrid request failed (HTTP '+r.status+').');try{return typeof r.body==='string'?JSON.parse(r.body):r.body;}catch{fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned invalid JSON.');}}
function magnet(h:string){if(!/^[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$/.test(h))fail(400,'A valid torrent info hash is required.');return 'magnet:?xt=urn:btih:'+h.toLowerCase();}
function files(hash:string){const result=api('/link/generate',{url:magnet(hash)});if(!Array.isArray(result.files))fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned no file list.');return result.files.map((f:any)=>{const path=[...(Array.isArray(f.directory)?f.directory:[]),f.filename].filter(Boolean).join('/');return {id:path,path,size:Number(f.size)||0,link:String(f.url||'')};}).filter((f:any)=>f.path&&f.size>0);}
function account(){const a=api('/user/details');const day=String(a.paid_until||'');const end=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)?day+'T23:59:59Z':day;const ms=Date.parse(end);return {user:String(a.id||''),premium:Number.isFinite(ms)&&ms>Date.now(),...(Number.isFinite(ms)?{expires:new Date(ms).toISOString()}:{})};}
export function handle(req:any){try{
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return ok({errors:{}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:token()?'ok':'attention',reason:token()?'':'Add an EasyDebrid API token in Setup.'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/test'||req.path==='/ether/action/test'){const a=account();const message=a.premium?'EasyDebrid account connected; premium access is active.':'Account connected, but premium access is expired or unavailable.';return ok(req.path==='/ether/test'?{ok:a.premium,message}:{toast:message,refresh:true});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/account')return ok({title:'EasyDebrid',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'key',accent:'primary',label:'$t:state',value:{$:'state'}},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:connection',blocks:[{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.actionButton',props:{label:'$t:test',action:'test'}}]},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:capabilities',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:help'},{kind:'text',content:'$t:docs'}]}]},data:{title:'EasyDebrid',subtitle:'A native plugin source in Sources → Debrid. Configure your account in Plugins → EasyDebrid → Setup, then run the connection test.',state:token()?'Token saved; test account':'Setup required'}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/account')return ok(account());
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/find'||req.path==='/ether/debrid/remove')return {status:501,body:{error:{code:'unsupported',message:'Cached-only provider; no account torrent queue.'}}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/check'){
  const hashes=Array.isArray(req.body?.hashes)?req.body.hashes:[];if(hashes.length>10000)fail(400,'Too many hashes.');const cached:any={};
  for(let n=0;n<hashes.length;n+=100){const batch=hashes.slice(n,n+100);const r=api('/link/lookup',{urls:batch.map(magnet)});if(!Array.isArray(r.cached)||r.cached.length!==batch.length)fail(502,'EasyDebrid returned an invalid cache check.');batch.forEach((h:string,i:number)=>cached[h]=r.cached[i]===true);}return ok({cached});
 }
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/acquire'){const h=String(req.body?.infoHash||'');const r=api('/link/lookup',{urls:[magnet(h)]});if(r.cached?.[0]!==true)return {status:409,body:{error:{code:'not_cached',message:'This torrent is not cached.'}}};return ok({torrentId:h,ready:true,added:false,files:files(h)});}
 if(req.path==='/ether/debrid/link'){const h=String(req.body?.infoHash||req.body?.torrentId||'');const f=files(h).find((f:any)=>f.path===req.body?.path);if(!f)fail(404,'The selected file is no longer available.');return ok({url:f.link,size:f.size});}
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
 }catch(e){const status=Number(e.status)||502,message=e.status?e.message:'EasyDebrid could not be reached.';if(req.path==='/ether/test')return ok({ok:false,message});return {status,body:{error:{code:'provider_error',message}}};}}
(globalThis as any).handle=handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/ether-wrapped/README.md

# Ether Wrapped

Explore a granted viewer's completed titles for the current year, with a monthly chart, top genres and a poster grid. Choose viewers at installation and select one on the page. Add “Your year in titles” in a collection and choose a viewer and optional year.

Screenshot placeholder: Wrapped page with viewer buttons, two stat tiles, posters, genres and a monthly chart in light and dark themes.

## Limits

The page reads the most recent 200 history entries, so older activity can be omitted. The chart counts completed history entries and does not estimate viewing time. Collections include only titles with an IMDb identifier. A viewer grant is required and can be revoked at any time.


## Source: sdk/examples/ether-wrapped/manifest.json

## Source: sdk/examples/ether-wrapped/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, type Manifest } from '../../typescript/src/index.ts';
import manifest from './manifest.json' with { type: 'json' };
import en from './i18n/en.json' with { type: 'json' };
import fr from './i18n/fr.json' with { type: 'json' };

type History = { titleId: string; type: string; watchedAt: string; completed?: boolean };
type Title = { id: string; title: string; type: string; tmdbId?: number; imdbId?: string; year?: number; genres?: string[]; posterPath?: string; summary?: string };
async function yearData(ctx: any, viewer: number, year: number) {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(viewer) || viewer <= 0 || year < 1900 || year > 9999) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
  if (!viewers.some((v: any) => v.id === viewer)) return { titles: [], plays: 0, genres: [], months: Array(12).fill(0) };
  const history: History[] = await ctx.ether.viewers.history(viewer, 200, 0);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  const months = Array(12).fill(0);
  for (const entry of history) {
    const date = new Date(entry.watchedAt);
    if (!entry.completed || date.getUTCFullYear() !== year) continue;
    let titleId = entry.titleId;
    if (entry.type === 'episode') { const key = Number(titleId); if (Number.isSafeInteger(key) && key >= 4e15 && key < 5e15) titleId = String(2e15 + Math.floor((key - 4e15) / 1e7)); }
    counts.set(titleId, (counts.get(titleId) || 0) + 1);
    months[date.getUTCMonth()]++;
  }
  const titles: Array<Title & {count: number}> = [];
  for (const [id, count] of counts) {
    try {
      const title = await ctx.ether.catalog.get(id) as Title | null;
      if (title) titles.push({ ...title, count });
    } catch { /* A removed title should not hide the rest of the year. */ }
  }
  titles.sort((a,b) => b.count-a.count || a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
  const genreCounts = new Map<string,number>();
  for (const title of titles) for (const genre of title.genres || []) genreCounts.set(genre, (genreCounts.get(genre) || 0) + title.count);
  const genres = [...genreCounts].sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1] || a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(0,5);
  return { titles, plays: months.reduce((a,b) => a+b,0), genres, months };
}
export const wrappedDefinition = { manifest: manifest as Manifest, strings: { en, fr }, routes: {
  async view(req, ctx) {
    const viewers = await ctx.ether.viewers.granted();
    const viewer = Number(req.query.viewer || viewers[0]?.id || 0);
    const year = Number(req.query.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const result = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    const data: Record<string,unknown> = { year: String(year), plays: String(result.plays), titleCount: String(result.titles.length), genres: result.genres.map(([g,n]) => `${g} (${n})`).join(', '), titles: result.titles.map(t => ({ ratingKey:t.id, title:t.title, type:t.type, poster:t.posterPath ? `https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/w300${t.posterPath}` : undefined })), series: [{ key:'plays', label:ctx.t('plays'), values:result.months }], times: result.months.map((_,i) => `${year}-${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}-01T00:00:00Z`) };
    const page = Math.max(0, Math.min(Math.ceil(viewers.length / 6) - 1, Number(req.query.viewerPage) || 0));
    const links = viewers.slice(page * 6, page * 6 + 6).map((v,i) => { data[`viewer${i}`] = v.name; data[`active${i}`] = v.id === viewer; return { href:`?viewer=${v.id}&viewerPage=${page}`, label:{$:`viewer${i}`}, activeWhen:{$:`active${i}`} }; });
    data.neverActive = false;
    if (page > 0) links.unshift({href:`?viewerPage=${page-1}`, label:'$t:previous' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    if ((page + 1) * 6 < viewers.length) links.push({href:`?viewerPage=${page+1}`, label:'$t:next' as any, activeWhen:{$:'neverActive'}});
    return { spec: { specVersion:1, layout:'list', header:[{kind:'page-header',title:'$t:page',description:'$t:description'}], body:[{kind:'filter-bar',controls:{},leading:{kind:'toggle-links',links}}, {kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'calendar',accent:'violet',label:'$t:year',value:{$:'year'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'play',accent:'teal',label:'$t:plays',value:{$:'plays'}},{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'film',accent:'blue',label:'$t:titles',value:{$:'titleCount'}},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:top_titles'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.posterGrid',props:{items:{$:'titles'},empty:'$t:empty'}},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:genres',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:{$:'genres'}}]},{kind:'heading',level:2,content:'$t:activity'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.liveChart',props:{series:{$:'series'},times:{$:'times'},label:'$t:plays'}}] }, data };
  },
  async catalog(req,ctx) {
    const viewer = Number(req.extra.viewerId || 0), year = Number(req.extra.year || new Date().getUTCFullYear());
    const data = await yearData(ctx, viewer, year);
    return { metas: data.titles.filter(t => (req.type === 'series' ? t.type === 'show' : t.type === req.type) && t.imdbId).slice(req.skip,req.skip+100).map(t => ({id:t.imdbId!,type:req.type,name:t.title,releaseInfo:String(t.year || ''),description:t.summary})) };
  }
}};
export const wrappedPlugin = plugin(wrappedDefinition);
export const handle = wrappedPlugin.handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/hello/go/README.md

# Hello plugin (Go)

Run the sidecar from the repository root:

```sh
ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT=8080 go run ./sdk/examples/hello/go/cmd
```

For a tunnel, set `ETHER_TUNNEL_URL` and `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` instead.
Use a credential obtained by pairing with Ether. The HTTP mode defaults to a
random free port when `ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT` is not set.

Run its tests with `go test ./sdk/examples/hello/go`.


## Source: sdk/examples/hello/go/cmd/main.go#main

``````
func main() {
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	if err := hello.NewHelloPlugin().Serve(ctx, sdk.ServeOptions{}); err != nil && ctx.Err() == nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}

// NewHelloPlugin constructs the reference Go hello plugin with identical routes
// and payloads to the TypeScript and Python hello plugins.
func NewHelloPlugin() *etherplugin.Plugin {
	return etherplugin.New(etherplugin.Definition{
		Manifest: etherplugin.Manifest{
			ID:          "org.ether.examples.hello",
			Version:     "0.1.0",
			Name:        "Hello plugin",
			Description: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
			Types:       []string{"movie"},
			IDPrefixes:  []string{"tt"},
			Catalogs: []etherplugin.StremioCatalogDecl{{
				Type:  "movie",
				ID:    "hello",
				Name:  "Hello movies",
				Extra: []etherplugin.StremioExtraField{{Name: "search"}},
			}},
			Resources: []any{"catalog", "meta", "subtitles"},
			Ether: &etherplugin.EtherManifestBlock{
				Protocol: 1,
				Kind:     etherplugin.KindExtension,
				Capabilities: []etherplugin.Capability{
					etherplugin.CapListSource,
					etherplugin.CapSubtitles,
					etherplugin.CapUI,
				},
				Summary:     "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
				Runtime:     etherplugin.RuntimeDecl{Kind: "remote"},
				Permissions: &etherplugin.Permissions{Catalog: "none"},
				Settings: &etherplugin.SettingsSchema{
					Fields: []etherplugin.SettingField{{
						Key:     "greeting",
						Kind:    "text",
						Label:   "Greeting word",
						Hint:    "Word used to greet viewers in the catalog and view",
						Default: "Hello",
					}},
				},
				Contributes: &etherplugin.Contributes{
					ListSources: []etherplugin.ListSourceMeta{{
						Key:     "hello",
						Label:   "Hello movies",
						Hint:    "Sample movie list from the hello plugin",
						Catalog: "hello",
						Refresh: "1h",
					}},
					Subtitles: &etherplugin.SubtitlesMeta{
						Languages: []string{"en"},
						Formats:   []string{"vtt"},
					},
					Pages: []etherplugin.PageMeta{{
						Key:   "home",
						Label: "Hello overview",
						Route: "/ether/view/home",
					}},
				},
			},
		},
		DefaultSettings: map[string]any{"greeting": "Hello"},
		Routes: etherplugin.Routes{
			Test: func(_ *etherplugin.Context) (etherplugin.TestResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.TestResponse{
					OK:      true,
					Message: "Hello plugin is healthy.",
				}, nil
			},
			Catalog: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.CatalogRequest) (etherplugin.CatalogResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				target := req.Search
				if target == "" {
					target = "from Ether"
				}
				return etherplugin.CatalogResponse{
					Metas: []etherplugin.CatalogItem{{
						ID:          "tt0133093",
						Type:        req.Type,
						Name:        greeting + " " + target,
						ReleaseInfo: "1999",
						Description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
			Meta: func(_ *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.MetaRequest) (etherplugin.MetaResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.MetaResponse{
					Meta: etherplugin.MetaItem{
						CatalogItem: etherplugin.CatalogItem{
							ID:          req.ID,
							Type:        req.Type,
							Name:        "The Matrix",
							ReleaseInfo: "1999",
							Description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
						},
					},
				}, nil
			},
			Subtitles: func(_ *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.SubtitlesRequest) (etherplugin.SubtitlesResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.SubtitlesResponse{
					Subtitles: []etherplugin.SubtitleItem{{
						ID:     req.ID + ":en",
						URL:    fmt.Sprintf("https://subtitles.example.invalid/%s/en.vtt", url.PathEscape(req.ID)),
						Lang:   "en",
						Label:  "English",
						Format: "vtt",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
			View: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, _ etherplugin.ViewRequest) (etherplugin.ViewResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				return etherplugin.ViewResponse{
					Spec: etherplugin.ViewSpecDocument{
						SpecVersion: 1,
						Layout:      "list",
						Header: []map[string]any{{
							"kind":        "page-header",
							"title":       map[string]any{"$": "title"},
							"description": map[string]any{"$": "subtitle"},
						}},
						Body: []map[string]any{{
							"kind":  "panel",
							"title": map[string]any{"$": "panelTitle"},
							"blocks": []map[string]any{{
								"kind":    "text",
								"content": map[string]any{"$": "greetingText"},
							}},
						}},
					},
					Data: map[string]any{
						"title":        "Hello plugin",
						"subtitle":     "Greeting view",
						"panelTitle":   "Greeting",
						"greetingText": greeting + " from Ether",
					},
				}, nil
			},
			Action: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, _ etherplugin.ActionRequest) (etherplugin.ActionResponse, error) {
				greeting, _ := ctx.Settings["greeting"].(string)
				if greeting == "" {
					greeting = "Hello"
				}
				return etherplugin.ActionResponse{
					Toast:   greeting + " from Ether",
					Refresh: true,
				}, nil
			},
			RankKey: func(candidate etherplugin.CandidateFacts, _ map[string]any) int64 {
				if candidate.Cached {
					return 1000
				}
				return 100
			},
			CondMatch: func(candidate etherplugin.CandidateFacts, _ string, value any) bool {
				want := true
				if b, ok := value.(bool); ok {
					want = b
				}
				return candidate.Cached == want
			},
		},
	})
}

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import urllib.parse
from typing import Any, Dict

_SDK_DIR = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "..", "python"))
if _SDK_DIR not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _SDK_DIR)

from ether_plugin import PluginContext, plugin, serve  # noqa: E402

HELLO_MANIFEST: Dict[str, Any] = {
    "id": "org.ether.examples.hello",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "name": "Hello plugin",
    "description": "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
    "types": ["movie"],
    "idPrefixes": ["tt"],
    "catalogs": [
        {
            "type": "movie",
            "id": "hello",
            "name": "Hello movies",
            "extra": [{"name": "search", "isRequired": False}],
        }
    ],
    "resources": ["catalog", "meta", "subtitles"],
    "ether": {
        "protocol": 1,
        "kind": "extension",
        "capabilities": [
            "list_source",
            "subtitles",
            "ui",
        ],
        "summary": "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
        "runtime": {"kind": "remote"},
        "permissions": {"catalog": "none"},
        "settings": {
            "fields": [
                {
                    "key": "greeting",
                    "kind": "text",
                    "label": "Greeting word",
                    "hint": "Word used to greet viewers in the catalog and view",
                    "default": "Hello",
                }
            ]
        },
        "contributes": {
            "listSources": [
                {
                    "key": "hello",
                    "label": "Hello movies",
                    "hint": "Sample movie list from the hello plugin",
                    "catalog": "hello",
                    "refresh": "1h",
                }
            ],
            "subtitles": {"languages": ["en"], "formats": ["vtt"]},
            "pages": [
                {
                    "key": "home",
                    "label": "Hello overview",
                    "route": "/ether/view/home",
                }
            ],
        },
    },
}


def _catalog(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    target = str(req.get("search") or "from Ether")
    return {
        "metas": [
            {
                "id": "tt0133093",
                "type": req["type"],
                "name": f"{greeting} {target}",
                "releaseInfo": "1999",
                "description": "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
            }
        ]
    }


def _meta(req: Dict[str, Any], _ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "meta": {
            "id": req["id"],
            "type": req["type"],
            "name": "The Matrix",
            "releaseInfo": "1999",
            "description": "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
        }
    }


def _subtitles(req: Dict[str, Any], _ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(req["id"], safe="")
    return {
        "subtitles": [
            {
                "id": f"{req['id']}:en",
                "url": f"https://subtitles.example.invalid/{encoded}/en.vtt",
                "lang": "en",
                "label": "English",
                "format": "vtt",
            }
        ]
    }


def _view(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    return {
        "spec": {
            "specVersion": 1,
            "layout": "list",
            "header": [
                {
                    "kind": "page-header",
                    "title": {"$": "title"},
                    "description": {"$": "subtitle"},
                }
            ],
            "body": [
                {
                    "kind": "panel",
                    "title": {"$": "panelTitle"},
                    "blocks": [{"kind": "text", "content": {"$": "greetingText"}}],
                }
            ],
        },
        "data": {
            "title": "Hello plugin",
            "subtitle": "Greeting view",
            "panelTitle": "Greeting",
            "greetingText": f"{greeting} from Ether",
        },
    }


def _action(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    greeting = str(ctx.settings.get("greeting") or "Hello")
    return {"toast": f"{greeting} from Ether", "refresh": True}


hello_plugin = plugin(
    manifest=HELLO_MANIFEST,
    default_settings={"greeting": "Hello"},
    routes={
        "test": lambda _ctx: {"ok": True, "message": "Hello plugin is healthy."},
        "catalog": _catalog,
        "meta": _meta,
        "subtitles": _subtitles,
        "view": _view,
        "action": _action,
        "rank_key": lambda cand, _cfg: 1000 if cand.get("cached") else 100,
        "cond_match": lambda cand, _op, val: bool(cand.get("cached"))
        is (val if isinstance(val, bool) else True),
    },
)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    serve(hello_plugin, background=False)

``````

# Hello plugin (TypeScript)

Minimal reference plugin built with `@ether/plugin-sdk`. Runs both hosted inside Ether's QuickJS + wazero runtime (`ether.runtime.kind: "hosted"`) and as a Node/Bun HTTP or tunnel sidecar.

## Test

```bash
node --test sdk/examples/hello/typescript/plugin.test.ts
```

## Run a sidecar

With Node 23.6 or newer (or Bun), from the repository root:

```bash
ETHER_PLUGIN_PORT=8080 node sdk/examples/hello/typescript/sidecar.ts
```

Set `ETHER_TUNNEL_URL` and `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` for a tunnel instead.
The hosted entry point is `plugin.ts`.

  greeting: string;

        languages: ["en"],
        formats: ["vtt"],
      },

        {
          key: "home",
          label: "Hello overview",

        },
      ],
      rankingSteps: [
        {
          key: "cached_boost",
          label: "Boost cached releases",
          hint: "Adds a score bonus when a release is cached",
        },
      ],
      ruleConditions: [
        {
          key: "is_cached",
          label: "Release is cached",
          operators: ["eq"],
        },
      ],
    },
  },
};

export const helloPlugin = plugin<HelloSettings>({
  manifest: helloManifest,
  defaultSettings: {
    greeting: "Hello",
  },
  routes: {
    test() {
      return {
        ok: true,
        message: "Hello plugin is healthy.",
      };
    },
    catalog({ type, search }, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      const target = search || "from Ether";
      return {
        metas: [
          {
            id: "tt0133093",
            type,
            name: `${greeting} ${target}`,
            releaseInfo: "1999",
            description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
          },
        ],
      };
    },
    meta({ type, id }) {
      return {
        meta: {
          id,
          type,
          name: "The Matrix",
          releaseInfo: "1999",
          description: "A computer hacker learns about the true nature of reality.",
        },
      };
    },
    subtitles({ id }) {
      return {
        subtitles: [
          {
            id: `${id}:en`,
            url: `https://subtitles.example.invalid/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/en.vtt`,
            lang: "en",
            label: "English",
            format: "vtt",
          },
        ],
      };
    },
    view(_req, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      return {
        spec: {
          specVersion: 1,
          layout: "list",
          header: [
            {
              kind: "page-header",
              title: { $: "title" },
              description: { $: "subtitle" },
            },
          ],
          body: [
            {
              kind: "panel",
              title: { $: "panelTitle" },
              blocks: [
                {
                  kind: "text",
                  content: { $: "greetingText" },
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        data: {
          title: "Hello plugin",
          subtitle: "Greeting view",
          panelTitle: "Greeting",
          greetingText: `${greeting} from Ether`,
        },
      };
    },
    action(_req, ctx) {
      const greeting = ctx.settings.greeting || "Hello";
      return {
        toast: `${greeting} from Ether`,
        refresh: true,
      };
    },
    rankKey(candidate) {
      return candidate.cached ? 1000 : 100;
    },
    condMatch(candidate, _op, value) {
      const want = typeof value === "boolean" ? value : true;
      return Boolean(candidate.cached) === want;
    },
  },
});

export const handle = helloPlugin.handle;
export const rank_key = helloPlugin.rank_key;
export const cond_match = helloPlugin.cond_match;
