``````
class MockHostClient:
    """In-memory mock implementation of Ether host services for unit tests."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.kv_store: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.secrets_store: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.catalog_store: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.history_store: Dict[int, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        self.watch_state: Dict[str, bool] = {}
        self.collections_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.notifications: List[str] = []
        self.logs: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.last_stream_url: Optional[Tuple[int, str]] = None
        self.http_handler: Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]] = lambda req: {
            "status": 200,
            "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            "body": "{}",
        }

        self.kv = self._KV(self)
        self.secret = self._Secret(self)
        self.http = self._Http(self)
        self.catalog = self._Catalog(self)
        self.viewers = self._Viewers(self)
        self.kind_store: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
        self.sources: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.blobs: Dict[str, bytes] = {}
        self.collections = self._Collections(self)
        self.notify = self._Notify(self)
        self.kinds = self._Kinds(self)
        self.cache = self._Cache(self)
        self.frontend = self._Frontend(self)

    class _Frontend:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def stream_url(self, viewer_id: int, item_ref: str) -> str:
            self._p.last_stream_url = (int(viewer_id), str(item_ref))
            return f"/ether/v1/kind-media/mock-{int(viewer_id)}"

    class _Kinds:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def upsert(self, kind: str, items: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
            kept = {it.get("id"): it for it in self._p.kind_store.get(kind, [])}
            for it in items:
                kept[it.get("id")] = it
            self._p.kind_store[kind] = list(kept.values())
            return len(items)

        def delete(self, kind: str, external_ids: List[str]) -> None:
            drop = set(external_ids)
            self._p.kind_store[kind] = [it for it in self._p.kind_store.get(kind, []) if it.get("id") not in drop]

        def items(self, kind: str, cursor: str = "", limit: int = 200) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            all_items = self._p.kind_store.get(kind, [])
            start = 0
            if cursor:
                start = next((i + 1 for i, it in enumerate(all_items) if it.get("id") == cursor), len(all_items))
            page = all_items[start:start + limit]
            out: Dict[str, Any] = {"items": page}
            if page and start + limit < len(all_items):
                out["nextCursor"] = page[-1].get("id")
            return out

        def resolve_sources(self, query: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
            return list(self._p.sources)

    class _Cache:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def put(self, library_key: str, name: str, data: bytes) -> str:
            ref = "blob:" + hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
            self._p.blobs[ref] = bytes(data)
            return ref

        def open(self, blob_ref: str) -> bytes:  # noqa: A002 - mirrors host naming
            return self._p.blobs[blob_ref]

    class _KV:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[str]:
            return self._p.kv_store.get(key)

        def put(self, key: str, value: str) -> None:
            self._p.kv_store[key] = str(value)

        def delete(self, key: str) -> None:
            self._p.kv_store.pop(key, None)

        def list(self, prefix: str = "") -> List[str]:
            return sorted(k for k in self._p.kv_store if k.startswith(prefix))

    class _Secret:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def get(self, name: str) -> str:
            return self._p.secrets_store.get(name, "")

    class _Http:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def fetch(self, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            return self._p.http_handler(req)

    class _Catalog:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def search(self, query: str, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> Dict[str, Any]:
            needle = query.lower()
            matches = [
                v
                for v in self._p.catalog_store.values()
                if needle in str(v.get("title", "")).lower()
            ]
            return {"titles": matches[offset : offset + limit]}

        def get(self, title_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
            return self._p.catalog_store.get(title_id)

    class _Viewers:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def history(self, viewer_id: int, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
            items = self._p.history_store.get(int(viewer_id), [])
            return items[offset : offset + limit]

        def set_watch_state(self, viewer_id: int, title_id: str, watched: bool) -> None:
            self._p.watch_state[f"{viewer_id}:{title_id}"] = bool(watched)

        setWatchState = set_watch_state

    class _Collections:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def upsert(self, collection: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
            self._p.collections_list.append(collection)

    class _Notify:
        def __init__(self, parent: "MockHostClient") -> None:
            self._p = parent

        def owner(self, text: str) -> None:
            self._p.notifications.append(str(text))

    def log(
        self,
        level: str,
        message: str,
        attrs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.logs.append({"level": level, "message": message, "attrs": attrs})

    def abort(self, message: str = "aborted") -> None:
        raise RuntimeError(f'__ETHER_FAULT__{{"code":"aborted","message":{json.dumps(message)}}}')


def create_mock_host_client() -> MockHostClient:
    return MockHostClient()


def assert_valid_view_spec(doc: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    if not isinstance(doc, dict):
        raise AssertionError("ViewSpecDocument must be a dict.")
    if doc.get("specVersion") != 1:
        raise AssertionError(f"ViewSpecDocument specVersion must be 1 (got {doc.get('specVersion')}).")
    if doc.get("layout") not in ("list", "detail", "bare"):
        raise AssertionError(f"ViewSpecDocument layout must be list, detail, or bare (got {doc.get('layout')}).")
    if not isinstance(doc.get("header"), list):
        raise AssertionError("ViewSpecDocument header must be a list.")
    if not isinstance(doc.get("body"), list):
        raise AssertionError("ViewSpecDocument body must be a list.")

    def _check_no_classname(val: Any, path: str) -> None:
        if isinstance(val, list):
            for idx, entry in enumerate(val):
                _check_no_classname(entry, f"{path}[{idx}]")
            return
        if isinstance(val, dict):
            for k, v in val.items():
                if k == "className" or k.endswith("ClassName"):
                    raise AssertionError(f"ViewSpec forbids {k} at {path}.{k}.")
                _check_no_classname(v, f"{path}.{k}")

    _check_no_classname(doc, "spec")

def _encode_extra_path(extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    if not extra:
        return ""
    return "/" + urllib.parse.urlencode(extra)


class TestHarness:
    """Synchronous test harness for exercising an Ether `PluginInstance`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        instance: PluginInstance,
        host: Optional[MockHostClient] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.host = host or (
            instance._host if isinstance(instance._host, MockHostClient) else create_mock_host_client()
        )
        instance._host = self.host
        self.instance = instance

    def request(self, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(req)

    def manifest(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": "/manifest.json"})["body"]

    def health(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": "/ether/health"})

    def configure(self, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {"method": "POST", "path": "/ether/configure", "body": json.dumps(settings)}
        )

    def test(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "POST", "path": "/ether/test"})

    def options(self, field_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(field_name, safe="")
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": f"/ether/options/{encoded}"})

    def catalog(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        catalog_id: str,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/catalog/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(catalog_id)}{suffix}.json",
            }
        )

    def meta(self, media_type: str, item_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/meta/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}.json",
            }
        )

    def stream(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        item_id: str,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/stream/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}{suffix}.json",
            }
        )

    def subtitles(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        item_id: str,
        pick_token: Optional[str] = None,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if pick_token is not None:
            headers["X-Ether-Pick"] = pick_token
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/subtitles/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}{suffix}.json",
                "headers": headers,
            }
        )

    def markers(self, media_type: str, item_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/ether/markers/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}.json",
            }
        )

    def event(self, events: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": "/ether/event",
                "body": json.dumps({"events": events}),
            }
        )

    def view(
        self,
        page: str = "home",
        query: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        clean = page.lstrip("/") or "home"
        res = self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/ether/view/{urllib.parse.quote(clean)}",
                "query": query,
            }
        )
        if res["status"] == 200:
            assert_valid_view_spec(res["body"]["spec"])
        return res

    def action(
        self,
        action_name: str,
        input_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": f"/ether/action/{urllib.parse.quote(action_name)}",
                "body": json.dumps(input_payload or {}),
            }
        )

    def tool(
        self,
        name: str,
        input_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": f"/ether/tool/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}",
                "body": json.dumps(input_payload or {}),
            }
        )

    def rank_key(
        self,
        candidate: Dict[str, Any],
        config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> float:
        return self.instance.rank_key(candidate, config)

    def cond_match(
        self,
        candidate: Dict[str, Any],
        operator: str = "eq",
        value: Any = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.instance.cond_match(candidate, operator, value)

    def file(self, path: str, range_header: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if range_header:
            headers["Range"] = range_header
        clean = path.lstrip("/")
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {"method": "GET", "path": f"/ether/file/{clean}", "headers": headers}
        )


def create_test_harness(
    instance: PluginInstance,
    host: Optional[MockHostClient] = None,
) -> TestHarness:
    return TestHarness(instance=instance, host=host)

class CatalogProvider:
    """Serve browse/detail for one declared kind. Items are plain dicts in
    the KindItem wire shape; requests are dicts with an extra ``kind`` key."""

    def browse(self, ctx: PluginContext, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def detail(self, ctx: PluginContext, kind: str, item_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    # Optional: define `changes(ctx, req)` for delta pull sync and
    # `search(ctx, req)` when the kind declares browse.liveSearch.


class KindResolver:
    """Turn a playable item into ordered playable sources."""

    def resolve(self, ctx: PluginContext, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class KindMatcher:
    """Score source candidates for one item (spec: matches, best first)."""

    def match(self, ctx: PluginContext, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class FrontendAdapter:
    """A plugin-provided protocol surface. Ether authenticates first;
    `handle` receives X-Ether-Viewer headers and never a credential."""

    def handle(
        self, method: str, path: str, headers: Dict[str, str], body: bytes
    ) -> Tuple[int, Dict[str, str], Union[bytes, str]]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class SetupTester:
    """Answer /ether/v1/setup/{step}/test with {ok, detail, fields?}."""

    def test_setup(self, ctx: PluginContext, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raise NotImplementedError


# Spec-name aliases.
Matcher = KindMatcher


def candidate_ref(candidate: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """The stable ref matchers report for a source candidate."""
    if candidate.get("infoHash"):
        return "infohash:" + str(candidate["infoHash"]).lower()
    if candidate.get("magnet"):
        return "magnet:" + str(candidate["magnet"])
    if candidate.get("nzbUrl"):
        return "nzb:" + str(candidate["nzbUrl"])
    return str(candidate.get("title") or "")


def stream_url(ctx: PluginContext, item_ref: str) -> str:
    """Mint an Ether stream URL for one of this plugin's own kind items
    (spec §6.5). Kept as a thin wrapper over PluginContext.stream_url."""
    return ctx.stream_url(item_ref)


class _KindsClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def upsert(self, kind: str, items: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        result = self._call("POST", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/upsert", {"items": items})
        return int((result or {}).get("accepted") or 0)

    def delete(self, kind: str, external_ids: List[str]) -> None:
        self._call("POST", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/delete", {"externalIds": external_ids})

    def items(self, kind: str, cursor: str = "", limit: int = 200) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"cursor": cursor, "limit": limit})
        return self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/items?{q}") or {"items": []}

    def resolve_sources(self, query: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        result = self._call("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/sources/resolve", query)
        return list((result or {}).get("candidates") or [])


def archive_list(data: bytes) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """List non-directory members of a zip/cbz/epub in archive order."""
    import io
    import zipfile

    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        for info in zf.infolist():
            if not info.is_dir():
                out.append({"index": len(out), "name": info.filename, "size": info.file_size})
    return out


def archive_read_member(data: bytes, name: str) -> bytes:
    import io
    import zipfile

    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        return zf.read(name)


def parse_feed(data: Union[bytes, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse RSS/Atom/JSON Feed into {title, summary, link, entries:[...]}."""
    if isinstance(data, bytes):
        data = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if data.lstrip().startswith("{"):
        doc = json.loads(data)
        return {
            "title": doc.get("title", ""), "summary": doc.get("description", ""),
            "link": doc.get("home_page_url", ""),
            "entries": [
                {
                    "id": it.get("id") or it.get("url", ""), "title": it.get("title", ""),
                    "summary": it.get("summary", ""), "link": it.get("url", ""),
                    "audio": (it.get("attachments") or [{}])[0].get("url", ""),
                    "date": it.get("date_published", ""),
                }
                for it in doc.get("items") or []
            ],
        }
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

    root = ET.fromstring(data)

    def local(tag: str) -> str:
        return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]

    def child_text(el: Any, name: str) -> str:
        for c in el:
            if local(c.tag) == name:
                return (c.text or "").strip()
        return ""

    if local(root.tag) == "feed":
        entries = []
        for e in root.iter():
            if local(e.tag) != "entry":
                continue
            page = media = ""
            for c in e:
                if local(c.tag) == "link":
                    if c.get("rel") == "enclosure":
                        media = c.get("href", "")
                    elif not page:
                        page = c.get("href", "")
            entries.append({"id": child_text(e, "id") or page, "title": child_text(e, "title"),
                            "summary": child_text(e, "summary"), "link": page, "audio": media,
                            "date": child_text(e, "updated")})
        return {"title": child_text(root, "title"), "summary": child_text(root, "subtitle"), "link": "", "entries": entries}
    channel = root
    for e in root.iter():
        if local(e.tag) == "channel":
            channel = e
            break
    entries = []
    for e in channel:
        if local(e.tag) != "item":
            continue
        enc = ""
        for c in e:
            if local(c.tag) == "enclosure":
                enc = c.get("url", "")
        entries.append({"id": child_text(e, "guid") or child_text(e, "link"), "title": child_text(e, "title"),
                        "summary": child_text(e, "description"), "link": child_text(e, "link"),
                        "audio": enc, "date": child_text(e, "pubDate")})
    return {"title": child_text(channel, "title"), "summary": child_text(channel, "description"),
            "link": child_text(channel, "link"), "entries": entries}

def _base_manifest(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    kind: str,
    capabilities: List[str],
    version: str = "0.1.0",
    summary: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    resolved_summary = summary or f"{name} plugin for Ether."
    return {
        "id": plugin_id,
        "name": name,
        "version": version,
        "description": resolved_summary,
        "types": ["movie", "series"],
        "idPrefixes": ["tt"],
        "ether": {
            "protocol": 1,
            "kind": kind,
            "capabilities": capabilities,
            "summary": resolved_summary,
            "runtime": {"kind": "remote"},
            "permissions": {"catalog": "none"},
        },
    }

def create_subtitles_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["subtitles"], version=version)
    man["resources"] = ["subtitles"]
    man["ether"]["settings"] = {
        "fields": [
            {
                "key": "preferredLanguage",
                "kind": "select",
                "label": "Preferred language",
                "default": "en",
                "options": [
                    {"value": "en", "label": "English"},
                    {"value": "es", "label": "Spanish"},
                    {"value": "fr", "label": "French"},
                ],
            }
        ]
    }
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "subtitles": {"languages": ["en", "es", "fr"], "formats": ["vtt", "srt"]}
    }

    def _subtitles(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        lang = str(ctx.settings.get("preferredLanguage") or "en")
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(req["id"], safe="")
        return {
            "subtitles": [
                {
                    "id": f"{req['id']}:{lang}",
                    "url": f"https://subtitles.example.invalid/{encoded}/{lang}.vtt",
                    "lang": lang,
                    "label": lang.upper(),
                    "format": "vtt",
                }
            ]
        }

    return plugin(
        manifest=man,
        default_settings={"preferredLanguage": "en"},
        routes={"subtitles": _subtitles},
    )


def create_scrobbler_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "integration", ["events"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "integration": {"category": "scrobbler", "adds": ["events"], "connect": "none"},
        "events": {
            "subscribe": [
                "playback.started",
                "playback.paused",
                "playback.stopped",
                "playback.completed",
            ]
        },
    }

    def _event(events: List[Dict[str, Any]], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        ack: List[str] = []
        for ev in events:
            viewer_id = ev.get("viewerId") or 0
            ctx.ether.kv.put(f"last_event:{viewer_id}", json.dumps(ev))
            ack.append(str(ev["id"]))
        return {"ack": ack}

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"event": _event})


def create_view_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["ui"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "pages": [{"key": "home", "label": name, "route": "/ether/view/home"}]
    }

    def _view(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raw = ctx.ether.kv.get("refresh_count")
        count = int(raw) if raw and str(raw).isdigit() else 0
        return {
            "spec": {
                "specVersion": 1,
                "layout": "list",
                "header": [
                    {
                        "kind": "page-header",
                        "title": {"$": "title"},
                        "description": {"$": "subtitle"},
                    }
                ],
                "body": [
                    {
                        "kind": "panel",
                        "title": "Status",
                        "blocks": [{"kind": "text", "content": {"$": "statusText"}}],
                    }
                ],
            },
            "data": {
                "title": name,
                "subtitle": f"Refreshed {count} times",
                "statusText": "Plugin view is ready.",
            },
        }

    def _action(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if req.get("action") == "refresh":
            raw = ctx.ether.kv.get("refresh_count")
            current = (int(raw) if raw and str(raw).isdigit() else 0) + 1
            ctx.ether.kv.put("refresh_count", str(current))
            return {"toast": "State refreshed.", "refresh": True}
        return {"toast": "Unknown action."}

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"view": _view, "action": _action})


def create_ranker_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["ranking_step"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["settings"] = {
        "fields": [
            {
                "key": "boost4k",
                "kind": "bool",
                "label": "Boost 2160p releases",
                "default": True,
            }
        ]
    }
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "rankingSteps": [
            {
                "key": "resolution_boost",
                "label": "Boost 2160p releases",
                "hint": "Adds a score bonus when a candidate is 2160p",
            }
        ]
    }

    def _rank_key(candidate: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        res = candidate.get("resolution")
        is_4k = res == 2160 or res == "2160p"
        bonus = 1000 if config.get("boost4k") and is_4k else 0
        return (500 if candidate.get("cached") else 0) + bonus

    return plugin(
        manifest=man,
        default_settings={"boost4k": True},
        routes={"rank_key": _rank_key},
    )


def create_condition_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["rule_condition"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "ruleConditions": [
            {
                "key": "cached_release",
                "label": "Release is cached",
                "operators": ["eq"],
            }
        ]
    }

    def _cond_match(candidate: Dict[str, Any], _op: str, value: Any) -> bool:
        want = value if isinstance(value, bool) else True
        return bool(candidate.get("cached")) is want

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"cond_match": _cond_match})
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/home-assistant/plugin.py

``````
"""Home Assistant sidecar using the Ether Python SDK."""
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from ether_plugin import CredentialError, PluginHttpError, plugin, serve

manifest = json.loads((HERE / 'manifest.json').read_text())
runtime_manifest = json.loads(json.dumps(manifest))
runtime_manifest['ether']['settings'] = json.loads((HERE / 'settings.schema.json').read_text())
SERVICE = re.compile(r'^[a-z0-9_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$')
ENTITY = re.compile(r'^[a-z0-9_]+\.[a-z0-9_]+$')

class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
        return None

def call(settings, path, data=None):
    base = str(settings.get('url', '')).rstrip('/')
    token = str(settings.get('token', ''))
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
    if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https') or not parsed.hostname or parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment or not token:
        raise PluginHttpError(400, 'not_configured', 'Home Assistant settings are incomplete.')
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode(), headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json'}, method='GET' if data is None else 'POST')
    try:
        with urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect).open(request, timeout=8) as response:
            raw = response.read(1024 * 1024 + 1)
            if len(raw) > 1024 * 1024:
                raise ValueError('response too large')
            return json.loads(raw)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        raise PluginHttpError(502, 'home_assistant_error', 'Home Assistant request failed.') from None

def run_service(settings, service, entity):
    if not SERVICE.fullmatch(service) or not ENTITY.fullmatch(entity):
        raise PluginHttpError(400, 'invalid_service', 'Enter a valid service and entity.')
    domain, action = service.split('.')
    call(settings, '/api/services/' + domain + '/' + action, {'entity_id': entity})

def events(items, ctx):
    ack = []
    for event in items:
        name = event.get('name', '').removeprefix('playback.')
        if name not in ('started', 'paused', 'stopped'):
            continue
        target = str(ctx.settings.get(name, '')).strip()
        if target:
            try:
                service, entity = target.split()
                run_service(ctx.settings, service, entity)
            except (ValueError, PluginHttpError):
                continue
        ack.append(event.get('id'))
    return {'ack': ack}

def tool(req, ctx):
    if req['name'] == 'ha_states':
        states = call(ctx.settings, '/api/states')
        if not isinstance(states, list):
            raise PluginHttpError(502, 'home_assistant_error', 'Home Assistant returned invalid states.')
        return {'states': [{'entity_id': s.get('entity_id'), 'state': s.get('state')} for s in states[:100] if isinstance(s, dict)]}
    if req['name'] == 'ha_run_scene':
        entity = str(req['input'].get('entity_id', ''))
        if not entity.startswith('scene.'):
            raise PluginHttpError(400, 'invalid_scene', 'Enter a scene entity.')
        run_service(ctx.settings, 'scene.turn_on', entity)
        return {'ok': True}
    raise PluginHttpError(404, 'not_found', 'Tool not found.')

def test(ctx):
    try:
        call(ctx.settings, '/api/')
        return {'ok': True, 'message': 'Connected to Home Assistant.'}
    except PluginHttpError:
        return {'ok': False, 'message': 'Could not connect to Home Assistant.'}

home_assistant = plugin(manifest=runtime_manifest, routes={'event': events, 'tool': tool, 'test': test})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # The SDK pairs from ETHER_URL and ETHER_PAIRING_CODE on first run, saves
    # the credential under ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR, and reuses it afterwards.
    # It returns when the tunnel disconnects; keep reconnecting with a bounded
    # delay. A missing or rejected credential is fatal, so it is not retried.
    delay = 1
    while True:
        try:
            serve(home_assistant, mode='tunnel', background=False)
        except CredentialError as exc:
            sys.exit(str(exc))
        except (OSError, ConnectionError):
            pass
        time.sleep(delay)
        delay = min(delay * 2, 60)


``````

## Source: sdk/examples/kind-library/README.md

# Field Recordings (example)

The content-kind proof example for Ether v0.3.8 (spec §13): a
three-level "field recordings" kind (collection → album → track,
tracks playable) with fixture content. It exists so the kind
infrastructure is exercised end to end by tests; it is **not** a
shipped feature and is not in the signed catalogue.

It exercises: a hierarchical declaration with an indexed field
(`genre`), pull sync with `/changes`, live search
(`browse.liveSearch`), the container pattern (tracks extracted from
one zip per album), a `{pageNumber}` URL template, a title matcher,
one setup step (source address + API key), presentations for
MediaBrowser (`music`) and Plex (`show`), and a tiny OPDS-ish
frontend adapter.

`kind_library_test.go` (in `sdk/examples`) packs it, checks it, runs
it hosted, syncs it into the plugin-item store, opens track 2's
bytes through the container pattern, and pins a manual match.
Assertions that need slice D (installing into a full test Ether,
browsing through a client surface, removal purging the library) live
in `TestKindLibraryEndToEndSliceD`, skipped until D lands.

See [docs/plugin-kinds.md](../../../docs/plugin-kinds.md).

## Source: sdk/examples/kind-library/src/plugin.ts

``````
// Field Recordings — the content-kind proof example (spec §13).
// Deliberately generic fixture content, not a shipped feature.
//
// One kind, three levels (collection → album → track). Albums are
// containers: each track is one member of the album's zip, so resolve
// returns the container pattern first and a {pageNumber} URL template
// second. Pull sync with /changes, live search, a title matcher, one
// setup step, and a tiny OPDS-ish frontend adapter.
type Request = {
  method: string;
  path: string;
  query?: Record<string, string[] | string>;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: unknown;
  settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
type Item = Record<string, any>;

function baseUrl(req: Request): string {
  let v = req.settings?.sourceUrl;
  if (v === undefined && typeof ether !== "undefined") {
    try { v = ether.settings.get().sourceUrl; } catch { v = undefined; }
  }
  return (typeof v === "string" && v.trim() ? v.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "") : "https://media.example");
}

function loadItems(req: Request): Item[] {
  const base = baseUrl(req);
  return [
    { id: "coast", level: "collection", title: "Coastal", childCount: 1, leafCount: 2 },
    {
      id: "harbour", level: "album", parentId: "coast", index: 0, title: "Harbour at Dawn",
      year: 2024, childCount: 2, leafCount: 2, fields: { genre: "ambient" },
      hints: { zipUrl: base + "/harbour.zip", zipSize: 4096 }, etag: "a1",
    },
    {
      id: "harbour-1", level: "track", parentId: "harbour", index: 0, title: "Gulls",
      playable: true, fields: { genre: "ambient", durationSec: 61 },
      hints: { member: "01-gulls.flac" }, etag: "t1",
    },
    {
      id: "harbour-2", level: "track", parentId: "harbour", index: 1, title: "Fog Horn",
      playable: true, fields: { genre: "ambient", durationSec: 84 },
      hints: { member: "02-fog-horn.flac", pageUrl: base + "/tracks/{pageNumber}.flac" }, etag: "t2",
    },
  ];
}

function bodyOf(req: Request): any {
  if (typeof req.body === "string") {
    try { return JSON.parse(req.body || "{}"); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  return req.body || {};
}

function pageOf(items: Item[], body: any) {
  const limit = Number(body.limit || 200);
  const off = Number(body.cursor || 0);
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => (a.index || 0) - (b.index || 0));
  const page: any = { items: sorted.slice(off, off + limit) };
  if (off + limit < sorted.length) page.nextCursor = String(off + limit);
  return { status: 200, body: page };
}

const byId = (items: Item[], id: string) => items.find((i) => i.id === id);

function candidateRef(c: any): string {
  if (c.infoHash) return "infohash:" + String(c.infoHash).toLowerCase();
  if (c.magnet) return "magnet:" + c.magnet;
  if (c.nzbUrl) return "nzb:" + c.nzbUrl;
  return String(c.title || "");
}

export function handle(req: Request) {
  const body = bodyOf(req);
  const items = loadItems(req);
  if (req.path === "/ether/configure") return { status: 200, body: { errors: {} } };
  if (req.path === "/ether/health") return { status: 200, body: { status: "ok", reason: "" } };

  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/setup/account/test") {
    const fields = body.fields || {};
    if (!fields.sourceUrl && !fields.apiKey) {
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, detail: "$t:missing_url" } };
    }
    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, detail: "$t:connected" } };
  }

  if (req.path.startsWith("/ether/v1/frontend/feed")) {
    const entries = items
      .filter((i) => i.playable)
      .map((i) =>
        `<entry><id>${i.id}</id><title>${i.title}</title>` +
        `<link rel="http://opds-spec.org/acquisition" href="/ether/v1/kind-media/${encodeURIComponent(i.id)}" type="audio/flac"/></entry>`)
      .join("");
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><feed xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"><title>Field Recordings</title>${entries}</feed>`,
    };
  }

  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/browse") {
    return pageOf(items.filter((i) => i.level === body.level && (i.parentId || "") === (body.parentId || "")), body);
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/search") {
    const q = String(body.query || "").toLowerCase();
    return pageOf(items.filter((i) => String(i.title).toLowerCase().includes(q)), body);
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/changes") {
    return { status: 200, body: { upserts: items, complete: true } };
  }
  if (req.path.startsWith("/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/items/")) {
    const item = byId(items, decodeURIComponent(req.path.split("/").pop() || ""));
    if (!item) return { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Item not found." } } };
    return { status: 200, body: item };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/resolve") {
    const item = body.item || {};
    const hints = item.hints || {};
    const parent = byId(items, item.parentId || "");
    const sources: any[] = [];
    if (parent && hints.member) {
      sources.push({
        id: "zip", pattern: "container", mime: "audio/flac",
        container: { format: "zip", volumes: [{ url: parent.hints.zipUrl, size: parent.hints.zipSize }], member: hints.member },
      });
    }
    if (hints.pageUrl) sources.push({ id: "direct", pattern: "range", mime: "audio/flac", url: hints.pageUrl });
    return { status: 200, body: { sources } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/v1/kinds/recordings/match") {
    const title = String(body.item?.title || "").toLowerCase();
    const matches = (body.candidates || []).map((c: any) => {
      const hit = String(c.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(title);
      return { candidateRef: candidateRef(c), score: hit ? 0.95 : 0.1, reasons: [hit ? "Title matches" : "Title does not match"] };
    }).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.score - a.score);
    return { status: 200, body: { matches } };
  }
  if (req.path === "/ether/view/library") {
    return {
      status: 200,
      body: {
        title: "$t:page_label",
        spec: {
          specVersion: 1,
          layout: "detail",
          header: [{ kind: "page-header", title: "$t:page_label", description: "$t:summary" }],
          body: [
            { kind: "stat-tile", iconKey: "play", accent: "primary", label: "$t:items_synced", value: { $: "count" } },
          ],
        },
        data: { count: String(items.length) },
      },
    };
  }
  return { status: 404, body: { error: { code: "not_found", message: "Route not found." } } };
}

(globalThis as any).handle = handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/local-folders/README.md

# Local folders

This hosted source scans a folder you grant to the plugin, matches movies and shows against Ether's catalogue, and returns local files as direct releases. Movie folders use `Title (Year)`; shows use `Show/Season 1/S01E02` filenames. Files remain in the selected folder.

## Setup

Run `go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/local-folders` and `go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/local-folders.etherpkg sdk/examples/local-folders`. Install the package in Server > Plugins, grant a folder and select the same folder in settings. Open the Local folders plugin page and choose Scan folder. Use the title picker on unmatched folders to assign a catalogue title. The scheduled scan repeats hourly. Run offline tests with `node --test sdk/examples/local-folders/tests/plugin.test.ts` and `go test ./sdk/examples`.

Screenshot placeholder: the Local folders page with a scan button and an unmatched folder card containing a title search picker. A second screenshot shows the folder grant and setting in the plugin drawer.

## Limits

Only files under one granted root are indexed. The scanner recognizes MKV, MP4, M4V, AVI, MOV, TS and WebM, and series episodes named with `S01E02`. Automatic matching requires an exact catalogue title and, when present, year. The folder API returns at most 1,000 entries per directory; the scan rejects a directory at that limit, so split large directories. Scans are subject to Ether’s host-call and time budgets; very large trees can exceed them. Scans stop at ten directory levels. Changes are reflected after the next scan, and removing a manual match currently requires removing the plugin's stored data. Ether's existing player support determines which files can be played.

## Source: sdk/examples/local-folders/plugin.ts

``````
import {
  plugin,
  type Manifest,
  type PluginContext,
  type FolderEntry,
  type CatalogTitleSummary,
  type EtherHost,
} from "../../typescript/src/index.ts";
import manifest from "./manifest.json" with { type: "json" };
import en from "./i18n/en.json" with { type: "json" };
import fr from "./i18n/fr.json" with { type: "json" };

type Settings = { folder: string };
type Match = { tmdbId: number; type: string };
type Item = { path: string; season?: number; episode?: number };
const read = <T>(v: unknown): T => v as T;
const parse = (value: string | null, fallback: any) => {
  try {
    return value ? JSON.parse(value) : fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
};
const video = /\.(mkv|mp4|m4v|avi|mov|ts|webm)$/i;
function identity(name: string) {
  const clean = name
    .replace(/\.(mkv|mp4|m4v|avi|mov|ts|webm)$/i, "")
    .replace(/[._]/g, " ")
    .trim();
  const year = clean.match(/\((\d{4})\)/);
  return {
    title: (year ? clean.slice(0, year.index) : clean).trim(),
    year: year ? Number(year[1]) : undefined,
  };
}
function scan(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>) {
  const root = ctx.settings.folder;
  if (!root) return;
  const grouped: Record<string, Item[]> = {};
  const pending: { path: string; top: string; depth: number }[] = [
    { path: "", top: "", depth: 0 },
  ];
  while (pending.length) {
    const cur = pending.shift()!;
    const entries = read<FolderEntry[]>(ctx.ether.folders.list(root, cur.path));
    if (entries.length >= 1000)
      throw new Error("Folder has too many entries to scan safely");
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.dir && cur.depth < 10)
        pending.push({
          path: e.path,
          top: cur.top || e.name,
          depth: cur.depth + 1,
        });
      else if (!e.dir && video.test(e.name)) {
        read(ctx.ether.folders.stat(root, e.path));
        const top = cur.top || e.name;
        const ep = e.path.match(/s(\d{1,2})e(\d{1,3})/i);
        (grouped[top] ||= []).push({
          path: e.path,
          ...(ep ? { season: Number(ep[1]), episode: Number(ep[2]) } : {}),
        });
      }
    }
  }
  const byId: Record<string, Item[]> = {},
    unmatched: string[] = [];
  for (const top of Object.keys(grouped)) {
    const manual = parse(
      read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("match:" + root + ":" + top)),
      null,
    ) as Match | null;
    const isSeries = grouped[top].some((i) => i.episode !== undefined);
    const guess = identity(top);
    const found = manual
      ? []
      : read<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }>(
          ctx.ether.catalog.search(guess.title, 20, 0),
        ).titles || [];
    const candidates = found
      .filter(
        (t) =>
          t.tmdbId &&
          (isSeries
            ? ["show", "series"].includes(t.type)
            : t.type === "movie") &&
          t.title.toLocaleLowerCase() === guess.title.toLocaleLowerCase() &&
          (!guess.year || t.year === guess.year),
      )
      .map((t) => ({ tmdbId: t.tmdbId!, type: isSeries ? "series" : "movie" }));
    const match =
      manual || (candidates.length === 1 ? candidates[0] : undefined);
    if (!match) {
      unmatched.push(top);
      continue;
    }
    const key = `index:${match.type}:${match.tmdbId}`;
    (byId[key] ||= []).push(...grouped[top]);
  }
  const old = read<string[]>(ctx.ether.kv.list("index:"));
  for (const key of Object.keys(byId))
    ctx.ether.kv.put(key, JSON.stringify(byId[key]));
  for (const key of old) if (!byId[key]) ctx.ether.kv.delete(key);
  ctx.ether.kv.put("unmatched", JSON.stringify(unmatched));
  ctx.ether.kv.put("scanned", root);
}
export function createPlugin(host?: EtherHost) {
  return plugin<Settings>({
    manifest: manifest as Manifest,
    host,
    strings: { en, fr },
    defaultSettings: { folder: "" },
    routes: {
      job(_req, ctx) {
        scan(ctx);
        return { ok: true };
      },
      stream(req, ctx) {
        if (
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) !==
            ctx.settings.folder ||
          !ctx.settings.folder
        )
          return { streams: [] };
        const parts = req.id.match(/^tmdb:(\d+)(?::(\d+):(\d+))?$/);
        if (!parts) return { streams: [] };
        const items = parse(
          read<string | null>(
            ctx.ether.kv.get(`index:${req.type}:${parts[1]}`),
          ),
          [],
        ) as Item[];
        return {
          streams: items
            .filter(
              (i) =>
                req.type !== "series" ||
                (i.season === Number(parts[2]) &&
                  i.episode === Number(parts[3])),
            )
            .map((i) => ({
              name: "Local",
              title: i.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop(),
              ether: { file: i.path, releaseName: i.path.split(/[\\/]/).pop() },
            })),
        };
      },
      view(_req, ctx) {
        const unmatched = (
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) ===
          ctx.settings.folder
            ? parse(read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("unmatched")), [])
            : []
        ) as string[];
        const body: any[] = [
          {
            kind: "widget",
            widget: "ether.actionButton",
            props: { action: "scan", label: "$t:scan" },
          },
          ...unmatched.map((name, i) => ({
            kind: "panel",
            title: { $: `folder${i}` },
            blocks: [
              {
                kind: "widget",
                widget: "ether.titleMatch",
                props: {
                  action: "match",
                  label: "$t:search",
                  params: { folder: name },
                },
              },
            ],
          })),
        ];
        if (!unmatched.length)
          body.push({
            kind: "text",
            content: ctx.settings.folder
              ? read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("scanned")) ===
                ctx.settings.folder
                ? "$t:empty"
                : "$t:notScanned"
              : "$t:noFolder",
          });
        return {
          spec: {
            specVersion: 1,
            layout: "list",
            header: [
              {
                kind: "page-header",
                title: "$t:page",
                description: "$t:description",
              },
            ],
            body,
          },
          data: Object.fromEntries(
            unmatched.map((name, i) => [`folder${i}`, name]),
          ),
        };
      },
      action(req, ctx) {
        if (req.action === "scan") {
          if (!ctx.settings.folder) throw new Error(ctx.t("noFolder"));
          scan(ctx);
          return { toast: ctx.t("scanned"), refresh: true };
        }
        const input = req.input as {
          folder?: string;
          tmdbId?: number;
          mediaType?: string;
        };
        const unmatched = parse(
          read<string | null>(ctx.ether.kv.get("unmatched")),
          [],
        ) as string[];
        if (
          req.action !== "match" ||
          !input.folder ||
          !unmatched.includes(input.folder) ||
          !input.tmdbId ||
          !["movie", "show", "series"].includes(input.mediaType || "")
        )
          throw new Error("Invalid match");
        ctx.ether.kv.put(
          "match:" + ctx.settings.folder + ":" + input.folder,
          JSON.stringify({
            tmdbId: input.tmdbId,
            type: input.mediaType === "movie" ? "movie" : "series",
          }),
        );
        scan(ctx);
        return { toast: ctx.t("saved"), refresh: true };
      },
    },
  });
}
export const handle = createPlugin().handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/movie-night/src/plugin.ts

``````
function ok(body:any){return {status:200,body};}
function search(query:string,count:number,offset:number=0){
 const found=ether.catalog.search(query,60,0).titles.filter((x:any)=>x.type==='movie');
 const chosen=[];for(let i=0;i<Math.min(count,found.length);i++){const x=found[(offset+i)%found.length];const detail=ether.catalog.get(String(x.id));chosen.push({id:String(x.id),title:detail.title||x.title,year:x.year,summary:detail.summary||'No synopsis available.',genres:(detail.genres||[]).join(', ')});}return {query,total:found.length,movies:chosen};
}
function count(v:any){return Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Math.floor(Number(v)||3)));}
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return ok({errors:{}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return ok({status:'ok'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/tool/pick_movie_night')return ok(search(String(req.body?.query||'star').slice(0,120),count(req.body?.count)));
 if(req.path==='/ether/action/pick'){
  const settings=ether.settings.get(),query=String(settings.query||'star'),n=count(settings.count),offset=Number(ether.kv.get('offset')||0);
  const result=search(query,n,offset);ether.kv.put('shortlist',JSON.stringify(result));ether.kv.put('offset',String(offset+n));return ok({toast:result.movies.length?'Saved '+result.movies.length+' movies for tonight.':'No movie matches. Try another title search in Setup.',refresh:true});
 }
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/tonight'){
 const saved=JSON.parse(ether.kv.get('shortlist')||'{"movies":[]}');
 return ok({title:'Movie Night',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'panel',title:'$t:controls',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:empty'},{kind:'widget',widget:'ether.actionButton',props:{label:'$t:pick',action:'pick'}}]},{kind:'panel',title:'$t:shortlist',blocks:[{kind:'repeat',items:{$:'movies'},itemKey:{$:'id'},blocks:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'film',accent:'primary',label:{$:'label'},value:{$:'year'}},{kind:'text',content:{$:'summary'}}]}]}]},data:{title:'Movie Night',subtitle:saved.query?'Saved matches for “'+saved.query+'”. Pick again to rotate through '+saved.total+' movie matches.':'A shortlist you can keep while deciding what to watch.',movies:saved.movies.map((m:any)=>({...m,label:m.title+(m.genres?' · '+m.genres:''),year:String(m.year||'')}))}});
 }
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
}
(globalThis as any).handle=handle;
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/october-after-dark/src/plugin.ts

``````
const ITEMS = [{"id": "tt0077651", "type": "movie", "name": "Halloween", "year": 1978}, {"id": "tt0094721", "type": "movie", "name": "Beetlejuice", "year": 1988}, {"id": "tt0107120", "type": "movie", "name": "Hocus Pocus", "year": 1993}, {"id": "tt0107688", "type": "movie", "name": "The Nightmare Before Christmas", "year": 1993}, {"id": "tt0862856", "type": "movie", "name": "Trick \u2019r Treat", "year": 2007}, {"id": "tt0087800", "type": "movie", "name": "A Nightmare on Elm Street", "year": 1984}, {"id": "tt0098084", "type": "movie", "name": "Pet Sematary", "year": 1989}, {"id": "tt0101272", "type": "movie", "name": "The Addams Family", "year": 1991}, {"id": "tt0106220", "type": "movie", "name": "Addams Family Values", "year": 1993}, {"id": "tt0109506", "type": "movie", "name": "The Crow", "year": 1994}, {"id": "tt0162661", "type": "movie", "name": "Sleepy Hollow", "year": 1999}, {"id": "tt1486185", "type": "movie", "name": "Red Riding Hood", "year": 2011}, {"id": "tt1142977", "type": "movie", "name": "Frankenweenie", "year": 2012}, {"id": "tt0086336", "type": "movie", "name": "Something Wicked This Way Comes", "year": 1983}, {"id": "tt0121164", "type": "movie", "name": "Corpse Bride", "year": 2005}, {"id": "tt0327597", "type": "movie", "name": "Coraline", "year": 2009}, {"id": "tt0837562", "type": "movie", "name": "Hotel Transylvania", "year": 2012}];
function ok(body:any) { return {status:200,body}; }
export function handle(req:any) {
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure') return ok({errors:{}});
 if(req.path==='/ether/health') return ok({status:'ok'});
 if(req.path==='/ether/test') return ok({ok:true,message:'17 Halloween films; annual October schedule.'});
 if(req.path.startsWith('/catalog/')) return ok({metas:ITEMS});
 if(req.path==='/ether/action/syncShelf') {
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/README.md

# Pluto TV

A hosted Live TV source that reads Pluto TV's public channel lineup and guide and requests an anonymous session when a channel is played. Channel numbers, categories and logos appear in Ether's Live TV guide. Ether ships no channels or account credentials with this example.

## Setup

Run `go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/pluto-tv` and `go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/pluto.etherpkg sdk/examples/pluto-tv`. Install the package in Server > Plugins, select the region that matches the server's location (or Automatic), and add Pluto TV as a Live TV source. The package is built with the TypeScript SDK. Run the offline tests with `node --test sdk/examples/pluto-tv/tests/plugin.test.ts` and `go test ./sdk/examples`.

Screenshot placeholder: the Live TV grid with channel numbers, category names, logos and a programme detail card. A second screenshot shows the region setting in the plugin drawer.

## Limits

Pluto determines the actual lineup from the server's public IP; the region setting checks the returned region and does not bypass geographic restrictions. The example uses Pluto's public, undocumented endpoints and may break when they change. Availability, advertising, stream formats and rights vary by location. A session is requested at tune time, so playback requires Pluto's service to be reachable. Fixtures are trimmed recordings; the boot fixture has a synthetic session token.


## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/manifest.json

``````
    "protocol": 1, "kind": "livetv_source", "capabilities": ["livetv_channels"],
    "summary": "$t:summary", "icon": "assets/icon.svg", "runtime": {"kind":"hosted", "entry":"plugin.ts"},
    "permissions": {"network":["api.pluto.tv","boot.pluto.tv"]},
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/pluto-tv/plugin.ts

``````
import {
  plugin,
  type Manifest,
  type HostFetchResponse,
  type PluginContext,
  type EtherHost,
} from "../../typescript/src/index.ts";
import manifest from "./manifest.json" with { type: "json" };

type Settings = { region: string };
type Channel = {
  _id: string;
  name: string;
  number?: number;
  category?: string;
  colorLogoPNG?: { path?: string };
  stitched?: { urls?: { type: string; url: string }[] };
  timelines?: {
    _id?: string;
    start: string;
    stop: string;
    title: string;
    episode?: { description?: string };
  }[];
};
function fetchJSON(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>, path: string): unknown {
  const region = ctx.settings.region || "auto";
  const sep = path.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
  const result = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
    url: `https://api.pluto.tv${path}${sep}marketingRegion=${encodeURIComponent(region)}`,
  }) as HostFetchResponse;
  if (result.status !== 200)
    throw new Error(`Pluto TV returned HTTP ${result.status}`);
  return JSON.parse(result.body);
}
function getChannels(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>): Channel[] {
  const data = fetchJSON(ctx, "/v2/channels.json");
  if (!Array.isArray(data)) return [];
  const configured = ctx.settings.region || "auto";
  const url = data[0]?.stitched?.urls?.[0]?.url || "";
  const detected = /[?&]marketingRegion=([^&]+)/i.exec(url)?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
  if (configured !== "auto" && detected && configured !== detected)
    throw new Error(
      "Pluto TV returned a different region; check server location",
    );
  return data;
}
function streamURL(ctx: PluginContext<Settings>, id: string): string {
  const client = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx".replace(
    /[xy]/g,
    (c) => {
      const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 16);
      return (c === "x" ? r : (r & 3) | 8).toString(16);
    },
  );
  const params = `appName=web&appVersion=8.0.0&deviceVersion=122.0.0&deviceModel=web&deviceMake=chrome&deviceType=web&clientID=${client}&clientModelNumber=1.0.0&serverSideAds=false&drmCapabilities=widevine%3AL3`;
  const result = ctx.ether.http.fetch({
    url: `https://boot.pluto.tv/v4/start?${params}`,
    headers: { Origin: "https://pluto.tv", Referer: "https://pluto.tv/" },
  }) as HostFetchResponse;
  if (result.status !== 200)
    throw new Error(`Pluto TV session returned HTTP ${result.status}`);
  const boot = JSON.parse(result.body) as {
    sessionToken?: string;
    stitcherParams?: string;
    servers?: { stitcher?: string };
  };
  const base = boot.servers?.stitcher || "";
  if (!boot.sessionToken || !/^https:\/\/[a-z0-9.-]+\.pluto\.tv$/i.test(base))
    throw new Error("Pluto TV session response is invalid");
  return `${base}/v2/stitch/hls/channel/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/master.m3u8?jwt=${encodeURIComponent(boot.sessionToken)}&masterJWTPassthrough=true${boot.stitcherParams ? "&" + boot.stitcherParams : ""}`;
}
export function createPlugin(host?: EtherHost) {
  return plugin<Settings>({
    manifest: manifest as Manifest,
    host,
    defaultSettings: { region: "auto" },
    routes: {
      channels(ctx) {
        return {
          channels: getChannels(ctx)
            .filter(
              (c) =>
                c._id &&
                c.name &&
                c.stitched?.urls?.some((u) => u.type === "hls" && u.url),
            )
            .map((c) => ({
              id: c._id,
              name: c.name,
              number: c.number,
              group: c.category,
              logo: c.colorLogoPNG?.path,
              guideId: c._id,
              inputs: [
                {
                  url: `plugin://tv.ether.examples.pluto/stream/tv/${encodeURIComponent(c._id)}`,
                },
              ],
            })),
        };
      },
      guide(req, ctx) {
        const query = `?start=${encodeURIComponent(req.from || new Date().toISOString())}&stop=${encodeURIComponent(req.to || new Date(Date.now() + 86400000).toISOString())}`;
        const channel = fetchJSON(
          ctx,
          `/v2/channels/${encodeURIComponent(req.channelId)}${query}`,
        ) as Channel;
        return {
          programmes: (channel.timelines || [])
            .filter((t) => t.start && t.stop && t.title)
            .map((t) => ({
              id: t._id,
              channelId: req.channelId,
              title: t.title,
              start: t.start,
              stop: t.stop,
              description: t.episode?.description,
            })),
        };
      },
      stream(req, ctx) {
        const channel = getChannels(ctx).find((c) => c._id === req.id);
        const url = channel ? streamURL(ctx, channel._id) : undefined;
        return { streams: url ? [{ name: channel!.name, url }] : [] };
      },
      test(ctx) {
        return { ok: getChannels(ctx).length > 0 };
      },
    },
  });
}
export const handle = createPlugin().handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/README.md

# SubDL subtitles

Searches SubDL by IMDb ID and downloads an SRT only after a viewer selects it. The owner supplies their own SubDL API key; no credentials are included. The plugin connects to `api.subdl.com` for search and `dl.subdl.com` for downloads.

## Setup

Create your own API key in your SubDL account, install the package in Ether, and enter the key in its settings. Enable SubDL under Playback > Audio and subtitles. Select a subtitle in your player to download it.

Screenshots to add: the SubDL integration settings drawer; a subtitle selection in a player.

## Limits

Search requires an IMDb ID. Only single-SRT ZIP archives and the first 30 results are supported; season packs and other formats are skipped at download. SubDL controls availability, rate limits and file contents. Its terms and API limits apply to your account. Third-party subtitles may have their own rights. The bundled fflate 0.8.2 is MIT licensed; see `vendor/LICENSE`.

To rebuild the bundled entry from the repository root, run `go run ./sdk/examples/subdl/build`.


## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/build/main.go#main

``````
func main() {

	if len(r.Errors) > 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "bundle failed")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
``````

## Source: sdk/examples/subdl/plugin.ts

``````
import { plugin, PluginRouteError } from '../../typescript/src/router.ts';
import { unzipSync, strFromU8 } from './vendor/fflate.js';
import manifest from './manifest.json';
import schema from './settings.schema.json';

const MAX = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const fail = (message: string): never => { throw new PluginRouteError(502, 'subdl_error', message); };
function bytes64(s: string): Uint8Array {
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';
  if (!/^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/.test(s) || s.length > 4 * Math.ceil(MAX / 3)) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const out: number[] = []; let bits = 0, value = 0;
  for (const c of s.replace(/=+$/, '')) { value = (value << 6) | alphabet.indexOf(c); bits += 6; if (bits >= 8) { bits -= 8; out.push((value >> bits) & 255); } }
  return new Uint8Array(out);
}
function archive(data: string): string {
  const bytes = bytes64(data);
  // Validate the central directory and its declared sizes before inflating.
  let end = -1;
  for (let i = bytes.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557); i--) if (bytes[i]===80 && bytes[i+1]===75 && bytes[i+2]===5 && bytes[i+3]===6) { end=i; break; }
  if (end < 0) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer); const count=view.getUint16(end+10,true); let offset=view.getUint32(end+16,true); let total=0;
  if (!count || count > 100 || offset >= end || view.getUint16(end+8,true)!==count || view.getUint16(end+4,true)!==0 || view.getUint16(end+6,true)!==0 || end+22+view.getUint16(end+20,true)!==bytes.length) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  for (let i=0;i<count;i++) {
    if (offset+46>end || view.getUint32(offset,true)!==0x02014b50) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
    const size=view.getUint32(offset+24,true); total+=size;
    if (total>MAX || (view.getUint16(offset+8,true)&1)) return fail('Subtitle archive is too large or encrypted.');
    offset+=46+view.getUint16(offset+28,true)+view.getUint16(offset+30,true)+view.getUint16(offset+32,true);
  }
  if (offset>end) return fail('Invalid subtitle archive.');
  try {
    const files=unzipSync(bytes); const names=Object.keys(files).filter(n=>/\.srt$/i.test(n) && !n.startsWith('__MACOSX/')).sort();
    if (names.length!==1 || files[names[0]].length>MAX) return fail('The archive must contain one SRT subtitle.');
    return strFromU8(files[names[0]]);
  } catch { return fail('Could not read the subtitle archive.'); }
}
const settingsManifest = {...manifest, ether:{...manifest.ether, settings:schema}} as any;
export const subdl = plugin<{apiKey:string}>({manifest:settingsManifest, routes:{
  subtitles(req, ctx) {
    const id = req.id.split(':');
    const apiKey = ctx.ether.secret.get('apiKey') as string;
    if (!/^tt\d+$/.test(id[0]) || !apiKey) return {subtitles:[]};
    let url='https://api.subdl.com/api/v1/subtitles?api_key='+encodeURIComponent(apiKey)+'&imdb_id='+encodeURIComponent(id[0])+'&subs_per_page=30&client=custom_integration';
    if (req.type==='series' && /^\d+$/.test(id[1] || '') && /^\d+$/.test(id[2] || '')) url+='&type=tv&season_number='+id[1]+'&episode_number='+id[2];
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    const body=JSON.parse(response.body); if (!body.status || !Array.isArray(body.subtitles)) return fail('Subtitle search failed.');
    return {subtitles:body.subtitles.slice(0,30).filter((s:any)=>/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(s.url || '') && /^[a-z]{2,3}$/i.test(s.language || s.lang || '')).map((s:any)=>({id:s.url,lang:(s.language || s.lang).toLowerCase(),format:'srt',name:String(s.release_name || s.name || 'SubDL').slice(0,200)}))};
  },
  subtitlesDownload(req,ctx) {
    if (!/^\/subtitle\/[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/.test(req.id) || req.format !== 'srt') return fail('Invalid subtitle selection.');
    const response=ctx.ether.http.fetch({url:'https://dl.subdl.com'+req.id,headers:{'x-api-key':ctx.ether.secret.get('apiKey') as string}}) as any;
    if (response.status!==200 || !response.bodyBase64) return fail('Subtitle download failed.');
    return {format:'srt',encoding:'utf8',data:archive(response.bodyBase64)};
  },
  test(ctx) { const key = ctx.ether.secret.get('apiKey') as string; return {ok:!!key, message:key ? 'API key saved.' : 'Enter an API key.'}; }
}});
export const handle = subdl.handle;

``````

## Source: sdk/examples/travel-mode/README.md

# Travel Mode

A native ranking step with a 1, 2, 4 or 8 GB target. Add it near the top of a quality profile’s ranking order; the default target is 4 GB. Its scorecard uses the same rank_key function with example releases. It favours cached, device-compatible files at 1080p or below, within the selected size target.

## Use

Created and verified through Studio in the 0.3.3 lab. These examples do not auto-install or change server configuration on upgrade.

From the repository root:

```sh
go run ./cmd/ether plugin check sdk/examples/travel-mode
go run ./cmd/ether plugin pack -o /tmp/travel-mode.etherpkg sdk/examples/travel-mode
```

Install the package in Server → Plugins, or copy these three files into a Studio draft. Review permissions and configure the installed plugin in Setup. The source and English strings are editable in Studio.

## Source: sdk/examples/travel-mode/src/plugin.ts

``````
export function rank_key(c:any,cfg:any={}):number{
 const ceiling=Math.max(480,Math.min(2160,Number(cfg.maxHeight)||1080));
 const budget=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.value??cfg.maxGB)||4)*1073741824;
 const height=parseInt(String(c.resolution||'0').replace(/[^0-9]/g,''),10)||0;
 const clientMax=Number(c.clientCaps?.maxHeight)||ceiling;
 let score=c.cached?300:0;
 if(height>Math.min(ceiling,clientMax))score-=10000;else if(height>0)score+=Math.min(height,1080);
 if(c.size>budget)score-=2000+Math.min(10000,Math.floor((c.size-budget)/1073741824)*100);else if(c.size>0)score+=Math.max(0,500-Math.floor(c.size/1073741824)*100);
 const codec=String(c.videoCodec||'').toLowerCase();const supports=(c.clientCaps?.codecs||[]).map((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase());
 if(codec&&supports.length&&!supports.includes(codec))score-=20000;
 if((c.languages||[]).some((x:string)=>x.toLowerCase()===(cfg.language||'en').toLowerCase()))score+=100;
 return Math.round(score);
}
const SAMPLES=[{name:'1080p cached · 2 GB',resolution:'1080p',size:2*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'720p cached · 1 GB',resolution:'720p',size:1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'h264'},{name:'4K remux · 55 GB',resolution:'2160p',size:55*1073741824,cached:true,languages:['en'],videoCodec:'hevc'}];
export function handle(req:any){
 if(req.path==='/ether/configure')return {status:200,body:{errors:{}}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/health')return {status:200,body:{status:'ok'}};
 if(req.path==='/ether/view/scorecard')return {status:200,body:{title:'Travel Mode',spec:{specVersion:1,layout:'detail',header:[{kind:'page-header',title:{$:'title'},description:{$:'subtitle'}}],body:[{kind:'panel',title:'$t:samples',blocks:[{kind:'text',content:'$t:sample_hint'},{kind:'repeat',items:{$:'scores'},itemKey:{$:'name'},blocks:[{kind:'stat-tile',iconKey:'gauge',accent:'primary',label:{$:'name'},value:{$:'score'}}]}]}]},data:{title:'Travel Mode',subtitle:'Adds a ranking step in Quality with a selectable file-size target. Defaults: 1080p, 4 GB and English audio. This scorecard shows the default settings.',scores:SAMPLES.map(c=>({name:c.name,score:String(rank_key(c))}))}}};
 return {status:404,body:{error:{code:'not_found',message:'Route not found.'}}};
}
(globalThis as any).handle=handle;(globalThis as any).rank_key=rank_key;

``````

## Source: sdk/go/README.md

# `etherplugin` (Go SDK)

Go authoring package (`github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go`) for Ether Plugin Protocol v1 (EPP/1).

## Execution modes

1. **Native HTTP or WebSocket tunnel sidecar (`ether.runtime.kind: "remote"`)**:
   Compile a standard Go binary and call `p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})` (or mount `p` as an `http.Handler`). Host calls go over HTTP to `/ether/plugin-host/*` authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
2. **Hosted WebAssembly guest**: not yet supported. Go 1.27.3 `GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm` emits `wasi_snapshot_preview1` imports (including `proc_exit`, `clock_time_get`, and `fd_write`), which the runtime forbids. TinyGo is not installed here, so a compatible TinyGo build has not been verified. Use a sidecar until a guest is built and tested against Ether's raw WASM ABI.

## Usage

```go
package main

import (
	"context"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	etherplugin "github.com/braedonsaunders/ether/sdk/go"
)

func main() {
	p := etherplugin.New(etherplugin.Definition{
		Manifest: etherplugin.Manifest{
			ID:      "org.ether.examples.hello",
			Name:    "Hello plugin",
			Version: "0.1.0",
			Ether: &etherplugin.EtherManifestBlock{
				Protocol:     1,
				Kind:         etherplugin.KindExtension,
				Capabilities: []etherplugin.Capability{etherplugin.CapListSource, etherplugin.CapUI},
				Summary:      "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
				Runtime:      etherplugin.RuntimeDecl{Kind: "remote"},
			},
		},
		Routes: etherplugin.Routes{
			Catalog: func(ctx *etherplugin.Context, req etherplugin.CatalogRequest) (etherplugin.CatalogResponse, error) {
				return etherplugin.CatalogResponse{
					Metas: []etherplugin.CatalogItem{{
						ID:          "tt0133093",
						Type:        req.Type,
						Name:        "Hello from " + req.ID,
						ReleaseInfo: "1999",
					}},
				}, nil
			},
		},
	})

	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	_ = p.Serve(ctx, etherplugin.ServeOptions{})
}
```

## WS8b interoperability test

Once `internal/plugins/remote` is present, run
`go test -tags ws8b ./sdk/examples/hello/go -run TestWS8bSDKInterop`.
It starts Ether's tunnel server and exercises the Go, Python, and TypeScript
hello sidecars. It requires Python 3 and a Node version with TypeScript support
and WebSocket. The Go SDK reconnects automatically after a dropped tunnel.

## Tunnel recovery

`Start(ctx, ServeOptions{Mode: "tunnel", ...})` returns after the initial
credential authentication and hello/welcome handshake; initial failures are
returned to the caller. After that, dropped connections retry serially with
jittered exponential backoff (50–100 ms initially, capped at 5–10 seconds).
Every attempt re-authenticates and repeats the handshake, with a 10-second
connection/handshake timeout. A connection stable for a minute resets backoff.

In-flight calls fail on disconnect and are not replayed. Ether runtimes resolve
the current connection for subsequent calls. `handle.Done` stays open during
recovery; cancelling `ctx` or calling `handle.Close()` stops active I/O and any
retry, closes the socket, and closes `Done`. `Close` is safe to call repeatedly.
Request cancellation stops that handler without closing the shared tunnel.

## Sidecars

A sidecar is a remote plugin whose program runs on a machine you choose and
dials out to Ether over the `ether-tunnel-v1` WebSocket. It needs no inbound
port. Use one when the program must reach a local network, a USB device, or an
installed tool that Ether's sandbox cannot.

Set `ETHER_URL` and pair once:

```sh
ETHER_URL=https://ether.example.com \
ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data \
ETHER_PAIRING_CODE=PAIR-1234 \
./my-sidecar
```

The SDK exchanges the code once, saves the credential, and derives the tunnel
URL from `ETHER_URL`. Create the code in Ether under Plugins › your plugin ›
Connect a sidecar; it is valid for 5 minutes and single use. On later restarts
the saved credential is reused, so no new code is needed.

- `ETHER_URL` — the server's `http(s)` base. The pair URL and the `ws(s)` tunnel
  URL are derived from it.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` — an explicit credential; always wins.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR` — where the credential is saved, else `/data` when it
  exists and is writable (a Docker volume), else the OS user config directory
  `…/ether-plugins/<plugin id>/`.
- `ETHER_PAIRING_CODE` — a one-time code.

The credential is saved at `<state dir>/credential` (mode `0600`, directory
`0700`) as JSON with the Ether URL it belongs to. If the tunnel rejects a saved
credential, the file is deleted and startup fails with one line instead of
reconnecting forever.

A Dockerfile that keeps the credential across restarts:

```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.27 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN go build -o /out/sidecar ./cmd/sidecar

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /out/sidecar /sidecar
VOLUME /data
ENV ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data
ENTRYPOINT ["/sidecar"]
```

Declare how the console runs it with an `ether.sidecar` manifest block:

```json
"ether": {
  "runtime": { "kind": "remote" },
  "sidecar": {
    "docker": "ghcr.io/you/my-sidecar:1.0.0",
    "docs": "https://example.com/my-sidecar"
  }
}
```

`docker` is an image reference; `download` (an https URL) with `command` (a
single line) is the alternative; `docs` adds a setup link. With a Docker image
the console shows a ready `docker run` command, mounting `-v ether-<id>:/data`
so the saved credential survives a restart.

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) dataRead(ctx context.Context, name string, args []any) ([]byte, error) {
	var out struct {
		BodyBase64 string `json:"bodyBase64"`
	}
	if err := c.dataCall(ctx, name, args, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(out.BodyBase64)
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#checkDataRange

``````
func checkDataRange(r DataRange) error {
	if r.Offset < 0 || r.Offset > 256<<20 || r.Length <= 0 || r.Length > 1<<20 {
		return fmt.Errorf("data range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..1048576")
	}
	return nil
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.CacheRead

``````
func (c *RemoteHostClient) CacheRead(ctx context.Context, blob string, r DataRange) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := checkDataRange(r); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c.dataRead(ctx, "cache.read", []any{blob, r})
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/data_host.go#*RemoteHostClient.ArchiveOpen

``````
// ArchiveOpen reads a bounded range of an uncompressed ZIP member. Deflate
// members are inflated from the start per call; use sequential large chunks.
func (c *RemoteHostClient) ArchiveOpen(ctx context.Context, blob string, member int, r DataRange) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := checkDataRange(r); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return c.dataRead(ctx, "archive.open", []any{blob, member, r})
}
``````

``````
// Host provides access to Ether host services (KV, secrets, HTTP, catalog,
// viewers, collections, folders, owner notifications, and logging).
type Host interface {
	KVGet(ctx context.Context, key string) (string, bool, error)
	KVPut(ctx context.Context, key, value string) error
	KVDelete(ctx context.Context, key string) error
	KVList(ctx context.Context, prefix string) ([]string, error)
	SecretGet(ctx context.Context, name string) (string, error)
	Fetch(ctx context.Context, req HostFetchRequest) (HostFetchResponse, error)
	CatalogSearch(ctx context.Context, query string, limit, offset int) ([]CatalogTitleSummary, error)
	CatalogGet(ctx context.Context, id string) (*CatalogTitleSummary, error)
	ViewerHistory(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, limit, offset int) ([]ViewerWatchEntry, error)
	SetWatchState(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, titleID string, watched bool) error
	UpsertCollection(ctx context.Context, collection map[string]any) error
	FoldersList(ctx context.Context, root, path string) ([]FolderEntry, error)
	FoldersStat(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (FolderEntry, error)
	FoldersHash(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (FolderHash, error)
	FoldersHashStart(ctx context.Context, root, path string) (FolderHashJob, error)
	FoldersHashPoll(ctx context.Context, id string) (FolderHashJob, error)
	FoldersHashCancel(ctx context.Context, id string) (FolderHashJob, error)
	NotifyOwner(ctx context.Context, text string) error
	Log(ctx context.Context, level, message string, attrs map[string]any) error
	// Content-kind host services. KindUpsert/KindDelete need a push-mode
	// kind; ResolveSources needs permissions.sources.
	KindUpsert(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, items []KindItem) (accepted int, err error)
	KindDelete(ctx context.Context, kindKey string, externalIDs []string) error
	KindItems(ctx context.Context, kindKey, cursor string, limit int) (KindPage, error)
	ResolveSources(ctx context.Context, q SourceQuery) ([]SourceCandidate, error)
	CachePut(ctx context.Context, libraryKey, name string, data []byte) (blobRef string, err error)
	CacheOpen(ctx context.Context, blobRef string) ([]byte, error)
	// StreamURL mints a short-lived, scoped ticket for one of this plugin's
	// own kind items and returns the Ether stream URL to embed in a
	// frontend adapter response (spec §6.5). viewerID is the viewer the
	// adapter authenticated.
	StreamURL(ctx context.Context, viewerID int64, itemRef string) (string, error)
}
``````

``````
// RemoteHostClient implements Host by calling `/ether/plugin-host/*` on the
// Ether server authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
type RemoteHostClient struct {
	baseURL    string
	credential string
	client     *http.Client
}
``````

## Source: sdk/go/host.go#NewRemoteHostClient

``````
// NewRemoteHostClient creates a RemoteHostClient.
func NewRemoteHostClient(opts RemoteHostOptions) *RemoteHostClient {
	base := opts.BaseURL
	if base == "" {
		base = os.Getenv("ETHER_HOST_URL")
	}
	if base == "" {
		base = "http://127.0.0.1:32450"
	}
	base = strings.TrimRight(base, "/")

	cred := opts.Credential
	if cred == "" {
		cred = os.Getenv("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL")
	}

	hc := opts.HTTPClient
	if hc == nil {
		hc = http.DefaultClient
	}
	return &RemoteHostClient{
		baseURL:    base,
		credential: cred,
		client:     hc,
	}
}
``````
