``````
def _encode_extra_path(extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]]) -> str:
    if not extra:
        return ""
    return "/" + urllib.parse.urlencode(extra)


class TestHarness:
    """Synchronous test harness for exercising an Ether `PluginInstance`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        instance: PluginInstance,
        host: Optional[MockHostClient] = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.host = host or (
            instance._host if isinstance(instance._host, MockHostClient) else create_mock_host_client()
        )
        instance._host = self.host
        self.instance = instance

    def request(self, req: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(req)

    def manifest(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": "/manifest.json"})["body"]

    def health(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": "/ether/health"})

    def configure(self, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {"method": "POST", "path": "/ether/configure", "body": json.dumps(settings)}
        )

    def test(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "POST", "path": "/ether/test"})

    def options(self, field_name: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(field_name, safe="")
        return self.instance.dispatch({"method": "GET", "path": f"/ether/options/{encoded}"})

    def catalog(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        catalog_id: str,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/catalog/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(catalog_id)}{suffix}.json",
            }
        )

    def meta(self, media_type: str, item_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/meta/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}.json",
            }
        )

    def stream(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        item_id: str,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/stream/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}{suffix}.json",
            }
        )

    def subtitles(
        self,
        media_type: str,
        item_id: str,
        pick_token: Optional[str] = None,
        extra: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        suffix = _encode_extra_path(extra)
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if pick_token is not None:
            headers["X-Ether-Pick"] = pick_token
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/subtitles/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}{suffix}.json",
                "headers": headers,
            }
        )

    def markers(self, media_type: str, item_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/ether/markers/{urllib.parse.quote(media_type)}/{urllib.parse.quote(item_id)}.json",
            }
        )

    def event(self, events: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": "/ether/event",
                "body": json.dumps({"events": events}),
            }
        )

    def view(
        self,
        page: str = "home",
        query: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        clean = page.lstrip("/") or "home"
        res = self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "GET",
                "path": f"/ether/view/{urllib.parse.quote(clean)}",
                "query": query,
            }
        )
        if res["status"] == 200:
            assert_valid_view_spec(res["body"]["spec"])
        return res

    def action(
        self,
        action_name: str,
        input_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": f"/ether/action/{urllib.parse.quote(action_name)}",
                "body": json.dumps(input_payload or {}),
            }
        )

    def tool(
        self,
        name: str,
        input_payload: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {
                "method": "POST",
                "path": f"/ether/tool/{urllib.parse.quote(name)}",
                "body": json.dumps(input_payload or {}),
            }
        )

    def rank_key(
        self,
        candidate: Dict[str, Any],
        config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    ) -> float:
        return self.instance.rank_key(candidate, config)

    def cond_match(
        self,
        candidate: Dict[str, Any],
        operator: str = "eq",
        value: Any = None,
    ) -> bool:
        return self.instance.cond_match(candidate, operator, value)

    def file(self, path: str, range_header: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        headers: Dict[str, str] = {}
        if range_header:
            headers["Range"] = range_header
        clean = path.lstrip("/")
        return self.instance.dispatch(
            {"method": "GET", "path": f"/ether/file/{clean}", "headers": headers}
        )

    return TestHarness(instance=instance, host=host)

Matcher = KindMatcher


def candidate_ref(candidate: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """The stable ref matchers report for a source candidate."""
    if candidate.get("infoHash"):
        return "infohash:" + str(candidate["infoHash"]).lower()
    if candidate.get("magnet"):
        return "magnet:" + str(candidate["magnet"])
    if candidate.get("nzbUrl"):
        return "nzb:" + str(candidate["nzbUrl"])
    return str(candidate.get("title") or "")


def stream_url(ctx: PluginContext, item_ref: str) -> str:
    """Mint an Ether stream URL for one of this plugin's own kind items
    (spec §6.5). Kept as a thin wrapper over PluginContext.stream_url."""
    return ctx.stream_url(item_ref)


class _KindsClient:
    def __init__(self, call_json: Callable[..., Any]) -> None:
        self._call = call_json

    def upsert(self, kind: str, items: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> int:
        result = self._call("POST", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/upsert", {"items": items})
        return int((result or {}).get("accepted") or 0)

    def delete(self, kind: str, external_ids: List[str]) -> None:
        self._call("POST", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/delete", {"externalIds": external_ids})

    def items(self, kind: str, cursor: str = "", limit: int = 200) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        q = urllib.parse.urlencode({"cursor": cursor, "limit": limit})
        return self._call("GET", f"/ether/plugin-host/kinds/{urllib.parse.quote(kind)}/items?{q}") or {"items": []}

    def resolve_sources(self, query: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Find owner sources. indexer_search accepts category (comma-separated
        Newznab IDs or family names, e.g. music/books/comics). A release source
        may set release.fileIndex or candidate.fileIndex (zero-based provider
        torrent list), or release.file (exact path/unique basename), to open any file
        kind. Invalid selections fail; omitted selectors retain video selection.
        Explicit file selection is supported for torrents, not NZB members.
        """
        result = self._call("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/sources/resolve", query)
        return list((result or {}).get("candidates") or [])


def archive_list(data: bytes) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """List non-directory members of a zip/cbz/epub in archive order."""
    import io
    import zipfile

    out: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        for info in zf.infolist():
            if not info.is_dir():
                out.append({"index": len(out), "name": info.filename, "size": info.file_size})
    return out


def archive_read_member(data: bytes, name: str) -> bytes:
    import io
    import zipfile

    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as zf:
        return zf.read(name)


def parse_feed(data: Union[bytes, str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Parse RSS/Atom/JSON Feed into {title, summary, link, entries:[...]}."""
    if isinstance(data, bytes):
        data = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if data.lstrip().startswith("{"):
        doc = json.loads(data)
        return {
            "title": doc.get("title", ""), "summary": doc.get("description", ""),
            "link": doc.get("home_page_url", ""),
            "entries": [
                {
                    "id": it.get("id") or it.get("url", ""), "title": it.get("title", ""),
                    "summary": it.get("summary", ""), "link": it.get("url", ""),
                    "audio": (it.get("attachments") or [{}])[0].get("url", ""),
                    "date": it.get("date_published", ""),
                }
                for it in doc.get("items") or []
            ],
        }
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

    root = ET.fromstring(data)

    def local(tag: str) -> str:
        return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]

    def child_text(el: Any, name: str) -> str:
        for c in el:
            if local(c.tag) == name:
                return (c.text or "").strip()
        return ""

    if local(root.tag) == "feed":
        entries = []
        for e in root.iter():
            if local(e.tag) != "entry":
                continue
            page = media = ""
            for c in e:
                if local(c.tag) == "link":
                    if c.get("rel") == "enclosure":
                        media = c.get("href", "")
                    elif not page:
                        page = c.get("href", "")
            entries.append({"id": child_text(e, "id") or page, "title": child_text(e, "title"),
                            "summary": child_text(e, "summary"), "link": page, "audio": media,
                            "date": child_text(e, "updated")})
        return {"title": child_text(root, "title"), "summary": child_text(root, "subtitle"), "link": "", "entries": entries}
    channel = root
    for e in root.iter():
        if local(e.tag) == "channel":
            channel = e
            break
    entries = []
    for e in channel:
        if local(e.tag) != "item":
            continue
        enc = ""
        for c in e:
            if local(c.tag) == "enclosure":
                enc = c.get("url", "")
        entries.append({"id": child_text(e, "guid") or child_text(e, "link"), "title": child_text(e, "title"),
                        "summary": child_text(e, "description"), "link": child_text(e, "link"),
                        "audio": enc, "date": child_text(e, "pubDate")})
    return {"title": child_text(channel, "title"), "summary": child_text(channel, "description"),
            "link": child_text(channel, "link"), "entries": entries}

def _base_manifest(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    kind: str,
    capabilities: List[str],
    version: str = "0.1.0",
    summary: Optional[str] = None,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    resolved_summary = summary or f"{name} plugin for Ether."
    return {
        "id": plugin_id,
        "name": name,
        "version": version,
        "description": resolved_summary,
        "types": ["movie", "series"],
        "idPrefixes": ["tt"],
        "ether": {
            "protocol": 1,
            "kind": kind,
            "capabilities": capabilities,
            "summary": resolved_summary,
            "runtime": {"kind": "remote"},
            "permissions": {"catalog": "none"},
        },
    }


def create_catalog_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["list_source"], version=version)
    man["catalogs"] = [
        {
            "type": "movie",
            "id": "featured",
            "name": "Featured movies",
            "extra": [{"name": "search", "isRequired": False}],
        }
    ]
    man["resources"] = ["catalog", "meta"]
    man["ether"]["settings"] = {
        "fields": [
            {
                "key": "apiKey",
                "kind": "secret",
                "label": "Access token",
                "hint": "Token used to query the upstream catalog",
            }
        ]
    }
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "listSources": [
            {
                "key": "featured",
                "label": "Featured movies",
                "hint": "Curated movies from the upstream list",
                "catalog": "featured",
                "refresh": "1h",
            }
        ]
    }
    return plugin(
        manifest=man,
        routes={
            "catalog": lambda req, _ctx: {
                "metas": [
                    {
                        "id": "tt0133093",
                        "type": req["type"],
                        "name": (
                            f"Result for {req['search']}"
                            if req.get("search")
                            else f"Featured in {req['id']}"
                        ),
                        "releaseInfo": "1999",
                    }
                ]
            },
            "meta": lambda req, _ctx: {
                "meta": {
                    "id": req["id"],
                    "type": req["type"],
                    "name": f"Title {req['id']}",
                    "releaseInfo": "1999",
                    "description": "Catalog metadata entry.",
                }
            },
        },
    )


def create_subtitles_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["subtitles"], version=version)
    man["resources"] = ["subtitles"]
    man["ether"]["settings"] = {
        "fields": [
            {
                "key": "preferredLanguage",
                "kind": "select",
                "label": "Preferred language",
                "default": "en",
                "options": [
                    {"value": "en", "label": "English"},
                    {"value": "es", "label": "Spanish"},
                    {"value": "fr", "label": "French"},
                ],
            }
        ]
    }
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "subtitles": {"languages": ["en", "es", "fr"], "formats": ["vtt", "srt"]}
    }

    def _subtitles(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        lang = str(ctx.settings.get("preferredLanguage") or "en")
        encoded = urllib.parse.quote(req["id"], safe="")
        return {
            "subtitles": [
                {
                    "id": f"{req['id']}:{lang}",
                    "url": f"https://subtitles.example.invalid/{encoded}/{lang}.vtt",
                    "lang": lang,
                    "label": lang.upper(),
                    "format": "vtt",
                }
            ]
        }

    return plugin(
        manifest=man,
        default_settings={"preferredLanguage": "en"},
        routes={"subtitles": _subtitles},
    )


def create_scrobbler_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "integration", ["events"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "integration": {"category": "scrobbler", "adds": ["events"], "connect": "none"},
        "events": {
            "subscribe": [
                "playback.started",
                "playback.paused",
                "playback.stopped",
                "playback.completed",
            ]
        },
    }

    def _event(events: List[Dict[str, Any]], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        ack: List[str] = []
        for ev in events:
            viewer_id = ev.get("viewerId") or 0
            ctx.ether.kv.put(f"last_event:{viewer_id}", json.dumps(ev))
            ack.append(str(ev["id"]))
        return {"ack": ack}

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"event": _event})


def create_view_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["ui"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "pages": [{"key": "home", "label": name, "route": "/ether/view/home"}]
    }

    def _view(_req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        raw = ctx.ether.kv.get("refresh_count")
        count = int(raw) if raw and str(raw).isdigit() else 0
        return {
            "spec": {
                "specVersion": 1,
                "layout": "list",
                "header": [
                    {
                        "kind": "page-header",
                        "title": {"$": "title"},
                        "description": {"$": "subtitle"},
                    }
                ],
                "body": [
                    {
                        "kind": "panel",
                        "title": "Status",
                        "blocks": [{"kind": "text", "content": {"$": "statusText"}}],
                    }
                ],
            },
            "data": {
                "title": name,
                "subtitle": f"Refreshed {count} times",
                "statusText": "Plugin view is ready.",
            },
        }

    def _action(req: Dict[str, Any], ctx: PluginContext) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        if req.get("action") == "refresh":
            raw = ctx.ether.kv.get("refresh_count")
            current = (int(raw) if raw and str(raw).isdigit() else 0) + 1
            ctx.ether.kv.put("refresh_count", str(current))
            return {"toast": "State refreshed.", "refresh": True}
        return {"toast": "Unknown action."}

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"view": _view, "action": _action})


def create_ranker_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["ranking_step"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["settings"] = {
        "fields": [
            {
                "key": "boost4k",
                "kind": "bool",
                "label": "Boost 2160p releases",
                "default": True,
            }
        ]
    }
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "rankingSteps": [
            {
                "key": "resolution_boost",
                "label": "Boost 2160p releases",
                "hint": "Adds a score bonus when a candidate is 2160p",
            }
        ]
    }

    def _rank_key(candidate: Dict[str, Any], config: Dict[str, Any]) -> int:
        res = candidate.get("resolution")
        is_4k = res == 2160 or res == "2160p"
        bonus = 1000 if config.get("boost4k") and is_4k else 0
        return (500 if candidate.get("cached") else 0) + bonus

    return plugin(
        manifest=man,
        default_settings={"boost4k": True},
        routes={"rank_key": _rank_key},
    )


def create_condition_template(
    plugin_id: str,
    name: str,
    version: str = "0.1.0",
) -> PluginInstance:
    man = _base_manifest(plugin_id, name, "extension", ["rule_condition"], version=version)
    man["ether"]["contributes"] = {
        "ruleConditions": [
            {
                "key": "cached_release",
                "label": "Release is cached",
                "operators": ["eq"],
            }
        ]
    }

    def _cond_match(candidate: Dict[str, Any], _op: str, value: Any) -> bool:
        want = value if isinstance(value, bool) else True
        return bool(candidate.get("cached")) is want

    return plugin(manifest=man, routes={"cond_match": _cond_match})
``````

## Source: sdk/typescript/README.md

# `@ether/plugin-sdk` (TypeScript / JavaScript)

Authoring kit for Ether plugins targeting Ether Plugin Protocol v1 (EPP/1).

The same `plugin({ manifest, routes })` definition runs:
- **Hosted** inside Ether's embedded QuickJS + wazero sandbox (`ether.runtime.kind: "hosted"`), bundled into a single artifact with `ether plugin pack`.
- **As a sidecar** on Node or Bun (`ether.runtime.kind: "remote"`), either serving HTTP directly (`serve(p, { mode: "http" })`) or dialing outbound over the `ether-tunnel-v1` WebSocket tunnel (`serve(p, { mode: "tunnel" })`).

Hosted plugins and Studio previews have no direct host filesystem, environment,
process or network access. QuickJS `std` and `os` modules are unavailable.
Use the permission-checked `ether` host APIs for services such as HTTP and
folders. Remote sidecars run under their own operating-system permissions and
are not covered by the hosted sandbox.

## Usage

```ts
import { plugin, serve } from "@ether/plugin-sdk";

const hello = plugin({
  manifest: {
    id: "org.ether.examples.hello",
    name: "Hello plugin",
    version: "0.1.0",
    description: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
    types: ["movie"],
    idPrefixes: ["tt"],
    catalogs: [{ type: "movie", id: "hello", name: "Hello movies" }],
    resources: ["catalog", "meta"],
    ether: {
      protocol: 1,
      kind: "extension",
      capabilities: ["list_source", "ui"],
      summary: "Minimal greeting plugin for Ether.",
      runtime: { kind: "hosted", entry: "plugin.ts" },
    },
  },
  routes: {
    catalog({ type, id }) {
      return {
        metas: [
          {
            id: "tt0133093",
            type,
            name: `Hello from ${id}`,
            releaseInfo: "1999",
          },
        ],
      };
    },
    meta({ type, id }) {
      return {
        meta: {
          id,
          type,
          name: `Title ${id}`,
          releaseInfo: "1999",
          description: "Sample metadata entry.",
        },
      };
    },
  },
});

export const handle = hello.handle;
export const rank_key = hello.rank_key;
export const cond_match = hello.cond_match;
export default hello;

// In a separate Node/Bun entry point: await serve(hello);
```

## Capabilities and routes

- `catalog` (`GET /catalog/{type}/{id}[/{extra}].json`)
- `meta` (`GET /meta/{type}/{id}.json`)
- `stream` (`GET /stream/{type}/{id}[/{extra}].json`) and `openStream` (`POST /ether/stream/open`)
- `subtitles` (`GET /subtitles/{type}/{id}[/{extra}].json`, requires `X-Ether-Pick` header)
- `markers` (`GET /ether/markers/{type}/{id}.json`)
- `channels` (`GET /ether/channels.json`) and `guide` (`GET /ether/guide/{channelId}.json`)
- `notify` (`POST /ether/notify`)
- `event` (`POST /ether/event`)
- `view` (`GET /ether/view/{page}`) and `action` (`POST /ether/action/{action}`)
- `tool` (`POST /ether/tool/{name}`) and `job` (`POST /ether/job/{name}`)
- `file` (`GET /ether/file/{path...}`)
- `rankKey` and `condMatch` hot-path exports (`rank_key`, `cond_match`)

Tunnel mode currently makes one connection. Use a process supervisor to
restart the sidecar after a disconnection.

## Sidecars

A sidecar is a remote plugin whose program runs on a machine you choose and
dials out to Ether over the `ether-tunnel-v1` WebSocket, so it needs no inbound
port. Pair once and the SDK saves the credential:

```sh
ETHER_URL=https://ether.example.com \
ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data \
ETHER_PAIRING_CODE=PAIR-1234 \
node server.js
```

Create the code in Ether under Plugins › your plugin › Connect a sidecar; it is
valid for 5 minutes and single use. `serve(plugin, { mode: "tunnel" })` resolves
the credential in this order: an explicit credential, then the saved file, then
the pairing code (exchanged once and saved). With none it throws
`CredentialError` with one clear line.

- `ETHER_URL` — the server's `http(s)` base; the pair and `ws(s)` tunnel URLs
  are derived from it.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL` — an explicit credential; always wins.
- `ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR` — where the credential is saved, else `/data` when it
  exists and is writable (a Docker volume), else `~/.config/ether-plugins/<id>/`.
- `ETHER_PAIRING_CODE` — a one-time code.

The credential is saved at `<state dir>/credential` (mode `0600`, directory
`0700`). If the tunnel rejects a saved credential, the file is deleted and
`serve` throws `CredentialError` instead of reconnecting forever.

A Dockerfile that keeps the credential across restarts:

```dockerfile
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
VOLUME /data
ENV ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR=/data
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

Declare how the console runs it with an `ether.sidecar` manifest block:

```json
"ether": {
  "runtime": { "kind": "remote" },
  "sidecar": {
    "docker": "ghcr.io/you/my-sidecar:1.0.0",
    "docs": "https://example.com/my-sidecar"
  }
}
```

`docker` is an image reference; `download` (an https URL) with `command` (a
single line) is the alternative; `docs` adds a setup link.

Searchable settings: a `select` field with `search: true` shows an explicit search
control in the installed plugin's Settings drawer. Ether forwards `q` and
`locale` to `GET /ether/options/{key}` in `request.query` (array values when hosted). Return an array of
`{value, label}` choices. The chosen string is stored verbatim; a JSON string can
carry coordinates and a display name together. Search never saves settings.
Background requests receive the server process locale (`LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`,
then `LANG`) in the `X-Ether-Locale` header when the caller has not supplied one.

### Owner-controlled resources and continuing jobs

`ether.runtime.limits` requests `memoryBytes`, `deadline` (a positive Go duration
such as `12h`), `unitBudget`, `fetchBytes`, `archiveMemberBytes`,
`archiveExpandedBytes` and `archiveMembers`. Ether grants each request up to the
owner's global or per-plugin ceiling. Owners can raise or lower ceilings under
Plugins → Settings and in each plugin's drawer. A per-plugin value overrides the
global value, including raising it. Zero inherits; global zero uses the default.
Saving cancels affected jobs and closes runtimes so lowered ceilings apply.

The default memory ceiling is **2 GiB**, adjustable up to wasm32's **4 GiB**;
omitted guest heap requests still use **32 MiB**, allocated only as needed.
The default call/job time ceiling is **12 hours** and background compute is
effectively unlimited (2^60 units per call); owners and manifests may lower it.
The default download and expanded-member ceilings are **8 GiB** each, total
archive expansion **32 GiB**, and archive members **65,535**. Downloads also obey
the library cache quota (2 GiB unless the manifest declares a different quota).
The host reports requested fields in the manifest and exact grants as
`runtimeLimits` in install preview and detail, displayed side by side.

Viewer request-path calls remain bounded: `/stream/`, `/catalog/`, `/meta/`,
`/subtitles/`, `/ether/open`, `/ether/metadata/`, `/ether/subtitles/`,
`/ether/markers`, and `/ether/v1/kinds/` (browse/search/resolve/match) get at most
10,000 units and 30 seconds, further shortened by each route/caller's deadline.
Ranking stays at its existing 2 ms per-candidate and 50 ms per-batch defaults.
Administrative setup, actions, tools, events and jobs use the owner-granted
resources; short health/configuration/view/options protocol deadlines still
protect the host's control plane. Remote plugin processes manage their own CPU
and memory; owner download/archive ceilings also apply to their host services.

An action returning `{job: "build-catalogue"}` starts an owner-triggered job.
Return `{continueInMs: 0, continuation: {next: 41}, progress: "Platform 41 of 92"}`
from its handler to continue. The next `JobRequest.continuation` is that opaque
JSON token. Return `{done: true, progress: "Ready"}` to finish, or
`{failed: "reason"}` to stop. A response without `continueInMs` also finishes.
Non-2xx responses, invalid results and call failures stop the job.

Ether allows 0–300,000 ms between calls with a minimum 100 ms pause. Total wall
time uses the owner time ceiling (12 hours by default), with a 1,000,000-call
sanity bound. Each call gets fresh per-call grants. At most two jobs run per
plugin and the same route cannot overlap. Job threads use OS background CPU/IO
priority on macOS, Linux and Windows. They pause before calls and host-service
operations during playback, Live TV viewing or high CPU/GPU load; pure compute
runs at reduced scheduling priority. Cancellation interrupts in-flight hosted
calls. Work starts only following an owner action; no eager background work.

Tokens are limited to 64 KiB and progress to 1,024 UTF-8 bytes. The drawer shows
progress and a Cancel button. The owner API provides `GET /api/plugins/{id}/jobs`
and `POST /api/plugins/{id}/jobs/cancel` with `{"path":"/ether/job/build-catalogue"}`.
Status includes total-time and attempt caps. Disabling, removing or reloading a
plugin, or stopping Ether, cancels work. The last sixteen route snapshots per
plugin are retained in memory. Store durable checkpoints in KV to recover on a
later owner-started run after restart; Ether does not restart work automatically.

Owner policy is persisted in `plugins.runtimeLimits` and
`plugins.runtimeOverrides[pluginId]`, with the same resource field names as the
manifest. `GET /api/plugins/runtime-limits` returns policy;
`PUT /api/plugins/runtime-limits` takes `{plugin?: string, limits: {...}}`.
Memory cannot exceed 4 GiB, job time has a one-year sanity bound, and member count
has a 1,000,000-entry sanity bound. The ZIP directory has a 64 MiB allocation
bound; traversal, encryption, special files and 1000:1 expansion checks remain.


## Source: sdk/typescript/src/host.ts

``````
/**
 * Host service clients for Ether plugins (SPEC §5.1.5, §5.2, §5.3).
 *
 * In hosted mode (QuickJS on wazero), calls go through the synchronous `ether`
 * and `__ether_host` globals provided by internal/plugins/wasm.
 * In sidecar mode (remote HTTP or tunnel), calls go over HTTP to
 * `/ether/plugin-host/*` authenticated with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`.
 */

import type { MaybePromise } from "./types.ts";
import type { ArchiveMember } from "./kit.ts";

export interface HostFetchRequest {
  method?: string;
  url: string;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
  body?: string;
  bodyBase64?: string;
}

export interface HostFetchResponse {
  status: number;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  body: string;
  bodyBase64?: string;
}

export interface DataRange { offset: number; length: number }
export interface FetchCacheRequest { url: string; headers?: Record<string, string>; libraryKey: string; name: string }
export interface FetchCacheResult { blob: string; size: number; crc32: string; md5: string; sha1: string; status: number }

function checkDataRange(r: DataRange): void {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(r.offset) || r.offset < 0 || r.offset > 256 * 1024 * 1024 || !Number.isSafeInteger(r.length) || r.length <= 0 || r.length > 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("Data range needs nonnegative offset and length 1..1048576");
}
function encodeData(data: Uint8Array): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 3) {
    const n = (data[i]! << 16) | ((data[i + 1] ?? 0) << 8) | (data[i + 2] ?? 0);
    parts.push(alphabet[(n >>> 18) & 63]! + alphabet[(n >>> 12) & 63]! + (i + 1 < data.length ? alphabet[(n >>> 6) & 63] : "=") + (i + 2 < data.length ? alphabet[n & 63] : "="));
  }
  return parts.join("");
}
function encodeText(text: string): Uint8Array {
  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(text); const bytes: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < encoded.length; i++) {
    if (encoded[i] === "%") { bytes.push(parseInt(encoded.slice(i + 1, i + 3), 16)); i += 2; }
    else bytes.push(encoded.charCodeAt(i));
  }
  return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}
function decodeData(r: { bodyBase64: string }): Uint8Array {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  const text = r.bodyBase64;
  const out = new Uint8Array(Math.floor(text.length * 3 / 4) - (text.endsWith("==") ? 2 : text.endsWith("=") ? 1 : 0));
  let acc = 0, bits = 0, pos = 0;
  for (const c of text) {
    if (c === "=") break;
    const n = alphabet.indexOf(c); if (n < 0) throw new Error("Invalid base64 host result");
    acc = (acc << 6) | n; bits += 6;
    if (bits >= 8) { bits -= 8; out[pos++] = (acc >> bits) & 255; }
  }
  return out;
}

export interface FolderHashJob { id: string; state: "running" | "done" | "canceled" | "error"; bytes: number; result?: FolderHash; error?: string }
export interface FolderHash { size: number; modTime: number; crc32: string; md5: string; sha1: string }

export interface FolderEntry {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  dir: boolean;
  size?: number;
  mtime?: number;
}

export interface CatalogTitleSummary {
  id: number | string;
  title: string;
  type: string;
  year?: number;
  imdbId?: string;
  tmdbId?: number;
  genres?: string[];
  posterPath?: string;
  summary?: string;
}

export interface ViewerWatchEntry {
  titleId: string;
  title?: string;
  watchedAt?: string;
  type?: string;
  progress?: number;
  completed?: boolean;
}

export interface EtherHost {
  settings?: { get(): MaybePromise<Record<string, unknown>> };
  kv: {
    get(key: string): MaybePromise<string | null>;
    put(key: string, value: string): MaybePromise<void>;
    delete(key: string): MaybePromise<void>;
    list(prefix?: string): MaybePromise<string[]>;
  };
  secret: {
    get(name: string): MaybePromise<string>;
  };
  http: {
    fetch(req: HostFetchRequest): MaybePromise<HostFetchResponse>;
    fetchToCache?(req: FetchCacheRequest): MaybePromise<FetchCacheResult>;
  };
  catalog: {
    search(
      query: string,
      limit?: number,
      offset?: number,
    ): MaybePromise<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }>;
    get(id: string): MaybePromise<CatalogTitleSummary | null>;
  };
  viewers: {
    granted(): MaybePromise<Array<{ id: number; name: string }>>;
    history(
      viewerId: number,
      limit?: number,
      offset?: number,
    ): MaybePromise<ViewerWatchEntry[]>;
    setWatchState(
      viewerId: number,
      titleId: string,
      watched: boolean,
    ): MaybePromise<void>;
  };
  collections: {
    upsert(collection: Record<string, unknown>): MaybePromise<void>;
  };
  folders: {
    list(root: string, path?: string): MaybePromise<FolderEntry[]>;
    stat(root: string, path: string): MaybePromise<FolderEntry>;
    hash(root: string, path: string): MaybePromise<FolderHash>;
    hashStart(root: string, path: string): MaybePromise<FolderHashJob>;
    hashPoll(id: string): MaybePromise<FolderHashJob>;
    hashCancel(id: string): MaybePromise<FolderHashJob>;
  };
  notify: {
    owner(text: string): MaybePromise<void>;
  };
  /** Content-kind host services (remote + mock clients provide them). */
  kinds?: {
    upsert(kind: string, items: import("./types.ts").KindItem[]): MaybePromise<number>;
    delete(kind: string, externalIds: string[]): MaybePromise<void>;
    items(kind: string, cursor?: string, limit?: number): MaybePromise<import("./types.ts").KindPage>;
    resolveSources(q: import("./types.ts").SourceQuery): MaybePromise<import("./types.ts").SourceCandidate[]>;
  };
  cache?: {
    put(libraryKey: string, name: string, data: Uint8Array): MaybePromise<string>;
    open(blobRef: string): MaybePromise<Uint8Array>;
    read?(blobRef: string, range: DataRange): MaybePromise<Uint8Array>;
  };
  archive?: {
    list(blobRef: string): MaybePromise<ArchiveMember[]>;
    open(blobRef: string, member: number, range: DataRange): MaybePromise<Uint8Array>;
  };
  /**
   * Frontend-adapter host services (spec §6.5). streamUrl mints a scoped,
   * short-lived Ether stream URL for one of this plugin's own kind items;
   * bytes are then served by Ether, never by the plugin.
   */
  frontend?: {
    streamUrl(viewerId: number, itemRef: string): MaybePromise<string>;
  };
  log(level: string, message: string, attrs?: Record<string, unknown>): MaybePromise<void>;
  abort(message?: string): never;
}

interface GlobalEtherBindings {
  __ether_host?: (name: string, argsJson: string) => string;
  ether?: {
    log: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
    abort: (msg?: string) => never;
    kv: {
      get: (k: string) => string | null;
      put: (k: string, v: string) => void;
      delete: (k: string) => void;
      list: (prefix?: string) => string[];
    };
    secret: {
      get: (name: string) => string;
    };
    http: {
      fetch: (req: HostFetchRequest) => HostFetchResponse;
    };
    catalog: {
      search: (q: string, limit?: number, offset?: number) => { titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] };
      get: (id: string) => CatalogTitleSummary | null;
    };
    viewers: {
      granted: () => Array<{ id: number; name: string }>;
      history: (viewerId: number, limit?: number, offset?: number) => ViewerWatchEntry[];
      setWatchState: (
        viewerIdOrObj: number | { viewerId: number; titleId: string; watched: boolean },
        titleId?: string,
        watched?: boolean,
      ) => void;
    };
    collections: {
      upsert: (c: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
    };
    folders: {
      list: (root: string, path?: string) => FolderEntry[];
      stat: (root: string, path: string) => FolderEntry;
      hash: (root: string, path: string) => FolderHash;
      hashStart: (root: string, path: string) => FolderHashJob;
      hashPoll: (id: string) => FolderHashJob;
      hashCancel: (id: string) => FolderHashJob;
    };
    notify: {
      owner: (text: string) => void;
    };
    frontend: {
      streamURL: (itemRef: string) => { url: string };
    };
  };
}

/**
 * Returns true when running inside the Ether QuickJS hosted runtime.
 */
export function isHostedRuntime(): boolean {
  const g = globalThis as unknown as GlobalEtherBindings;
  return typeof g.__ether_host === "function" || typeof g.ether === "object";
}

/**
 * Creates a host client bound to the QuickJS hosted runtime globals (`globalThis.ether` / `__ether_host`).
 */
export function createHostedClient(): EtherHost {
  const g = globalThis as unknown as GlobalEtherBindings;

  const callHost = <T>(name: string, args: unknown[]): T => {
    if (typeof g.__ether_host === "function") {
      const raw = g.__ether_host(name, JSON.stringify(args));
      return (raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null) as T;
    }
    throw new Error(`Host service ${name} is not available outside the Ether runtime`);
  };

  return {
    archive: {
      list: (blob) => callHost<ArchiveMember[]>("archive.list", [blob]),
      open: (blob, member, range) => { checkDataRange(range); return decodeData(callHost("archive.open", [blob, member, range])); },
    },
    cache: {
      put: (lib, name, data) => callHost<{blob: string}>("cache.put", [lib, name, {bodyBase64: encodeData(data)}]).blob,
      open: (blob) => { const r = callHost<{body?: string; bodyBase64?: string}>("cache.open", [blob]); return r.bodyBase64 ? decodeData({bodyBase64: r.bodyBase64}) : encodeText(r.body ?? ""); },
      read: (blob, range) => { checkDataRange(range); return decodeData(callHost("cache.read", [blob, range])); },
    },
    settings: { get: () => callHost<Record<string, unknown>>("settings.get", []) },
    kv: {
      get(key: string): string | null {
        if (g.ether?.kv) return g.ether.kv.get(key) ?? null;
        return callHost<string | null>("kv.get", [key]);
      },
      put(key: string, value: string): void {
        if (g.ether?.kv) {
          g.ether.kv.put(key, String(value));
          return;
        }
        callHost("kv.put", [key, String(value)]);
      },
      delete(key: string): void {
        if (g.ether?.kv) {
          g.ether.kv.delete(key);
          return;
        }
        callHost("kv.delete", [key]);
      },
      list(prefix = ""): string[] {
        if (g.ether?.kv) return g.ether.kv.list(prefix) ?? [];
        return callHost<string[]>("kv.list", [prefix]) ?? [];
      },
    },
    secret: {
      get(name: string): string {
        if (g.ether?.secret) return g.ether.secret.get(name);
        return callHost<string>("secret.get", [name]);
      },
    },
    http: {
      fetchToCache: (req) => callHost<FetchCacheResult>("http.fetchToCache", [req]),
      fetch(req: HostFetchRequest): HostFetchResponse {
        const normalized = {
          method: req.method ?? "GET",
          url: req.url,
          headers: req.headers ?? {},
          ...(req.bodyBase64 !== undefined ? { bodyBase64: req.bodyBase64 } : { body: req.body ?? "" }),
        };
        if (g.ether?.http) return g.ether.http.fetch(normalized);
        return callHost<HostFetchResponse>("http.fetch", [normalized]);
      },
    },
    catalog: {
      search(query: string, limit = 50, offset = 0): { titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] } {
        if (typeof g.__ether_host === "function") {
          return callHost<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }>("catalog.search", [
            query,
            limit,
            offset,
          ]);
        }
        if (g.ether?.catalog) return g.ether.catalog.search(query, limit, offset);
        return { titles: [] };
      },
      get(id: string): CatalogTitleSummary | null {
        if (g.ether?.catalog) return g.ether.catalog.get(id);
        return callHost<CatalogTitleSummary | null>("catalog.get", [id]);
      },
    },
    viewers: {
      granted() { return callHost<Array<{ id: number; name: string }>>("viewers.granted", []) ?? []; },
      history(viewerId: number, limit = 50, offset = 0): ViewerWatchEntry[] {
        if (typeof g.__ether_host === "function") {
          return callHost<ViewerWatchEntry[]>("viewers.history", [viewerId, limit, offset]) ?? [];
        }
        if (g.ether?.viewers) return g.ether.viewers.history(viewerId, limit, offset) ?? [];
        return [];
      },
      setWatchState(viewerId: number, titleId: string, watched: boolean): void {
        if (typeof g.__ether_host === "function") {
          callHost("viewers.setWatchState", [viewerId, titleId, watched]);
          return;
        }
        if (g.ether?.viewers) {
          g.ether.viewers.setWatchState(viewerId, titleId, watched);
          return;
        }
        callHost("viewers.setWatchState", [viewerId, titleId, watched]);
      },
    },
    collections: {
      upsert(collection: Record<string, unknown>): void {
        if (g.ether?.collections) {
          g.ether.collections.upsert(collection);
          return;
        }
        callHost("collections.upsert", [collection]);
      },
    },
    folders: {
      list(root: string, path = ""): FolderEntry[] {
        if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.list(root, path) ?? [];
        return callHost<FolderEntry[]>("folders.list", [root, path]) ?? [];
      },
      hashStart(root: string, path: string): FolderHashJob { if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.hashStart(root, path); return callHost<FolderHashJob>("folders.hashStart", [root, path]); },
      hashPoll(id: string): FolderHashJob { if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.hashPoll(id); return callHost<FolderHashJob>("folders.hashPoll", [id]); },
      hashCancel(id: string): FolderHashJob { if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.hashCancel(id); return callHost<FolderHashJob>("folders.hashCancel", [id]); },
      hash(root: string, path: string): FolderHash {
        if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.hash(root, path);
        return callHost<FolderHash>("folders.hash", [root, path]);
      },
      stat(root: string, path: string): FolderEntry {
        if (g.ether?.folders) return g.ether.folders.stat(root, path);
        return callHost<FolderEntry>("folders.stat", [root, path]);
      },
    },
    notify: {
      owner(text: string): void {
        if (g.ether?.notify) {
          g.ether.notify.owner(text);
          return;
        }
        callHost("notify.owner", [text]);
      },
    },
    frontend: {
      streamUrl(viewerId: number, itemRef: string): string {
        // The hosted binding is viewer-scoped by Ether already; the viewerId
        // argument is accepted for parity with the remote client.
        void viewerId;
        const r = callHost<{ url: string }>("frontend.streamURL", [itemRef]);
        return r?.url ?? "";
      },
    },
    log(level: string, message: string, attrs?: Record<string, unknown>): void {
      if (typeof g.__ether_host === "function") {
        try {
          g.__ether_host(
            "log",
            JSON.stringify(attrs ? [level, message, attrs] : [level, message]),
          );
        } catch {
          // Logging never fails the caller.
        }
        return;
      }
      if (g.ether?.log) {
        g.ether.log(level, message, attrs ? JSON.stringify(attrs) : "");
      }
    },
    abort(message = "aborted"): never {
      if (g.ether?.abort) {
        return g.ether.abort(message);
      }
      throw new Error(
        "__ETHER_FAULT__" + JSON.stringify({ code: "aborted", message: String(message) }),
      );
    },
  };
}

export const createHostedHostClient = createHostedClient;
// Choose the host transport for the runtime that loaded this plugin.
export const ether: EtherHost = isHostedRuntime()
  ? createHostedClient()
  : createRemoteHostClient();

export interface RemoteHostOptions {
  /** Base URL of the Ether server (for example "http://127.0.0.1:32450"). */
  baseUrl?: string;
  /** Plugin credential issued during pairing (`X-Ether-Plugin-Credential`). */
  credential?: string;
  /** Optional custom fetch implementation for testing. */
  fetchImpl?: typeof fetch;
}

function readEnv(name: string): string | undefined {
  const g = globalThis as { process?: { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> } };
  return g.process?.env?.[name];
}

/**
 * Creates a host client for remote/sidecar plugins that calls `/ether/plugin-host/*`
 * on Ether with `X-Ether-Plugin-Credential` (SPEC §5.1.5, WS8b).
 */
export function createRemoteHostClient(opts: RemoteHostOptions = {}): EtherHost {
  const rawBase = opts.baseUrl ?? readEnv("ETHER_HOST_URL") ?? "http://127.0.0.1:32450";
  const base = rawBase.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  const credential = opts.credential ?? readEnv("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL") ?? "";
  const doFetch = opts.fetchImpl ?? fetch;

  const callJson = async <T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body?: unknown,
    allow404 = false,
  ): Promise<T | null> => {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      "X-Ether-Plugin-Credential": credential,
      Accept: "application/json",
    };
    let payload: string | undefined;
    if (body !== undefined) {
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
      payload = JSON.stringify(body);
    }
    const resp = await doFetch(`${base}${path}`, {
      method,
      headers,
      body: payload,
    });
    if (allow404 && resp.status === 404) {
      return null;
    }
    const text = await resp.text();
    const parsed = text ? (JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>) : null;
    if (!resp.ok) {
      const errObj =
        parsed && typeof parsed.error === "object" ? (parsed.error as Record<string, string>) : null;
      throw new Error(
        errObj?.message ?? `Host call ${method} ${path} failed with HTTP ${resp.status}`,
      );
    }
    return parsed as T;
  };

  return {
    archive: {
      list: async (blob) => (await callJson<ArchiveMember[]>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/data/archive.list", [blob])) ?? [],
      open: async (blob, member, range) => { checkDataRange(range); return decodeData((await callJson<{bodyBase64: string}>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/data/archive.open", [blob, member, range]))!); },
    },
    ...(credential ? { settings: { get: async () => (await callJson<{ settings: Record<string, unknown> }>("GET", "/ether/plugin-host/settings"))?.settings ?? {} } } : {}),
    kv: {
      async get(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
        const res = await callJson<{ key: string; value: string }>(
          "GET",
          `/ether/plugin-host/kv/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`,
          undefined,
          true,
        );
        return res ? res.value : null;
      },
      async put(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
        await callJson("PUT", `/ether/plugin-host/kv/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`, {
          value: String(value),
        });
      },
      async delete(key: string): Promise<void> {
        await callJson("DELETE", `/ether/plugin-host/kv/${encodeURIComponent(key)}`);
      },
      async list(prefix = ""): Promise<string[]> {
        const q = prefix ? `?prefix=${encodeURIComponent(prefix)}` : "";
        const res = await callJson<{ keys: string[] }>("GET", `/ether/plugin-host/kv${q}`);
        return res?.keys ?? [];
      },
    },
    secret: {
      get(_name: string): Promise<string> {
        return Promise.reject(
          new Error(
            "secret.get is only available in hosted plugins; remote plugins receive secrets via /ether/configure",
          ),
        );
      },
    },
    http: {
      fetchToCache: async (req) => (await callJson<FetchCacheResult>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/data/http.fetchToCache", [req]))!,
      async fetch(req: HostFetchRequest): Promise<HostFetchResponse> {
        const resp = await doFetch(req.url, {
          method: req.method ?? "GET",
          headers: req.headers,
          body: req.body,
        });
        const outHeaders: Record<string, string> = {};
        resp.headers.forEach((v, k) => {
          outHeaders[k] = v;
        });
        return {
          status: resp.status,
          headers: outHeaders,
          body: await resp.text(),
        };
      },
    },
    catalog: {
      async search(
        query: string,
        limit = 50,
        offset = 0,
      ): Promise<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }> {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({
          q: query,
          limit: String(limit),
          offset: String(offset),
        });
        const res = await callJson<{ titles: CatalogTitleSummary[] }>(
          "GET",
          `/ether/plugin-host/catalog/search?${params.toString()}`,
        );
        return res ?? { titles: [] };
      },
      async get(id: string): Promise<CatalogTitleSummary | null> {
        return callJson<CatalogTitleSummary>(
          "GET",
          `/ether/plugin-host/catalog/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
          undefined,
          true,
        );
      },
    },
    viewers: {
      async granted() { return (await callJson<Array<{ id: number; name: string }>>("GET", "/ether/plugin-host/viewers/granted")) ?? []; },
      async history(viewerId: number, limit = 50, offset = 0): Promise<ViewerWatchEntry[]> {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({
          limit: String(limit),
          offset: String(offset),
        });
        const res = await callJson<ViewerWatchEntry[]>(
          "GET",
          `/ether/plugin-host/viewers/${viewerId}/history?${params.toString()}`,
        );
        return res ?? [];
      },
      async setWatchState(viewerId: number, titleId: string, watched: boolean): Promise<void> {
        await callJson("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/viewers/watch-state", {
          viewerId,
          titleId,
          watched,
        });
      },
    },
    collections: {
      async upsert(collection: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
        await callJson("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/collections/upsert", collection);
      },
    },
    folders: {
      list(): Promise<FolderEntry[]> {
        return Promise.reject(
          new Error(
            "folders.list is for hosted plugins; sidecar plugins read their local fileRoot directly",
          ),
        );
      },
      hashStart(): Promise<FolderHashJob> { return Promise.reject(new Error("folders.hash requires the hosted runtime")); },
      hashPoll(): Promise<FolderHashJob> { return Promise.reject(new Error("folders.hash requires the hosted runtime")); },
      hashCancel(): Promise<FolderHashJob> { return Promise.reject(new Error("folders.hash requires the hosted runtime")); },
      hash(): Promise<FolderHash> { return Promise.reject(new Error("folders.hash requires the hosted runtime")); },
      stat(): Promise<FolderEntry> {
        return Promise.reject(
          new Error(
            "folders.stat is for hosted plugins; sidecar plugins read their local fileRoot directly",
          ),
        );
      },
    },
    notify: {
      async owner(text: string): Promise<void> {
        await callJson("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/notify", { text });
      },
    },
    kinds: {
      async upsert(kind, items) {
        const r = await callJson<{ accepted: number }>("POST", `/ether/plugin-host/kinds/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/upsert`, { items });
        return r?.accepted ?? 0;
      },
      async delete(kind, externalIds) {
        await callJson("POST", `/ether/plugin-host/kinds/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/delete`, { externalIds });
      },
      async items(kind, cursor = "", limit = 200) {
        return (await callJson("GET", `/ether/plugin-host/kinds/${encodeURIComponent(kind)}/items?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}&limit=${limit}`)) ?? { items: [] };
      },
      async resolveSources(q) {
        const r = await callJson<{ candidates: unknown[] }>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/sources/resolve", q);
        return (r?.candidates ?? []) as never[];
      },
    },
    cache: {
      read: async (blob, range) => { checkDataRange(range); return decodeData((await callJson<{bodyBase64: string}>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/data/cache.read", [blob, range]))!); },
      async put(libraryKey, name, data) {
        const resp = await doFetch(`${base}/ether/plugin-host/cache/${encodeURIComponent(libraryKey)}?name=${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: credential ? { "X-Ether-Plugin-Credential": credential } : {},
          body: data as BodyInit,
        });
        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`plugin-host cache put: status ${resp.status}`);
        return ((await resp.json()) as { blob?: string }).blob ?? "";
      },
      async open(blobRef) {
        const resp = await doFetch(`${base}/ether/plugin-host/cache/${blobRef.replace(/^\//, "")}`, {
          headers: credential ? { "X-Ether-Plugin-Credential": credential } : {},
        });
        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`plugin-host cache open: status ${resp.status}`);
        return new Uint8Array(await resp.arrayBuffer());
      },
    },
    frontend: {
      async streamUrl(viewerId: number, itemRef: string): Promise<string> {
        const r = await callJson<{ url: string }>("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/frontend/stream-url", {
          viewerId,
          itemRef,
        });
        return r?.url ?? "";
      },
    },
    async log(level: string, message: string, attrs?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
      await callJson("POST", "/ether/plugin-host/log", { level, message, attrs });
    },
    abort(message = "aborted"): never {
      throw new Error(message);
    },
  };
}

``````
``````
/**
 * i18n and copy-rule helpers for Ether plugins (SPEC §2.7, §2.8, §5.1.1, §5.6).
 */

export type LocaleStrings = Record<string, string>;
export type StringsCatalog = Record<string, LocaleStrings>;

export interface I18nHelper {
  /** Resolves a key for the given locale with fallback to base language, then "en", then the key itself. */
  t(key: string, params?: Record<string, string | number>, locale?: string): string;
  /** Returns a "$t:<key>" reference for manifest and ViewSpec fields. */
  ref(key: string): `$t:${string}`;
  /** Returns the full catalog of locale strings. */
  catalog(): StringsCatalog;
}

/** Returns a `$t:key` reference for manifest and ViewSpec fields. */
export function tRef<K extends string>(key: K): `$t:${K}` {
  return `$t:${key}`;
}

/** Creates a locale resolver backed by an inline strings catalog. */
export function createI18n(
  strings: StringsCatalog = {},
  defaultLocale = "en",
): I18nHelper {
  const resolveKey = (
    rawKey: string,
    params?: Record<string, string | number>,
    locale = defaultLocale,
  ): string => {
    const key = rawKey.startsWith("$t:") ? rawKey.slice(3) : rawKey;
    const base = locale ? locale.split("-")[0] ?? "" : "";
    const candidates = [locale, base, "en"];
    let template: string | undefined;
    for (const loc of candidates) {
      if (!loc) continue;
      const table = strings[loc];
      if (table && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(table, key)) {
        template = table[key];
        break;
      }
    }
    if (template === undefined) {
      template = key;
    }
    if (!params) return template;
    return template.replace(/\{([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\}/g, (match, name: string) => {
      const val = params[name];
      return val !== undefined ? String(val) : match;
    });
  };

  return {
    t: resolveKey,
    ref: tRef,
    catalog: () => strings,
  };
}

const BANNED_WORDS = /\b(simply|easily|just)\b/i;

/**
 * Checks a user-visible string against Ether's copy rules (internal/plugins/manifest.go LintCopy):
 * - max characters (when max > 0)
 * - no em or en dashes
 * - no exclamation marks
 * - no "simply", "just" or "easily"
 * - sentence case (starts with an uppercase letter, not Title Case)
 * Returns an empty string when valid, or the plain reason when invalid.
 */
export function lintCopy(raw: string, max = 0): string {
  const s = raw.trim();
  if (max > 0 && Array.from(s).length > max) {
    return `is longer than ${max} characters`;
  }
  if (s.includes("—") || s.includes("–")) {
    return "must not contain em or en dashes";
  }
  if (s.includes("!")) {
    return "must not contain exclamation marks";
  }
  if (BANNED_WORDS.test(s)) {
    return "must not use the words simply, just or easily";
  }
  for (const ch of s) {
    const lower = ch.toLowerCase();
    const upper = ch.toUpperCase();
    if (lower !== upper) {
      if (ch === lower) {
        return "must use sentence case";
      }
      break;
    }
  }
  const words = s.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length >= 3) {
    let caps = 0;
    for (const w of words) {
      const first = Array.from(w)[0];
      if (first && first.toLowerCase() !== first.toUpperCase() && first === first.toUpperCase()) {
        caps++;
      }
    }
    if (caps * 3 > words.length * 2) {
      return "must use sentence case";
    }
  }
  return "";
}
``````

## Source: sdk/typescript/src/kinds.ts

``````
/**
 * Content-kind handlers (Ether v0.3.8): catalogue providers, resolvers,
 * matchers, frontend adapters and setup tests, plus the dispatch the
 * router calls for /ether/v1/kinds, /ether/v1/setup and
 * /ether/v1/frontend. Wire shapes live in types.ts and are pinned by
 * sdk/conformance/kinds/fixture.json across all three SDKs.
 */
import type { PluginContext } from "./router.ts";
import type {
  KindBrowseRequest,
  KindChangePage,
  KindItem,
  KindMatchRequest,
  KindMatchScore,
  KindPage,
  KindResolveRequest,
  KindResolveResponse,
  MaybePromise,
  RawRequest,
  RawResponse,
  SetupTestRequest,
  SetupTestResult,
  SourceCandidate,
} from "./types.ts";

export interface CatalogProvider<S = Record<string, unknown>> {
  browse(req: KindBrowseRequest, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<KindPage>;
  detail(kind: string, id: string, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<KindItem>;
  /** Optional delta feed for pull sync; without it Ether re-walks. */
  changes?(req: { kind: string; cursor?: string; limit?: number }, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<KindChangePage>;
  /** Optional provider search; required when the kind declares browse.liveSearch. */
  search?(req: KindBrowseRequest, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<KindPage>;
}

export interface KindResolver<S = Record<string, unknown>> {
  resolve(req: KindResolveRequest, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<KindResolveResponse>;
}

export interface KindMatcher<S = Record<string, unknown>> {
  match(req: KindMatchRequest, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<{ matches: KindMatchScore[] }>;
}

/** Spec-name alias. */
export type Matcher<S = Record<string, unknown>> = KindMatcher<S>;

export interface FrontendAdapter {
  handle(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    headers: Record<string, string>,
    body: string,
  ): MaybePromise<{ status: number; headers?: Record<string, string>; body: string }>;
}

export interface SetupTester<S = Record<string, unknown>> {
  testSetup(req: SetupTestRequest, ctx: PluginContext<S>): MaybePromise<SetupTestResult>;
}

/** The stable ref matchers report for a source candidate. */
export function candidateRef(c: SourceCandidate): string {
  if (c.infoHash) return `infohash:${c.infoHash.toLowerCase()}`;
  if (c.magnet) return `magnet:${c.magnet}`;
  if (c.nzbUrl) return `nzb:${c.nzbUrl}`;
  return c.title ?? "";
}

/**
 * Mint a scoped, short-lived Ether stream URL for one of this plugin's own
 * kind items (spec §6.5). The viewer is the one Ether authenticated on this
 * request (X-Ether-Viewer); bytes are served by Ether, never by the plugin.
 */
export async function streamUrl<S = Record<string, unknown>>(
  ctx: PluginContext<S>,
  itemRef: string,
): Promise<string> {
  if (!ctx.ether?.frontend) throw new Error("stream url: no host service available");
  const raw = ctx.headers["X-Ether-Viewer"] ?? ctx.headers["x-ether-viewer"];
  const value = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw;
  const viewerId = Number.parseInt(String(value ?? ""), 10);
  if (!Number.isFinite(viewerId) || viewerId <= 0) {
    throw new Error("stream url: no authenticated viewer on this request");
  }
  return ctx.ether.frontend.streamUrl(viewerId, itemRef);
}

export interface KindHandlers<S = Record<string, unknown>> {
  catalog: Map<string, CatalogProvider<S>>;
  resolve: Map<string, KindResolver<S>>;
  match: Map<string, KindMatcher<S>>;
  frontend: Map<string, FrontendAdapter>;
  setup?: SetupTester<S>;
}

export function createKindHandlers<S = Record<string, unknown>>(): KindHandlers<S> {
  return { catalog: new Map(), resolve: new Map(), match: new Map(), frontend: new Map() };
}

function ok(body: unknown): RawResponse {
  return { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body };
}

function err(status: number, code: string, message: string): RawResponse {
  return { status, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: { error: { code, message } } };
}

function parseBody(body: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (typeof body === "string" && body.trim()) {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(body) as unknown;
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  }
  if (body && typeof body === "object") return body as Record<string, unknown>;
  return {};
}

/**
 * The original query for a frontend-adapter request, from the flat `query`
 * map and the query string still attached to `path`. Repeated keys arrive
 * flattened to the first value by the server.
 */
function frontendQuery(req: RawRequest): URLSearchParams {
  const query = new URLSearchParams();
  if (req.query) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.query)) {
      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
        if (v.length > 0) query.set(k, String(v[0]));
      } else if (v !== undefined && v !== null) {
        query.set(k, String(v));
      }
    }
  }
  const qIndex = (req.path || "").indexOf("?");
  if (qIndex >= 0) {
    for (const [k, v] of new URLSearchParams((req.path || "").slice(qIndex + 1))) {
      if (!query.has(k)) query.set(k, v);
    }
  }
  return query;
}

/** Dispatch one /ether/v1/* request; returns null when the path is not a kind route. */
export async function dispatchKinds<S = Record<string, unknown>>(
  handlers: KindHandlers<S>,
  req: RawRequest,
  ctx: PluginContext<S>,
): Promise<RawResponse | null> {
  const method = (req.method || "GET").toUpperCase();
  const path = (req.path || "/").split("?")[0] ?? "/";
  if (!path.startsWith("/ether/v1/")) return null;
  const parts = path.slice("/ether/v1/".length).split("/").map((p) => decodeURIComponent(p));

  // Frontend adapters are protocol surfaces (WebDAV, Subsonic, OPDS, …) and
  // see every method token. The kind and setup routes stay JSON GET/POST.
  if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] === "frontend") {
    const adapter = handlers.frontend.get(parts[1] ?? "");
    if (!adapter) return err(404, "not_found", `No frontend adapter is registered for "${parts[1]}".`);
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.headers ?? {})) headers[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? (v[0] ?? "") : v;
    // Rebuild the adapter URL with the original query. The server flattens
    // repeated keys to the first value, so the query holds one value per key.
    let subPath = `/${parts.slice(2).join("/")}`;
    const query = frontendQuery(req);
    const qs = query.toString();
    if (qs) subPath += `?${qs}`;
    const res = await adapter.handle(method, subPath, headers, typeof req.body === "string" ? req.body : "");
    if (res.body.length > 10 * 1024 * 1024) return err(502, "adapter_error", "Frontend adapter response is larger than 10 MiB; serve media through Ether stream URLs.");
    // A HEAD reply carries headers only, exactly as a real server would.
    return { status: res.status, headers: res.headers ?? {}, body: method === "HEAD" ? "" : res.body };
  }

  if (method !== "GET" && method !== "POST") {
    return err(405, "method_not_allowed", "Kind routes use GET or POST.");
  }

  let body: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    body = parseBody(req.body);
  } catch {
    return err(400, "invalid_json", "Request body must be valid JSON.");
  }

  if (parts.length === 3 && parts[0] === "setup" && parts[2] === "test") {
    if (!handlers.setup) return err(404, "not_found", "Setup test handler is not registered.");
    const input = { step: String(body.step || parts[1]), fields: body.fields as Record<string, unknown> | undefined };
    return ok(await handlers.setup.testSetup(input, ctx));
  }

  if (parts.length < 3 || parts[0] !== "kinds") return null;
  const kind = parts[1] ?? "";
  const tail = parts.slice(2);
  const browseReq = { ...body, kind } as unknown as KindBrowseRequest;
  const page = async (p: MaybePromise<KindPage>): Promise<RawResponse> => {
    const result = { ...(await p) };
    const limit = Number(browseReq.limit || 200);
    result.items = (result.items ?? []).slice(0, limit);
    if (!result.nextCursor) delete result.nextCursor;
    return ok(result);
  };

  if (tail.length === 1 && (tail[0] === "browse" || tail[0] === "search")) {
    const provider = handlers.catalog.get(kind);
    if (!provider) return err(404, "not_found", `No catalogue provider is registered for kind "${kind}".`);
    if (tail[0] === "search") {
      if (!provider.search) return err(501, "not_implemented", "This provider does not search.");
      return page(provider.search(browseReq, ctx));
    }
    return page(provider.browse(browseReq, ctx));
  }
  if (tail.length === 2 && tail[0] === "items") {
    const provider = handlers.catalog.get(kind);
    if (!provider) return err(404, "not_found", `No catalogue provider is registered for kind "${kind}".`);
    return ok(await provider.detail(kind, tail[1] ?? "", ctx));
  }
  if (tail.length === 1 && tail[0] === "changes") {
    const provider = handlers.catalog.get(kind);
    if (!provider?.changes) return err(501, "not_implemented", "This provider has no changes feed.");
    const result = { ...(await provider.changes({ kind, cursor: body.cursor as string | undefined, limit: body.limit as number | undefined }, ctx)) };
    result.upserts = result.upserts ?? [];
    return ok(result);
  }
  if (tail.length === 1 && tail[0] === "resolve") {
    const resolver = handlers.resolve.get(kind);
    if (!resolver) return err(404, "not_found", `No resolver is registered for kind "${kind}".`);
    const result = { ...(await resolver.resolve({ ...body, kind } as unknown as KindResolveRequest, ctx)) };
    result.sources = result.sources ?? [];
    return ok(result);
  }
  if (tail.length === 1 && tail[0] === "match") {
    const matcher = handlers.match.get(kind);
    if (!matcher) return err(404, "not_found", `No matcher is registered for kind "${kind}".`);
    const result = { ...(await matcher.match({ ...body, kind } as unknown as KindMatchRequest, ctx)) };
    result.matches = result.matches ?? [];
    return ok(result);
  }
  return err(404, "not_found", "No kind route matched.");
}
``````

## Source: sdk/typescript/src/kit.ts

``````
/**
 * Kit helpers for content-kind plugins (stdlib/runtime only, matching
 * sdk/go/kit): feed parsing, zip member listing, and simple HTML text
 * and link extraction for listing pages.
 */

export interface FeedEntry {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  summary: string;
  link: string;
  audio: string;
  date: string;
}

export interface ParsedFeed {
  title: string;
  summary: string;
  link: string;
  entries: FeedEntry[];
}

function tagText(block: string, name: string): string {
  const m = new RegExp(`<${name}(?:\\s[^>]*)?>([\\s\\S]*?)</${name}>`, "i").exec(block);
  return m ? m[1]!.replace(/<!\[CDATA\[([\s\S]*?)\]\]>/, "$1").trim() : "";
}

function blocks(xml: string, name: string): string[] {
  return [...xml.matchAll(new RegExp(`<${name}(?:\\s[^>]*)?>([\\s\\S]*?)</${name}>`, "gi"))].map((m) => m[1]!);
}

/** Parse RSS, Atom or JSON Feed into a normalised feed. */
export function parseFeed(data: string): ParsedFeed {
  if (data.trimStart().startsWith("{")) {
    const doc = JSON.parse(data) as Record<string, any>;
    return {
      title: doc.title ?? "",
      summary: doc.description ?? "",
      link: doc.home_page_url ?? "",
      entries: (doc.items ?? []).map((it: Record<string, any>) => ({
        id: it.id || it.url || "",
        title: it.title ?? "",
        summary: it.summary ?? "",
        link: it.url ?? "",
        audio: it.attachments?.[0]?.url ?? "",
        date: it.date_published ?? "",
      })),
    };
  }
  if (/<feed[\s>]/.test(data)) {
    return {
      title: tagText(data, "title"),
      summary: tagText(data, "subtitle"),
      link: "",
      entries: blocks(data, "entry").map((e) => {
        let page = "";
        let media = "";
        for (const m of e.matchAll(/<link[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>/gi)) {
          if (/rel="enclosure"/.test(m[0])) media = m[1]!;
          else if (!page) page = m[1]!;
        }
        return { id: tagText(e, "id") || page, title: tagText(e, "title"), summary: tagText(e, "summary"), link: page, audio: media, date: tagText(e, "updated") };
      }),
    };
  }
  const channel = blocks(data, "channel")[0] ?? data;
  return {
    title: tagText(channel.split("<item")[0]!, "title"),
    summary: tagText(channel.split("<item")[0]!, "description"),
    link: tagText(channel.split("<item")[0]!, "link"),
    entries: blocks(data, "item").map((e) => ({
      id: tagText(e, "guid") || tagText(e, "link"),
      title: tagText(e, "title"),
      summary: tagText(e, "description"),
      link: tagText(e, "link"),
      audio: /<enclosure[^>]*url="([^"]+)"/.exec(e)?.[1] ?? "",
      date: tagText(e, "pubDate"),
    })),
  };
}

/** One non-directory zip member, in archive order. */
export interface ArchiveMember {
  index: number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
}

/** List zip/cbz/epub members by reading the central directory. */
export function archiveList(data: Uint8Array): ArchiveMember[] {
  const view = new DataView(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength);
  let eocd = -1;
  for (let i = data.length - 22; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (view.getUint32(i, true) === 0x06054b50) { eocd = i; break; }
  }
  if (eocd < 0) throw new Error("archiveList: not a zip archive");
  const count = view.getUint16(eocd + 10, true);
  let off = view.getUint32(eocd + 16, true);
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  const out: ArchiveMember[] = [];
  for (let n = 0; n < count && off + 46 <= data.length; n++) {
    if (view.getUint32(off, true) !== 0x02014b50) break;
    const size = view.getUint32(off + 24, true);
    const nameLen = view.getUint16(off + 28, true);
    const extraLen = view.getUint16(off + 30, true);
    const commentLen = view.getUint16(off + 32, true);
    const name = decoder.decode(data.subarray(off + 46, off + 46 + nameLen));
    if (!name.endsWith("/")) out.push({ index: out.length, name, size });
    off += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;
  }
  return out;
}

/** Strip markup down to readable text. */
export function scrapeText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>|<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>|<[^>]+>/gi, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

/** Extract anchors with absolute URLs resolved against base. */
export function scrapeLinks(html: string, base: string): Array<{ url: string; text: string }> {
  const out: Array<{ url: string; text: string }> = [];
  for (const m of html.matchAll(/<a\s[^>]*href\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi)) {
    const href = m[1]!.trim();
    if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("javascript:")) continue;
    out.push({ url: new URL(href, base).toString(), text: scrapeText(m[2]!) });
  }
  return out;
}
``````

## Source: sdk/typescript/src/pairing.ts

``````
/**
 * Sidecar pairing built into the SDK. Every plugin used to hand-write the
 * code exchange and keep the credential in memory; this resolves a credential
 * once, saves it under the state directory, and reuses it across restarts.
 */
export const PAIR_EXCHANGE_PATH = "/ether/plugins/pair";
export const TUNNEL_PATH = "/ether/plugins/tunnel";

const CREDENTIAL_FILE_MODE = 0o600;
const STATE_DIR_MODE = 0o700;

export class CredentialError extends Error {}

export function noCredentialMessage(): string {
  return (
    "No credential: create a pairing code in Ether (Plugins > this plugin > " +
    "Connect a sidecar) and set ETHER_PAIRING_CODE."
  );
}

export interface PairingInputs {
  url?: string;
  code?: string;
  credential?: string;
  stateDir?: string;
}

function env(name: string): string | undefined {
  const g = globalThis as { process?: { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> } };
  return g.process?.env?.[name];
}

async function nodeFs(): Promise<typeof import("node:fs")> {
  // A computed specifier keeps a hosted bundle from resolving the Node module.
  const spec = "node:" + "fs";
  return (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ spec)) as typeof import("node:fs");
}

async function nodeOs(): Promise<typeof import("node:os")> {
  const spec = "node:" + "os";
  return (await import(/* @vite-ignore */ spec)) as typeof import("node:os");
}

export function serverBase(base: string | undefined): string {
  const trimmed = (base ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    throw new CredentialError("ETHER_URL is not set");
  }
  let parsed: URL;
  try {
    parsed = new URL(trimmed);
  } catch {
    throw new CredentialError("ETHER_URL is not a valid URL");
  }
  if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
    throw new CredentialError("ETHER_URL must use http or https");
  }
  if (!parsed.host) {
    throw new CredentialError("ETHER_URL has no host");
  }
  return `${parsed.protocol}//${parsed.host}`;
}

export function tunnelUrlFromBase(base: string | undefined): string {
  const parsed = new URL(serverBase(base));
  const scheme = parsed.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:";
  return `${scheme}//${parsed.host}${TUNNEL_PATH}`;
}

export function pairUrlFromBase(base: string | undefined): string {
  return serverBase(base) + PAIR_EXCHANGE_PATH;
}

export async function resolveStateDir(explicit: string, pluginId: string): Promise<string> {
  if (explicit.trim()) {
    return explicit.trim();
  }
  const fs = await nodeFs();
  try {
    const info = fs.statSync("/data");
    if (info.isDirectory()) {
      fs.accessSync("/data", fs.constants.W_OK);
      return "/data";
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to the user config directory.
  }
  const os = await nodeOs();
  const configHome = env("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") ?? `${os.homedir()}/.config`;
  return `${configHome}/ether-plugins/${pluginId || "plugin"}`;
}

function credentialPath(stateDir: string): string {
  return `${stateDir}/credential`;
}

export async function readSavedCredential(stateDir: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const fs = await nodeFs();
  try {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(credentialPath(stateDir), "utf8");
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as { credential?: string };
    return parsed.credential || undefined;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

export async function writeSavedCredential(
  stateDir: string,
  credential: string,
  url: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const fs = await nodeFs();
  fs.mkdirSync(stateDir, { recursive: true, mode: STATE_DIR_MODE });
  try {
    fs.chmodSync(stateDir, STATE_DIR_MODE);
  } catch {
    // Best effort: some filesystems ignore modes.
  }
  const path = credentialPath(stateDir);
  fs.writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify({ credential, url }), { mode: CREDENTIAL_FILE_MODE });
  try {
    fs.chmodSync(path, CREDENTIAL_FILE_MODE);
  } catch {
    // Best effort.
  }
}

export async function clearSavedCredential(stateDir: string): Promise<void> {
  const fs = await nodeFs();
  try {
    fs.unlinkSync(credentialPath(stateDir));
  } catch {
    // Already gone.
  }
}

async function exchangeCode(base: string, code: string): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch(pairUrlFromBase(base), {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ code }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new CredentialError(`Pairing code was rejected (HTTP ${res.status}).`);
  }
  const payload = (await res.json()) as { credential?: string };
  if (!payload.credential) {
    throw new CredentialError("Pairing response had no credential.");
  }
  return payload.credential;
}

/**
 * Applies the startup order: explicit credential, then the saved file, then a
 * one-time pairing code (exchanged and saved). Returns the credential, whether
 * it came from the file, and the state directory. Never logs either secret.
 */
export async function resolveCredential(
  pluginId: string,
  inputs: PairingInputs,
): Promise<{ credential: string; fromFile: boolean; stateDir: string }> {
  const stateDir = await resolveStateDir(
    inputs.stateDir ?? env("ETHER_PLUGIN_STATE_DIR") ?? "",
    pluginId,
  );
  const explicit = (inputs.credential ?? env("ETHER_PLUGIN_CREDENTIAL") ?? "").trim();
  if (explicit) {
    return { credential: explicit, fromFile: false, stateDir };
  }
  const saved = await readSavedCredential(stateDir);
  if (saved) {
    return { credential: saved, fromFile: true, stateDir };
  }
  const url = inputs.url ?? env("ETHER_URL") ?? "";
  const code = (inputs.code ?? env("ETHER_PAIRING_CODE") ?? "").trim();
  if (url.trim() && code) {
    const credential = await exchangeCode(url, code);
    await writeSavedCredential(stateDir, credential, url);
    return { credential, fromFile: true, stateDir };
  }
  throw new CredentialError(noCredentialMessage());
}
``````

``````
import type {
``````
